title: Executive Driver - NATO Headquarters M/W/X
description:
Executive Driver, NATO Headquarters

Application deadline: 12 October, 11:59 PM CET

Apply here: https://bit.ly/3TJGHQq 

 

  1. ABOUT THE ROLE

Do you have experience as a professional VIP driver? 

NATO's Office of Security is hiring! 

The Executive Driver will plan and execute the transportation of NATO senior leaders - primarily in Brussels, Belgium but also occasionally in neighbouring cities and countries. They will drive armoured and non-armoured passenger cars and vans, on official NATO business, following protocol and adhering to organizational priorities. 

They will also be responsible for handling various administrative and maintenance actions linked to the daily tasks. 

Please note that this position requires flexibility to work outside normal working hours at short notice and be assigned on-call duties, when required.

2. QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE

title: Multi-skilled maintenance technician - English is allowed!
description:
Are you a hands-on technician who's already living in Belgium? Do you have solid knowledge of electricity or electromechanics? And are you looking for a stable job in maintenance work with lots of variety? Then this might be the job for you!

For a growing transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for a multi-skilled maintenance technician with a strong background in electrical maintenance or electromechanics to help maintain the buildings, warehouse, technical installations, and outdoor areas of the company. And the best part: Dutch isn't required, so you can also apply if you speak English very well!

Your role

As technician, you play a key role in ensuring the reliability, safety, and operational performance of the infrastructure. You perform both the preventive and corrective maintenance of all the facilities, ensuring the logistical operations keep running safely and efficiently. Electricity is at the heart of the job, but you're also responsible for a wide range of general building maintenance.

Your key duties:

  • Perform various kinds of repairs, replacements and maintenance works to the infrastructure of the company
  • Carry out preventive technical controls on the various installations
  • Keep up the company grounds and outdoor facilities
  • Help perform maintenance and repairs to the company vehicles
  • Supervise external contractors and service providers

You'll sometimes need to go into the freezer warehouse, of course with the necessary thermal clothing.

Is this you?

  • Education and/or experience in electrical maintenance, electromechanics or another relevent technical field
  • Able to read electrical diagrams and schematics
  • Own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)
  • Very good knowledge of English, both spoken and written
  • Already living in Belgium, preferably in the greater area of Oostkamp

Then please don't hesitate to apply, because this job could be yours!

Any other technical skills are a big plus but not required, e.g. mechanics, plumbing, HVAC...

title: contextbegeleider
description:
Bij Amber vzw te Bierbeek zetten we ons elke dag in voor kwetsbare jongeren en gezinnen. Dat doen we met open hart, echte betrokkenheid en een stevige portie professionaliteit.
Bij Amber vzw geloven we dat elke jongere en elk gezin kansen verdient. Het team Contextbegeleiding biedt mobiele ondersteuning aan gezinnen met kinderen en jongeren tussen 0 en 25 jaar. We stappen mee in hun leefwereld, zoeken samen naar wat werkt en helpen gezinnen groeien in hun kracht.

Wat ga je doen?

Je biedt begeleiding op maat aan gezinnen en hun netwerk, en werkt samen aan haalbare doelen. Concreet betekent dat:

  • Je begeleidt gezinnen en hun netwerk in hun thuissituatie.
  • Je plant zelfstandig je agenda en voert huisbezoeken uit.
  • Je ondersteunt gezinnen bij het realiseren van hun doelstellingen en bewaakt het proces.
  • Je overlegt met betrokken partners (school, hulpverlening, familie …).
  • Je beheert je eigen begeleidingsdossiers en zorgt voor een transparante administratie.
  • Je werkt nauw samen met je team en neemt actief deel aan overlegmomenten.
  • Je denkt mee over de werking van de dienst en neemt naast het begeleidingswerk ook andere taken op.
  • Je hebt een diploma hoger onderwijs met sociale of pedagogische oriëntatie en/of
    relevante werkervaring in de jeugdhulp of welzijnssector.
  • Je werkt vanuit de krachten van mensen en de organisatie. Je focust op
    vaardigheden en mogelijkheden, maar gaat tegelijkertijd problemen en moeilijke
    thema’s niet uit de weg.
  • Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid op voor je acties.
  • Je beschikt over de nodige zelfreflectie en staat open voor feedback.
  • Je bent enthousiast, leergierig en stressbestendig.
  • Je kan zelfstandig werken en .functioneert ook goed binnen een team.
  • Je bent sociaal vaardig, communicatief en empathisch.
  • Je kan je werk plannen, organiseren en structureren.
  • Je bent flexibel inzetbaar en bent bereid ook ’s avonds te werken
  • Je beschikt over een rijbewijs B en een eigen wagen aangezien je vaak op de baan
    bent om je te verplaatsen naar je gezinnen.
  • Je kan een uittreksel uit het strafregister (model 2) voorleggen.

title: Warehouse job: order picker in day shift
description:
Are you already familiar with orderpicking and logistics? And are you looking for a stable and physically engaging role with job security? And do you like great hours to get a good work-life balance? Then this is an excellent opportunity for you!

For a large and growing logistics in Oostkamp specialised in frozen goods, we're looking for an orderpicker to join the day shift team in the freezer warehouse. Do cold temperatures not scare you at all and do you speak English well? Then don't hesitate to apply, because the company is very welcoming to speakers of Dutch and English!

The job

As an orderpicker, you play a crucial part in the company’s logistical process. You work in the freezer every day to prepare orders for supermarkets throughout Europe.

Your responsibilites include:

  • Making orders based on order lists
  • Preparing completed orders for shipment
  • Taking the orders to the loading docks for the trucks

You do all of this using an electrical pallet truck (also known as an "EPT").

Be sure to apply if you:

  • Have experience in orderpicking or other warehouse work
  • Aren't afraid of physically heavy work in a freezer environment
  • Have your own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)

Experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT) is a big plus, but not required.

!! Please note: you need to live in Belgium for this job. Actief cannot help you immigrate nor provide housing. If you don't have an official address in Belgium, you don't qualify and cannot apply !!

title: Order picker - night shift - English allowed!
description:
Are you a true night owl who performs best during the night? Do you already have some experience in order picking or logistics? Are you looking for a physically challenging role with job security? Then this could be the perfect job for you!

For a stable and growing transport company in Oostkamp that specializes in frozen food logistics, we're looking for an order picker to join the team in the freezer in the night shift. Do cold temperatures not scare you at all and do you speak English well? Then don't hesitate to apply, because the company is very welcoming to speakers of Dutch and English!

The job

As an order picker, you're the corner stone of the company's logistical processes. You work in the freezer every night to prepare orders for supermarkets throughout Europe.

Your responsibilites include:

  • Making orders based on order lists
  • Preparing completed orders for shipment
  • Taking the orders to the loading docks for the trucks

You do all of this using an electrical pallet truck (also known as an "EPT").

Be sure to apply if you:

  • Have experience in orderpicking or other warehouse work
  • Aren't afraid of physically heavy work in a freezer environment
  • Feel at your absolute best at night and are looking for a night job
  • Have your own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)

Experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT) is a big plus, but not required.

title: Coördinator Wooncentrum Villa84
description:
Vzw Het Balanske is van oorsprong een door het Vlaams Agentschap voor Personen met een Handicap (VAPH) erkend vrijetijdszorgcentrum gelegen in Tielt-Winge. Sinds de oprichting in 1992 wenden we ons tot kinderen, jongeren en volwassenen met een beperking, en hun brede context. We bieden vrijetijdsbesteding op maat aanbieden voor de brede doelgroep én willen een plek zijn waar ouders met een kind met een beperking steun vinden bij elkaar en elkaar kunnen ontmoeten. Sinds 2018 behuizen we, ook in Tielt-Winge, dagcentrum de Kalebas waar (jong)volwassenen met een beperking terecht kunnen voor een zinvolle en kwalitatieve dagbesteding in ateliervorm. Sinds begin dit jaar behuizen we, in onze tweede vestiging te Diest, een wooncentrum voor (jong)volwassenen met een beperking en een aangrenzende inclusieve koffie- en lunchbar waar gebruikers van ons dag- en wooncentrum een actieve rol opnemen in het bedienen van klanten.

Villa84 is de naam van ons gloednieuw wooncentrum. 14 (jong)volwassenen met een beperking vinden hier een warme thuis. Zij nemen overdag deel aan zinvolle dagbesteding – bij dagcentrum De Kalebas of elders. ’s Ochtends, van zodra zij terugkeren naar het wooncentrum en in het weekend is begeleiding aanwezig; er is tevens een inslapende nachtbegeleider. Villa84 wil een veilige, inclusieve en huiselijke omgeving bieden waar bewoners zichzelf kunnen zijn en waar familie en netwerk altijd welkom zijn.

Om de werking van Villa84 mee vorm te geven, zoeken wij een coördinator die een sleutelrol zal spelen in de verdere uitbouw van dit nog nieuwe woonproject en in de ondersteuning van het begeleidend team.

Wat is jouw takenpakket?

  • Je staat in voor de operationele werking van het wooncentrum en tracht deze maximaal te optimaliseren.
  • Je bouwt de dagelijkse werking samen met het begeleidersteam verder uit en organiseert het wooncentrum praktisch en inhoudelijk.
  • Samen met de begeleiding sta je garant voor kwalitatieve ondersteuning van de doelgroep.
  • Je maakt samen met de coördinator van dagcentrum De Kalebas een vlotte, complementaire en nauwe samenwerking mogelijk tussen de pijlers van dag- en woonondersteuning.
  • Je maakt deel uit van het kernteam en bent dan ook beleidsmatig sterk. Je volgt wijzigende of nieuwe regelgeving en beleidselementen op en vertaalt deze naar de praktijk.
  • Je garandeert kwaliteitsvolle zorg, in lijn met de VAPH-regelgeving.
  • Je zorgt voor heldere en verbindende communicatie met alle betrokkenen. Je bent het eerste aanspreekpunt voor bewoners, familie, je team en externe partners.
  • Je verzorgt het intakeproces bij nieuwe aanmeldingen, maakt individuele dienstverleningsovereenkomsten (IDO’s) op en beheert de cliëntendossiers (via ZorgOnline). Je stelt met je team handelingsplannen op per cliënt en volgt deze samen met de aandachtsbegeleider op.
  • Je bent een coachend leidinggevende die teamleden ondersteunt, motiveert en mee op sleeptouw neemt. Je verbindt en enthousiasmeert.
  • Je staat mee in voor het VTO-beleid en leidt je team toe naar relevante vormingen, trainingen en opleidingen.
  • Je bent logistiek en administratief sterk.
  • Je vindt het niet erg om in de groep te staan. Je hoofdrol is vanzelfsprekend deze van coördinator, maar je durft jezelf ook inschakelen in de groepswerking. Je kan je indien nodig flexibel opstellen om bij ziekte, afwezigheid of gedurende het weekend in te springen als begeleider.
  • Je rapporteert rechtstreeks aan de algemeen coördinator en de directeur van vzw Het Balanske en werkt nauw samen met de coördinator van dagcentrum de Kalebas.

Wie zoeken wij?

We zoeken een coördinator die meedenkt, meedoet én meebouwt.

Jij bent iemand die:

  • Een bachelor- of masterdiploma heeft, bij voorkeur in een orthopedagogische, sociale of menswetenschappelijke richting.
  • Ervaring heeft in de zorgsector en liefst ook in een leidinggevende of coördinerende functie. Kennis van en ervaring binnen een VAPH-voorziening is een belangrijke meerwaarde.
  • Beslissingsvaardig én toegankelijk is: je kan knopen doorhakken, maar luistert ook naar je team en betrekt hen.
  • Flexibel, stressbestendig en communicatief sterk is.
  • Orthopedagogisch inzicht heeft om onze bewoners samen met het team de juiste ondersteuning te bieden en handelingsplannen mee uit te werken en op te volgen.
  • Administratief en digitaal onderlegd is.
  • Een blanco uittreksel uit het strafregister kan voorleggen.

title: Maatwerkcoach Kok - vlinder
description:
Als Vlinder-kok / Werkbegeleider bij Mariasteen combineer je jouw passie voor koken met het begeleiden van een team. Je bent de drijvende kracht achter de keuken in de verschillende restaurants van Mariasteen, bereidt dagelijks verse maaltijden en helpt medewerkers met een afstand tot de arbeidsmarkt hun talenten verder te ontwikkelen.

Jouw functieomschrijving

  • Je springt in waar nodig en ondersteunt de keukenwerking in de verschillende horecazaken van Mariasteen.
  • Je organiseert de dagelijkse werking, bewaakt de kwaliteit en bereidt met passie verse diners en maaltijden.
  • Je begeleidt, motiveert en coacht een team van medewerkers met een afstand tot de arbeidsmarkt.
  • Je past je vlot aan verschillende keukens, teams en werkplanningen aan.
  • Je verdeelt de taken en zorgt voor een efficiënte en veilige keukenwerking.
  • Je bewaakt de hygiëne, voedselveiligheid en kwaliteit van elk gerecht.
  • Je werkt nauw samen met collega's om elke service, zowel in de restaurants als bij cateringopdrachten, vlot en succesvol te laten verlopen.

  • Je beschikt over een hotelschooldiploma en hebt bij voorkeur reeds leidinggevende ervaring.
  • Je bent op de hoogte van de HACCP-wetgeving, de procedures en aankoopsystemen.
  • Je bent een people manager, je hebt ervaring in het beheren van een team. Je ben coach, motivator en beschikt over de nodige diplomatie en empatisch vermogen.
  • Je kan overweg met MS Office (zoals Outlook, Word en Excel) om je planning en administratie mee te ondersteunen.
  • Je communiceert vlot in het Nederlands.
  • Weekend- en avondwerk schrikken jou niet af — je weet dat horeca leeft wanneer anderen ontspannen.
  • Je houdt van afwisseling en krijgt energie van een job waar geen enkele dag dezelfde is.
  • Je bent klant-en resultaatgericht.
  • Je bent een teamspeler: één team één doel.

title: Project Manager | Elektriciteit | Halle
description:
Als Project Manager ben je verantwoordelijk voor het succesvol realiseren van complexe technische projecten bij internationale klanten binnen een innovatieve industriële omgeving actief in energie- en datacenterinfrastructuur. Je neemt de volledige end-to-end verantwoordelijkheid op voor projecten, van de initiële klantorder tot de installatie en uiteindelijke oplevering. Daarbij beheer je het volledige traject, inclusief planning, budgetbewaking, opvolging van mijlpalen en het garanderen van kwaliteit en timing. Je fungeert als centraal aanspreekpunt voor de klant en bouwt aan duurzame relaties door verwachtingen helder af te stemmen en een vlotte communicatie te onderhouden gedurende het volledige projectverloop. In deze rol stuur je multidisciplinaire teams aan, waaronder engineering, supply chain, productie en service, en zorg je voor een efficiënte samenwerking tussen alle betrokken partijen. Daarnaast beoordeel je offertes op technische en commerciële haalbaarheid en formuleer je onderbouwde adviezen richting interne stakeholders. Je coördineert zowel interne als externe betrokkenen, bewaakt de voortgang van projecten en stuurt bij waar nodig om de beoogde resultaten te realiseren. Dankzij jouw gestructureerde aanpak, sterke organisatorische vaardigheden en gevoel voor ownership slaag je erin complexe vraagstukken om te zetten in concrete oplossingen en tastbare resultaten voor industriële eindgebruikers. Deze functie biedt bovendien veel ruimte voor autonomie, initiatief en het opbouwen van langdurige klantrelaties binnen een professionele en toekomstgerichte organisatie. Provide your feedback on BizChat Hoe ziet een typische werkdag eruit?Welke technische kennis is vereist?Hoe bouw je duurzame klantrelaties op? FilesFiles Message Copilot
  • Een masterdiploma in Engineering, bijvoorbeeld elektriciteit, elektronica, bouw of industrieel ontwerp, of een gelijkwaardige technische richting.
  • Minimaal vijf tot tien jaar ervaring als Project Manager in een industriële omgeving met complexe technische projecten.
  • Sterk technisch inzicht in elektrische, mechanische of controls-systemen en de samenhang tussen deze disciplines.
  • Ervaring met projectmethodologieën zoals PMP of Prince2 wordt beschouwd als een duidelijke meerwaarde voor deze functie.
  • Aantoonbare vaardigheid in budgetbeheer, planning en stakeholdermanagement binnen technische en industriële projecten.
  • Een zelfstandige, proactieve en oplossingsgerichte werkstijl, gericht op het realiseren van afgesproken projectdoelstellingen.
  • Vlotte communicatie in het Engels en Nederlands en/of Frans, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk bij klanten en interne teams.
  • Bereidheid tot beperkte internationale verplaatsingen van ongeveer tien procent van de werktijd waar nodig.

title: Verzorgende oproepzorg Toontjeshuis
description:
Familiehulp ondersteunt mensen in hun dagelijks leven, met aandacht voor zorg, welzijn en huishouden.

Als Verzorgende oproepzorg geef je ondersteuning aan personen met een beperking die zelfstandig wonen. Je werkt samen met een zelf organiserend team en staat in voor zorg op maat, alle dagen van de week. 

Je beantwoordt oproepen van bewoners en helpt bij:

  • Noodoproepen (bv. bewoner is gevallen).
  • Dringende hulpvragen (bv. bewoner moet naar het toilet).
  • Kortere hulpvragen (bv. korte vraag, iets vergeten).
  • Gewone zorgvragen (max. 60 minuten).

Jouw algemene taken omvatten:

  • Lichaamsverzorging van de klant.
  • Maaltijden klaarmaken (opwarmen, broodmaaltijd, enz.).
  • Ondersteuning bij het nemen van maaltijden.
  • Huishoudelijke taken (opruimen, wassen).
  • Begeleiden bij verplaatsingen in huis (uit- en in bed, van- en naar WC, enz).
  • Sociale ondersteuning: actief luisteren, helpen bij zinvolle tijdsbesteding.
  • Diploma Verzorgende of gelijkwaardig (zie www.familiehulp.be/diploma).
  • Je houdt van sociaal contact en communiceert vlot.
  • Betrouwbaarheid en respect voor privacy zijn voor jou vanzelfsprekend.
  • Bereidheid om avond- en weekendwerk in beurtrol te doen.
  • Eigen vervoer (fiets, step, auto, …).

Parlez-vous français ? Téléchargez la pièce jointe au bas de cette offre d'emploi (vactureBijlage.pdf)
Do you speak English? Download the attachment at the bottom of this vacancy (vactureBijlage.pdf)

De ramen lappen tot ze glimmen. De was piekfijn in de plooi strijken. De boodschappen netjes regelen. Lekkere gerechten klaarmaken. De afwas én de vloeren doen schitteren. Als huishoudhulp bij Het Poetsbureau doe je deze taken dagelijks voor je klanten. Dicht bij huis en mét de glimlach. En je laat trouwens niet enkel het huis van klanten blinken. Je straalt zelf ook! Want voor ons ben jij zoveel meer dan een huishoudhulp. Jij bent een van de Sterren van Het Poetsbureau.

Verwacht dus oprecht respect voor wat je doet. Maar ook het beste loonpakket in de sector en vele extra voordelen zoals een auto of elektrische fiets. Én aandacht voor je gezondheid en veiligheid natuurlijk, dankzij duidelijke instructies en opleidingen om veilig te poetsen, strijken, koken, enzoverder. Alles tiptop in orde. Zoals een Ster het verdient!

Je werkt graag bij klanten aan huis. Je laat met plezier woningen stralen. Je hebt liefde voor het vak en werkt met zorg. Kortom: je blinkt uit: in huishoudelijk werk én in de omgang. Herken je jezelf hierin? Dan heb je alles in huis om uit te blinken als een Ster van Het Poetsbureau.

title: German-Speaking Customer Support Advisor | Telecommunications (m,w,d) anywhere in Bulgaria (Callcenteragent/in)
description:
Start : 14/9

Training online. One week to spend in Varna  after the training for the nesting phase. Afterwards anywhere in Bulgaria!

We are partnering with a leading international customer experience provider to recruit German-speaking Customer Support Advisors for a telecommunications project in Bulgaria.

This is a remote position within Bulgaria, combining customer service, technical troubleshooting, and light sales. You’ll support German-speaking customers with their mobile services, billing questions, and technical issues while identifying opportunities to recommend suitable additional products.

Important: While the role is remote, candidates must be available to complete 1 week of on-site nesting in Varna after the initial remote training period. The role operates Monday to Friday, 40 hours per week, with rotating shifts between 09:00 and 19:00.

Your Role

- Support German-speaking customers via phone and email
- Resolve technical, billing, and general service enquiries
- Handle complaints professionally and ensure timely resolution
- Troubleshoot customer issues and escalate more complex cases when necessary
- Accurately document customer interactions and relevant information
- Identify opportunities to recommend and cross-sell suitable products and services
- Deliver a consistently high-quality customer experience while meeting performance standards

Your Qualifications

- German C1
- English B1 or above
- High school diploma or equivalent
- Excellent communication and problem-solving skills
- Customer-focused and comfortable handling complaints
- Interest in troubleshooting and technical support
- Previous customer service or contact centre experience is an advantage, but not required
- Based in Bulgaria or willing to relocate

The Offer

- Remote working model within Bulgaria, with only 1 week of mandatory on-site nesting in Varna
- Indefinite employment contract
- Competitive salary plus performance bonus
- Uncapped sales bonus, averaging approximately €200/month
- Relocation package for eligible EU citizens, including transportation reimbursement and a €260/month accommodation allowance for the first 3 months
- Meal allowance
- Private health insurance
- Multisport and/or Coolfit card
- Access to an online learning platform
- Monday to Friday schedule – weekends off
- Comprehensive training and long-term career development opportunities

Homeoffice:
Umfang: Maximal 100%

description: You are an enthusiastic and adventurous person? Are you ready for new challenges? If your answer is YES - then here is a role for you - join the leader in the CX (Customer Experience) industry TELUS Digital Bulgaria! As a Back Office Gaming Support Specialist with German and English, you will be a part of a great team and all together will: Assist our players with any issues they might experience or report Focus on the player and provide the ultimate player experience Listen to the voice of the players and communicate it further to the appropriate teams Work with our team to improve our processes What we are looking for: Fluency in German and a good command of English Gaming experience - you have played games and you can relate to a player's concept, community, and mindset Player empathy and understanding a player's perspective when tackling their issues Understanding of Player Support Desire to help the players as best as possible and to contribute to the team's success In Return, We Offer: Relocation Bonus: €1,200 Gross (paid in 2 installations) - to support relocation and initial rent costs 21 Days of Company-Provided Accommodation on arrival, and assistance in finding a long-term home Flight Tickets Covered - we handle your travel to Sofia Fully paid training Stable job and career development opportunities Attractive salary Additional health insurance More than fifty benefits and services to choose from Positive international working environment Support and learning Employee referral bonuses

title: Kundtjänstmedarbetare med svenska och engelska – Sofia
description:
For more than 37 years, Sutherland has been a global leader in Customer Experience Management (CXM). As a pioneer in automation and innovative customer solutions, we deliver exceptional service on behalf of our clients worldwide.

With operations in 60 countries and a presence in Bulgaria since 2008, our diverse team of more than 2,000 professionals supports customers in 17 different languages from Sofia, Varna, Burgas, and remote locations.

🎯 About the Role

We are looking for a Customer Support Associate with Swedish and English to join our team supporting customers of a leading international telecommunications provider.

You will assist customers through inbound voice and non-voice channels, including phone, email, and chat, with day-to-day service-related questions such as top-ups, SIM activation, roaming usage, and general account inquiries. This is a pure customer service role with no sales, upselling, or device troubleshooting.

Key Responsibilities

    Handle inbound customer inquiries via phone, email, chat, and other supported channels
    Assist customers with top-ups, SIM activation, roaming usage, and general service-related questions
    Resolve customer concerns efficiently and aim for first-contact resolution whenever possible
    Accurately document customer interactions and follow established processes
    Provide professional, clear, and empathetic support in every interaction

What We’re Looking For

Must-have:

    Swedish – minimum B2 level
    English – minimum B2 level
    Undergraduate, graduate, postgraduate education or equivalent
    Strong verbal and written communication skills
    Good computer skills and ability to work with multiple systems
    Availability to work 09:00–18:00, Monday to Friday

Nice-to-have:

    Previous experience in customer service, BPO, telecommunications, or a similar environment
    Experience working with CRM or ticketing systems
    Strong problem-solving skills and a customer-focused mindset

What You’ll Get

Compensation & Benefits:

    Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses
    Additional health insurance
    Food vouchers
    3 weeks of paid training in English, followed by accreditation
    Relocation support to Sofia for eligible candidates

Work Environment:

    Onsite from our Sofia office
    Working hours: 09:00–18:00, Monday to Friday
    Voice and non-voice customer support

Growth & Development

You will receive structured training and ongoing support while developing your customer service and communication skills in an international environment.

🚀 Ready to Apply?

title: Digital Transformation Services Lead (Hybrid)
description:
WorkNomads is on the hunt for a Head of Digital Transformation to join our team!



Who We Are:

We are building a community where global talent is geographically unleashed, and diversity is celebrated. We champion the freedom of living and working across borders, shaping a nation without a country.

·       Remote engineering services, global impact — expert engineering, design, and business talent in cross-disciplinary project teams.

·       Diversity celebrated — 40+ nationalities, 4 continents, one team.

·       Continuous growth — we invest in you: projects, coliving, community, pushing you beyond what you thought possible.



Your mission at WorkNomads:

The Digital Transformation Services Lead is responsible for reimagining and modernizing Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) service delivery by introducing digital, AI-enabled, and architecture-led operating models. Leveraging an enterprise architecture background, this role bridges business strategy, technology, and operations to transform how services are designed, delivered, measured, and continuously improved.

As the strategic technology leader for service transformation, the role also provides direction and governance to the IT organization, ensuring technology investments, platforms, and architecture enable the future state of service delivery.

Working in close partnership with Operations leadership to understand service performance, customer needs, and operational challenges through data-driven insights, the role actively uncovers commercial opportunities by identifying new digital capabilities, value-added services, and innovation initiatives that expand the client's service portfolio, strengthen strategic partnerships, and drive sustainable revenue growth and profitability.

Key Responsibilities

Service Transformation Strategy

Define and execute the digital transformation strategy for customer service accounts and managed services.

Design future-state operating models that leverage AI, automation, analytics, cloud technologies, and digital platforms.

Transform traditional BPO delivery into standardized, technology-enabled, and data-driven service models.

Establish scalable frameworks that can be replicated across multiple accounts and business units.



Enterprise Architecture & Technology Leadership

Apply Enterprise Architecture principles to align business capabilities, processes, applications, data, and technology with strategic objectives.

Define the target architecture for digital service delivery and guide the evolution of supporting technology platforms.

Ensure technology decisions support scalability, interoperability, security, governance, and operational excellence.

Lead and steer the IT organization in delivering technology capabilities that support business transformation.

Partner with IT leaders to prioritize investments, modernize platforms, and accelerate innovation.



Innovation & New Ways of Working

Introduce proven operational and digital practices from industries such as financial services, manufacturing, healthcare, logistics, and technology into the BPO environment.

Challenge existing service delivery models and drive continuous innovation.

Promote Agile, DevSecOps, product-oriented delivery, platform thinking, and automation-first principles across service operations.

Foster a culture of experimentation, continuous improvement, and technology adoption.



Operational Excellence

Redesign business processes to improve efficiency, quality, resilience, and customer experience.

Establish governance models, KPIs, dashboards, and performance metrics that provide end-to-end visibility into service performance.

Standardize processes and operating procedures to improve consistency across accounts.

Ensure transformation initiatives deliver measurable operational and financial outcomes.



Commercial Growth

Identify opportunities to expand service scope through digital capabilities, AI solutions, automation, consulting, and managed services.

Partner with Sales, Account Management, and Client Success teams to develop transformation roadmaps and business cases.

Position the organization as a strategic digital transformation partner for clients.

Support revenue growth through upselling, cross-selling, and innovative service offerings.



Financial & Value Realization

Improve account profitability through technology-enabled productivity gains and optimized delivery models.

Develop business cases that quantify expected benefits, ROI, and cost savings.

Track realization of transformation benefits and continuously optimize value delivery.



Leadership & Stakeholder Management

Lead cross-functional transformation programs involving Operations, IT, Digital, AI, Product, and Client teams.

Influence senior executives and client stakeholders on transformation priorities and investment decisions.

Mentor operational and technology leaders in digital transformation, enterprise architecture, and modern service delivery practices.

Build strong collaboration between business and IT to ensure successful execution.

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related discipline.

Enterprise Architecture experience with a strong understanding of business architecture, application architecture, data architecture, and technology architecture.

10+ years of experience in digital transformation, enterprise architecture, IT strategy, or service transformation.

Experience within BPO, customer operations, shared services, managed services, or large-scale service organizations.

Demonstrated success leading digital transformation initiatives involving AI, automation, cloud, analytics, and modern enterprise platforms.

Experience leading technology teams and influencing enterprise-wide transformation programs.

Knowledge of Enterprise Architecture frameworks (e.g., TOGAF) is an advantage.

Familiarity with Agile, DevSecOps, ITIL, Lean, Six Sigma, or Product Operating Models is preferred.

Product Manager – Managed Cloud Services (f/m/d)


Full or part time

At NTT DATA Business Solutions, we drive innovation – from advisory and implementation to managed services and beyond, powered by a global team of over 18,500 experts representing over 90 nations in more than 30 countries. With SAP at our core and a powerful ecosystem of partners like Microsoft and ServiceNow, we continuously improve solutions and AI-driven technology to make them work for companies – and for their people.

We are part of NTT DATA, a $30+ billion business and technology services, AI and digital infrastructure leader. As a Global Top Employer, NTT DATA serves 75% of the Fortune Global 100 and, with experts in over 70 countries, co-innovates solutions that encourage experimentation and recognize great work.

With us, you have endless opportunities to think big, act bold and take ownership. Make this the place where you belong, learn, and build your network.

**Make this the place where you grow.

**Location: **Germany, Romania or Bulgaria

What makes us special:

We have a holistic view of the individual needs of our employees. Here (https://nttdata-solutions.com/de/karriere/benefits/)  you can find a detailed overview of our wide variety of benefits during different life phases.

■ Flexible working hours and locations: workation, mobile working, part-time models, sabbaticals, etc.

■ Your further development by plan: topic-specific induction, targeted career development based on career models, programs and your own academy

■ Family first: e.g. daycare allowance, paid maternity leave and paternity network

■ SAP Platinum Partnership: strong SAP partnership, large knowledge network, and SAP Learning Hub and certification opportunities.

■ We take care: e.g. 25% subsidy for company pension plan, company health management and cooperation with fitness providers

■ We help you get from A to B: company car (depending on your role), discount on public transport and bicycle leasing via JobRad®.



Do you love challenges?

■ In your role, you will be responsible for identifying and evaluating market trends and new technologies for IaaS and Paas Services for our SAP customer base (Managed Cloud Services).

■ You will play an active role in creating managed services portfolio roadmaps.

■ Your tasks will also include designing new global managed cloud portfolio services in terms of content, offerings, and cost calculation.

■ You will take on end-to-end service offer management (go-to-market, portfolio, delivery) with a focus on portfolio lifecycle management and support the sales and presales teams with your expertise.

■ You will maintain key product documentation (SOWs, costing, pricing, sales enablement) in collaboration with Presales & Bid Management

■ Your responsibilities also include providing internal teams with product knowledge and conducting enablement sessions to ensure readiness for market launch.

■ Finally, you will be responsible for preparing decision-making templates for senior/executive management.

Convince us with your potential!

■ You have successfully completed a degree in (business) information technology, economics or a comparable qualification.

■ You have at least 3-5 years of professional experience in SAP technology consulting, operations and support.

■ You already have comprehensive knowledge of Hyperscalers (Azure, AWS, GCP), Infrastructure-as-a-Service or Platform-as-a-Service as well as SAP products and technology (S/4HANA, SAP Netweaver, SAP ECC).

■ Knowledge of automation and AI is an advantage.

■ You are fluent in written and spoken English and/or German.

■ Occasional travel, including (inter)nationally, is not a challenge for you.

■ You are characterized by customer-oriented thinking and acting, combined with strong communication and presentation skills and a confident manner. A team-oriented approach to work – including in an international environment – rounds off your profile.

Do you have questions?

We look forward to receiving your complete application documents stating your earliest start date.

NTT DATA Business Solutions: Make this the place where you grow

Theresa Froemmel

title: Svensktalande E-Commerce Advisor i Bulgarien
description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they are doing!

We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

Concentrix Bulgaria is now looking for a number of dynamic and self-motivated Customer Advisors to join our exciting new project.

VF is the global company behind some of the world’s leading lifestyle brands including household names such as, Timberland, The North Face, Napapijri, Lee, Wrangler, Vans Eastpak and Kipling
Our aim is to consistently deliver world class customer service and we never lose sight of our goal - our customers are the focus of everything we do here! From email to phone in a multitude of languages, we’re on hand to offer care to all our customers to make sure they have a fun and enjoyable shopping experience with us.  

We’re an energetic, innovative and forward thinking team who are always looking for new ideas to delight and wow our customers.  The Customer Advisor is required to:

•    Be proficient (verbal & written) in Swedish
•    Be advanced in English
•    Be able to represent our client’s brands and deliver outstanding customer service with clarity, passion and enthusiasm
•    Be flexible to meet the changing needs and varying deadlines of our business
•    Be able to work to customer service measures, metrics and KPIs within a service targeted environment.
•    Hold a High-school or University degree
•    Possess excellent computer literacy
•    Have previous experience in a customer service environment, preferably telephone based.

Main responsibilities:

•    Communicating with customers by telephone, email and online to provide outstanding service
•    Building a rapport with customers to help them with enquiries including; order taking, product information, tracking deliveries, returns, sizing and quality queries
•    Discussing new products and managing multiple tasks to promptly resolve customer queries
•    Identifying ways to improve processes in order to improve sales, brand loyalty and the customer service and experience
•    Updating our systems with information and helping marketing, retail and other teams to further improve customer service and satisfaction.
Who are we:
Concentrix, a wholly owned subsidiary of SYNNEX Corporation (NYSE: SNX), is a leading business services company. We focus on customer engagement and improving business outcomes for over 450 global clients across many continents. Our 100,000+ staff deliver technology-infused, omni-channel customer experience management, marketing optimization, digital, consulting, analytics and back office solutions in 40+ languages from 125+ delivery centres. We serve automotive; banking and financial services; insurance; healthcare; technology; consumer electronics; media and communications; retail and e-commerce; travel and transportation; and energy and public-sector clients.

title: Digital Transformation Services Lead (Hybrid)
description:
WorkNomads is on the hunt for a Head of Digital Transformation to join our team!



Who We Are:

We are building a community where global talent is geographically unleashed, and diversity is celebrated. We champion the freedom of living and working across borders, shaping a nation without a country.

·       Remote engineering services, global impact — expert engineering, design, and business talent in cross-disciplinary project teams.

·       Diversity celebrated — 40+ nationalities, 4 continents, one team.

·       Continuous growth — we invest in you: projects, coliving, community, pushing you beyond what you thought possible.



Your mission at WorkNomads:

The Digital Transformation Services Lead is responsible for reimagining and modernizing Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) service delivery by introducing digital, AI-enabled, and architecture-led operating models. Leveraging an enterprise architecture background, this role bridges business strategy, technology, and operations to transform how services are designed, delivered, measured, and continuously improved.

As the strategic technology leader for service transformation, the role also provides direction and governance to the IT organization, ensuring technology investments, platforms, and architecture enable the future state of service delivery.

Working in close partnership with Operations leadership to understand service performance, customer needs, and operational challenges through data-driven insights, the role actively uncovers commercial opportunities by identifying new digital capabilities, value-added services, and innovation initiatives that expand the client's service portfolio, strengthen strategic partnerships, and drive sustainable revenue growth and profitability.

Key Responsibilities

Service Transformation Strategy

Define and execute the digital transformation strategy for customer service accounts and managed services.

Design future-state operating models that leverage AI, automation, analytics, cloud technologies, and digital platforms.

Transform traditional BPO delivery into standardized, technology-enabled, and data-driven service models.

Establish scalable frameworks that can be replicated across multiple accounts and business units.



Enterprise Architecture & Technology Leadership

Apply Enterprise Architecture principles to align business capabilities, processes, applications, data, and technology with strategic objectives.

Define the target architecture for digital service delivery and guide the evolution of supporting technology platforms.

Ensure technology decisions support scalability, interoperability, security, governance, and operational excellence.

Lead and steer the IT organization in delivering technology capabilities that support business transformation.

Partner with IT leaders to prioritize investments, modernize platforms, and accelerate innovation.



Innovation & New Ways of Working

Introduce proven operational and digital practices from industries such as financial services, manufacturing, healthcare, logistics, and technology into the BPO environment.

Challenge existing service delivery models and drive continuous innovation.

Promote Agile, DevSecOps, product-oriented delivery, platform thinking, and automation-first principles across service operations.

Foster a culture of experimentation, continuous improvement, and technology adoption.



Operational Excellence

Redesign business processes to improve efficiency, quality, resilience, and customer experience.

Establish governance models, KPIs, dashboards, and performance metrics that provide end-to-end visibility into service performance.

Standardize processes and operating procedures to improve consistency across accounts.

Ensure transformation initiatives deliver measurable operational and financial outcomes.



Commercial Growth

Identify opportunities to expand service scope through digital capabilities, AI solutions, automation, consulting, and managed services.

Partner with Sales, Account Management, and Client Success teams to develop transformation roadmaps and business cases.

Position the organization as a strategic digital transformation partner for clients.

Support revenue growth through upselling, cross-selling, and innovative service offerings.



Financial & Value Realization

Improve account profitability through technology-enabled productivity gains and optimized delivery models.

Develop business cases that quantify expected benefits, ROI, and cost savings.

Track realization of transformation benefits and continuously optimize value delivery.



Leadership & Stakeholder Management

Lead cross-functional transformation programs involving Operations, IT, Digital, AI, Product, and Client teams.

Influence senior executives and client stakeholders on transformation priorities and investment decisions.

Mentor operational and technology leaders in digital transformation, enterprise architecture, and modern service delivery practices.

Build strong collaboration between business and IT to ensure successful execution.

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related discipline.

Enterprise Architecture experience with a strong understanding of business architecture, application architecture, data architecture, and technology architecture.

Stručni uvjeti: KV/SSS tehničkog smjera, vozački ispit, poznavanje rada na računalu.
Na oglas se mogu prijaviti osobe oba spola. Radni odnos se zasniva na neodređeno vrijeme uz obvezni probni rad.
  
U prijavi na oglas potrebno je navesti osobne podatke podnositelja prijave (osobno ime, adresa stanovanja, broj telefona odnosno mobitela te po mogućnosti e-mail adresa) i naziv radnog mjesta na koje se osoba prijavljuje.
Prijavu je potrebno vlastoručno potpisati.
Uz prijavu, kandidati  su dužni priložiti:
•životopis
•dokaz o hrvatskom državljanstvu (preslika / scan osobne iskaznice, putovnice ili domovnice)
•presliku / scan svjedodžbe,
•vozačka dozvola B kategorije.
  
Isprave se prilažu u neovjerenoj preslici ili scanu, a prije izbora kandidat/kinja će predočiti izvornik.
Prijave s dokazima o ispunjavanju uvjeta podnose se do 30. rujna 2026. godine na adresu VODNE USLUGE d.o.o., Bjelovar, Ferde Rusana 21, s naznakom - „prijava na oglas“ ili e-mailom na adresu: pisarnica@vodneusluge-bj.hr
Potpunom prijavom smatra se prijava koja sadrži sve podatke i priloge navedene u oglasu.
Osoba koja nije podnijela pravovremenu ili potpunu prijavu ili ne ispunjava formalne uvjete iz oglasa, ne smatra se kandidatom prijavljenim na oglas.
Kandidat/kinja koji/a ostvaruje pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima dužan/na je u prijavi na oglas pozvati se na to pravo, odnosno priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu i ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate/kinje samo pod jednakim uvjetima.
Kandidat/kinja koji/a može ostvariti pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno članku 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji („Narodne novine“, 121/17, 98/19, 84/21 i 156/23), dužan/a se u prijavi na oglas pozvati na to pravo te ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima.
Kandidat/kinja koji/a se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji uz prijavu na oglas dužan/a je priložiti, pored dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta i sve potrebne dokaze dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-843/843.  Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja u skladu s člankom 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom („Narodne novine“ br. 157/13, 152/14, 39/18 i 32/20), uz prijavu je dužan osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta priložiti i dokaz o utvrđenom statusu osobe s invaliditetom.
Za kandidate koji ispunjavaju uvjete iz oglasa bit će proveden usmeni razgovor, a o vremenu i mjestu održavanja usmenog razgovora, kandidati će biti obaviješteni putem kontakt broja telefona odnosno mobitela ili e-mail adrese iz prijave.
Kandidat/kinja koji/a nije pristupio/ila usmenom razgovoru više se ne smatra kandidatom/kinjom u postupku.
O rezultatima oglasa kandidati/kinje će biti obaviješteni pisanim putem.    
  
VODNE USLUGE d.o.o. pridržavaju pravo poništiti ovaj natječaj u bilo kojem trenutku, bez posebnog obrazloženja.

title: DIPLOMIRANI INŽENJER/KA GRAĐEVINARSTVA-INŽENJER/KA GRAĐEVINARSTVA -PROJEKTANT
description:
PROJEKTANT HIDROTEHNIČKE STRUKE (m/ž) Želite raditi na projektima koji imaju stvaran utjecaj na razvoj gradova i infrastrukture? PRONING DHI d.o.o. traži diplomiranog inženjera građevinarstva / inženjera građevinarstva – projektanta (m/ž) koji želi svoje znanje razvijati kroz rad na složenim hidrotehničkim projektima u Hrvatskoj i regiji. Ako vas zanimaju hidrotehnika, projektiranje, modeliranje i suvremene tehnologije, a želite raditi u stručnom timu i sudjelovati u projektima od koncepcije do realizacije, voljeli bismo vas upoznati. TKO SMO MI? PRONING DHI je privatno projektno društvo iz Zagreba, osnovano 1994. godine. Više od 30 godina bavimo se projektiranjem i konzaltingom u području:
  • urbane hidrotehnike
  • hidrotehnike riječnih slivova
  • eko-inženjerstva.
Sudjelovali smo u izradi kompleksnih hidrotehničkih projekata u Hrvatskoj i regiji – od master planova kanalizacijskih sustava Zagreba, Ljubljane i Osijeka do projekta odvodnje EKO-Kaštelanskog zaljeva. Posebnu pažnju posvećujemo primjeni suvremenih tehnologija. U radu koristimo i razvijamo 1D i 2D matematičke simulacijske modele, a bavimo se i razvojem sustava za predviđanje poplava u realnom vremenu. ŠTO ĆETE RADITI? Kao član našeg projektnog tima sudjelovat ćete u:
  • izradi i vođenju tehničke dokumentacije u području komunalne hidrotehnike
  • razvoju koncepcijskih rješenja te izradi idejnih, glavnih i izvedbenih projekata
  • izradi studija izvodljivosti
  • ishođenju akata za građenje
  • koordinaciji i suradnji s različitim stručnjacima i sudionicima u procesu projektiranja
  • drugim stručnim poslovima iz područja hidrotehničkog projektiranja, ovisno o vašem iskustvu i stručnosti.
Drugim riječima, ne tražimo samo izvršitelja zadataka, već stručnjaka koji želi sudjelovati u razvoju kvalitetnih projektnih rješenja. KOGA TRAŽIMO? Tražimo osobu koja ima:
  • VSS – dipl. ing. građ. / mag. ing. aedif. ili VŠS – ing. građ.
  • iskustvo u izradi hidrotehničkih projekata
  • dobro poznavanje tehničke i zakonske regulative iz područja građevinarstva
  • napredno znanje rada u MS Officeu, AutoCAD-u i Urbanu
  • vozačku dozvolu B kategorije
  • znanje hrvatskog i engleskog jezika.
Prednost, ali ne i uvjet, predstavljaju:
  • najmanje 5 godina radnog iskustva
  • poznavanje SWMM-a i EPANET-a
  • poznavanje GIS alata poput ArcGIS-a i QGIS-a
  • ovlaštenje za inženjera i upis u imenik ovlaštenih inženjera strukovne komore s položenim stručnim ispitom.
Nemate sve navedene kvalifikacije? Ako ste građevinski tehničar s relevantnim radnim iskustvom, također ste dobrodošli prijaviti se. ZAŠTO PRONING DHI? Kod nas ćete imati priliku: RADITI NA SLOŽENIM PROJEKTIMA Sudjelovat ćete na domaćim i internacionalnim projektima u području hidrotehnike. KORISTITI SUVREMENE TEHNOLOGIJE Radit ćete s modernim alatima i tehnologijama, uključujući matematičko modeliranje hidrotehničkih sustava. RAZVIJATI SVOJE ZNANJE Omogućujemo stručno usavršavanje i razvoj kroz rad na različitim projektima. BITI DIO STRUČNOG TIMA Radit ćete u poticajnom i dinamičnom okruženju, uz suradnju s različitim stručnjacima. IMATI STABILNE UVJETE RADA Rad se uglavnom odvija u našem uredu u Zagrebu, uz povremene terenske obilaske i neradne vikende. Uz osnovna primanja nudimo i dodatke na plaću u skladu s ostvarenim rezultatima, božićnicu, uskrsnicu i potporu za godišnji odmor. MJESTO RADA Zagreb – ured PRONING DHI Povremeni terenski obilasci prema potrebama projekata. Vrsta zaposlenja: rad na određeno vrijeme, uz mogućnost stalnog zaposlenja nakon isteka probnog perioda. ZAINTRIGIRALO VAS JE? Ako želite svoje znanje iz građevinarstva i hidrotehnike usmjeriti prema složenim projektima, suvremenim tehnologijama i stručnom razvoju, pošaljite nam svoj životopis. Prijava treba sadržavati:
  • CV / životopis s kontakt podacima
  • motivacijsko pismo.
Prijave se šalju na: info@proning-dhi.hr PRONING DHI d.o.o. Otona Kučere 5, 10000 Zagreb www.proning-dhi.hr

title: PROJEKTANT/PROJEKTANTICA
description:
PROJEKTANT (m/ž)

Za rad u projektantskom uredu tražimo motiviranu i odgovornu osobu za radno mjesto Projektant (m/ž).

Opis posla

Projektant sudjeluje u izradi arhitektonskih i građevinskih projekata kroz različite faze projektiranja, u suradnji s glavnim projektantom i ostalim članovima projektnog tima.

Glavne odgovornosti uključuju:

  • sudjelovanje u izradi idejnih, glavnih i izvedbenih projekata

  • izradu i razradu arhitektonske i građevinske projektne dokumentacije

  • izradu tehničkih nacrta, detalja i grafičkih priloga

  • sudjelovanje u razvoju projektnih rješenja

  • usklađivanje projektne dokumentacije s ostalim strukama

  • pripremu dokumentacije za ishođenje potrebnih dozvola i suglasnosti

  • komunikaciju i koordinaciju s kolegama, suradnicima i ostalim sudionicima u projektu

  • praćenje projekta i izvršavanje zadataka prema dogovorenim rokovima

  • sudjelovanje u obilascima lokacija i gradilišta prema potrebi

Uvjeti i očekivanja

Od kandidata očekujemo:

  • završeno odgovarajuće obrazovanje iz područja arhitekture, graditeljstva ili srodnog tehničkog područja

  • poznavanje rada u relevantnim programima za projektiranje i izradu tehničke dokumentacije

  • preciznost, odgovornost i organiziranost

  • sposobnost timskog rada i kvalitetne komunikacije

  • samostalnost u izvršavanju povjerenih zadataka u skladu s razinom iskustva

  • spremnost na učenje i profesionalni razvoj

Radno iskustvo na sličnim poslovima je prednost, ali razmotrit ćemo i kandidate s manje iskustva koji pokazuju znanje, motivaciju i želju za učenjem.

Mjesto i način rada

Rad se obavlja na licu mjesta, u prostorijama projektantskog ureda.

Tražimo osobu koja će biti svakodnevno prisutna u uredu i aktivno sudjelovati u radu projektnog tima. Ovo radno mjesto nije predviđeno za rad na daljinu (remote) niti isključivo online suradnju.

Što nudimo

  • rad na raznovrsnim arhitektonskim i projektantskim zadacima

  • rad u profesionalnom i suradničkom okruženju

  • mogućnost učenja i razvoja stručnih znanja

  • sudjelovanje u svim fazama razvoja projekta

  • stabilnu i dugoročnu suradnju

  • mogućnost profesionalnog napredovanja u skladu sa znanjem, iskustvom i rezultatima

Ako ste zainteresirani za rad u projektantskom uredu i želite biti dio tima koji zajednički razvija i realizira projekte, pozivamo vas da nam pošaljete svoj životopis i, ako je primjenjivo, portfolio dosadašnjih radova.

Prednost je iskustvo na servisiranju ili remontu hidrauličnih nadogradnji, radnih strojeva, građevinske ili komunalne mehanizacije, teretnih vozila ili drugih hidrauličnih sustava. Poslodavac nudi:
  • radno vrijeme od ponedjeljka do petka, 7:00 – 15:00 sati
  • slobodne vikende
  • kolektivni ljetni i zimski godišnji odmor
  • redovita primanja
  • stabilno zaposlenje
  • raznovrstan posao – od servisa i dijagnostike do složenijih popravaka i remonta
  • rad u radionici opremljenoj za servisiranje i remont
  • mogućnost dodatnog stručnog usavršavanja
  • radno mjesto u Osijeku

title: DISPONENT (DISPEČER) M/Ž
description:
Tražimo disponenta za organizaciju međunarodnog cestovnog prijevoza. Radno mjesto je u uredu i nije predviđena mogućnost rada od kuće / remote rada. Disponent je odgovoran za svakodnevnu organizaciju i praćenje rada kamiona – od pronalaska utovara i dogovaranja prijevoza do praćenja isporuke. Opis posla
  • pronalazak utovara i prijevoznih naloga putem platforme TIMOCOM
  • komunikacija i dogovaranje prijevoza s klijentima i poslovnim partnerima
  • organizacija i planiranje ruta
  • svakodnevna komunikacija s vozačima
  • komunikacija s utovarnim i istovarnim mjestima
  • praćenje kamiona putem navigacijskog sustava
  • praćenje termina utovara i istovara
  • rješavanje svakodnevnih situacija i problema tijekom prijevoza
  • kontrola i praćenje transportne dokumentacije Što očekujemo? Prednost imaju kandidati s prethodnim iskustvom u disponiranju, logistici, transportu ili špediciji. Obavezno je:
  • aktivno znanje engleskog jezika
  • dobro poznavanje rada na računalu
  • dobro snalaženje s digitalnim alatima, programima i tehnologijom
  • organiziranost, odgovornost i komunikativnost
  • sposobnost brzog reagiranja i rješavanja problema
  • Znanje talijanskog jezika je prednost. Što nudimo?
  • mogućnost dugoročnog zaposlenja
  • stjecanje konkretnog praktičnog iskustva u međunarodnom cestovnom transportu
  • učenje organizacije prijevoza, rada s burzama tereta, planiranja ruta i svakodnevne koordinacije vozila
  • upoznavanje s cjelokupnim procesom transporta – od pronalaska naloga do završetka isporuke
  • mogućnost da s vremenom samostalno organizirate i vodite dodijeljena vozila Ako imate iskustva u logistici ili transportu i odgovara vam dinamičan uredski posao, veselimo se vašoj prijavi.

title: KONOBAR M/Ž
description:
Café Allegri - ZADAR - Hey park

Posjedujemo ugostiteljske objekte diljem Hrvatske, a koji su pozicionirani u sklopu supermarketa i radnim vremenom prilagođeni istima, te su ugodno i toplo uređeni. Velika pozornost pridaje se kvaliteti usluge i stručnosti osoblja s naglaskom na srdačnost! Visoku razinu kvalitete održavamo kontinuiranim ulaganjem u naše djelatnike, prostor i ponudu, što nam se višestruko vraća kroz zadovoljne djelatnike i stalne goste. Ukoliko i Vi želite postati dio našeg tima od 150 zadovoljnih djelatnika, javite se na naš natječaj! Ako i nemate radnog iskustva te bi Vam ovo bilo prvo zaposlenje, rado ćemo Vas uzeti u obzir kao potencijalnog kandidata, te Vam pomoći u stjecanju iskustva i usvajanju novih znanja i vještina! Za dodatne informacije o našoj ponudi i uvjetima rada možete se javiti na broj 099/ 3224342 ili posao@celka.hr. Naš tim proširujemo osobom koja ima želju za učenjem i kontinuiranim usavršavanjem na radnom mjestu: Ugostiteljski djelatnik (m/ž) Što ćete raditi? - posluživati goste sukladno propisanim pravilima i standardima - održavati čistoću i urednost radnog prostora i opreme - osiguravati primjenu propisanih i zadanih standarda u ugostiteljstvu - predstavljati organizaciju u najboljem svjetlu te izgrađivati prijateljske odnose sa gostima i kolegama Što nudimo? - stimulativne uvjete - rad u uspješnoj i stabilnoj tvrtki - dinamičnu i ugodnu radnu atmosferu - izvrsne kolege i međuljudske odnose

title: KOMERCIJALIST / ADMINISTRATOR U MEĐUNARODNOM TRANSPORTU M/Ž
description:
Tražimo komercijalista za rad u prijevozničkoj tvrtki koja se bavi međunarodnim cestovnim prijevozom robe. Radno mjesto je u uredu i nije predviđena mogućnost rada od kuće / remote rada. Osoba na ovom radnom mjestu bit će uključena u svakodnevne komercijalne i administrativne poslove povezane s transportom, vozačima, vozilima, klijentima i poslovnom dokumentacijom. Ključni zadaci i odgovornosti
  • izdavanje i praćenje računa u programu Minimax
  • praćenje uplata i naplata potraživanja
  • priprema naloga za plaćanje i praćenje obveza prema dobavljačima
  • zaprimanje, kontrola i evidencija transportne dokumentacije
  • vođenje i praćenje dokumentacije vezane uz vozila i vozače – dozvole, potvrde, registracije i ostala potrebna dokumentacija
  • komunikacija s klijentima, dobavljačima i poslovnim partnerima telefonskim i elektroničkim putem
  • komunikacija i koordinacija s bankama, Poreznom upravom i drugim državnim institucijama
Uvjeti koje tražimo
  • aktivno znanje engleskog jezika
  • dobro poznavanje rada na računalu i snalaženje u poslovnim programima i digitalnim alatima
  • dobre organizacijske sposobnosti i pozornost na detalje
  • odgovornost, samostalnost i pouzdanost u radu
  • dobre komunikacijske vještine
  • spremnost na učenje i rad s različitim vrstama poslovne dokumentacije
Prethodno iskustvo na sličnim poslovima, posebno u transportu, logistici, administraciji, računovodstvu ili komercijali, predstavlja prednost. Što nudimo?
  • mogućnost dugoročnog zaposlenja
  • stjecanje praktičnog iskustva u poslovanju međunarodne prijevozničke tvrtke
  • upoznavanje s procesima vezanim uz transport, fakturiranje, naplatu, dokumentaciju vozila i vozača te komunikaciju s klijentima i institucijama
  • mogućnost stjecanja širokog praktičnog znanja iz različitih područja poslovanja
Tražimo osobu koja je organizirana, odgovorna i dobro se snalazi s dokumentacijom, ljudima i računalom te želi naučiti kako funkcionira svakodnevno poslovanje međunarodne prijevozničke tvrtke. Ako se prepoznajete u navedenom, veselimo se vašoj prijavi.

title: RADNIK / RADNICA NA ODRŽAVANJU
description:
OPIS POSLOVA
  • Popravak i održavanje strojnog parka
  • Cjelokupno planiranje i organizacija mehaničkog i električnog održavanja u skladu s planiranjem proizvodnje
  • Sustavno rješavanje problema i analiza uzroka kvara
  • Tehničko pojašnjenje sa proizvođačem
  • Osnovno znanje upravljanja strojevima (Servisne funkcije)
  • Poboljšanja i optimizacija izravno u toku popravka
Dokumentiranje popravka:
  • Provođenje popravka
  • Preuzimanje, dokumentiranje i dovršavanje popravka sukladno specifikacijama
  • Pretraživanje, traženje ponude i naručivanje rezervnih dijelova
Alat, uređaji:
  • Ispravno rukovanje sa mjernim instrumentima koji su potrebni za održavanje
  • Tumačenje izmjerenih vrijednosti i poduzimanje odgovarajućih mjera
  • Odgovarajuće rukovanje posebnim alatima
Radno okruženje
  • Radno mjesto (odjel) i radni stroj (potrebno održavati čistoću radnog mjesta kao i radnog stroja i njegovog okruženja)
Preventivni remont
  • stalna optimizacija procesa radi optimizacije dostupnosti stroja
Kontinuirani proces poboljšanja:
  • Aktivno sudjelovanje na kontinuiranom procesu poboljšanja
NUDIMO - raznolikost i dinamičnost u radu - suradnja sa uigranim timom radnika i rad na zanimljivim projektima - mogućnost profesionalnog i osobnog razvoja i daljnjeg napredovanja unutar poduzeća - prijava na puno radno vrijeme - putni troškovi plaćeni u cijelosti - ostali neoporezivi dodaci na plaću - mogućnost stalnog zaposlenja. UVJETI
  • Visoka razina posvećenosti radu, inicijativa i fleksibilnost
  • Posvećenost sigurnosti na radu i zaštiti okoliša
  • Osvještenost troškovima, orijentiranost na poboljšanje
  • Visoka razina odgovornosti prema radu
  • Samostalnost u radu
  • Spremnost na timski rad
  • Spremnost na daljnje školovanje

title: VODITELJ/ICA PRODAJNOG PODRUČJA - AREA MANAGER
description:
ZIEGLER je proizvođač vatrogasnih vozila i opreme s tradicijom duljom od 130 godina. ZIEGLER Grupa zapošljava više od 1.200 djelatnika diljem svijeta, posluje na 9 proizvodnih lokacija te godišnje proizvede više od 900 vozila. Dio je velike globalne grupacije CIMC, vodećeg svjetskog dobavljača logističke i energetske opreme. ZIEGLER d.o.o. posluje u Hrvatskoj od 2000. godine te djeluje na dvije proizvodne lokacije – u Zagrebu i Kutini. Zbog razvoja našeg tima i daljnjeg širenja prisutnosti na tržištu tražimo: VODITELJA/ICU PRODAJNOG PODRUČJA – 1 izvršitelj – Mjesto rada: Zagreb ili Kutina Idealan kandidat:

  • VŠS ili VSS ekonomskog, poslovnog, tehničkog ili srodnog usmjerenja
  • Najmanje 1 godina iskustva u prodaji, razvoju poslovanja ili upravljanju ključnim kupcima
  • Izražene komunikacijske, pregovaračke i interpersonalne vještine
  • Dokazan pristup usmjeren na kupca, uz fokus na ostvarivanje prodajnih ciljeva i poslovnih rezultata
  • Aktivno znanje engleskog jezika u govoru i pismu (minimalno B2 razina)
  • Organizirana, proaktivna i rezultatski usmjerena osoba
  • Spremnost na putovanja unutar dodijeljene regije
  • Interes za automobilsku i vatrogasnu industriju
Prednost imaju kandidati koji imaju:
  • Iskustvo u prodaji u automobilskoj, vatrogasnoj ili srodnoj industriji
  • Poznavanje postupaka javne nabave i natječajne dokumentacije
  • Iskustvo rada u ERP sustavima
  • Poznavanje dodatnih regionalnih jezika
Opis poslova:
  • Razvijanje i održavanje poslovnih odnosa s postojećim i potencijalnim kupcima na dodijeljenom području
  • Prepoznavanje novih poslovnih prilika i aktivno širenje tržišne prisutnosti tvrtke
  • Upravljanje cjelokupnim prodajnim procesom – od prvog kontakta s kupcem do sklapanja ugovora
  • Izrada komercijalnih ponuda, ponuda za natječaje i druge dokumentacije u suradnji s internim odjelima
  • Sudjelovanje u postupcima javne nabave te koordinacija pripreme natječajnih ponuda
  • Posjeti kupcima, održavanje prezentacija, demonstracija proizvoda i vođenje pregovora
  • Praćenje tržišnih trendova, aktivnosti konkurencije i potreba kupaca te redovito izvještavanje uprave
  • Ostvarivanje dogovorenih prodajnih ciljeva i doprinos rastu poslovanja tvrtke
  • Izrada prodajnih izvještaja, prognoza i ostale povezane dokumentacije
  • Predstavljanje tvrtke na stručnim događanjima, sajmovima i konferencijama
Nudimo:
  • Rad u dinamičnom međunarodnom okruženju
  • Priliku za rad u rastućoj industriji
  • Profesionalni razvoj uz podršku iskusnog tima
  • Ugovor o radu na određeno vrijeme uz mogućnost zaposlenja na neodređeno vrijeme

Ako ste zainteresirani za ovu poziciju, pošaljite svoj životopis i motivacijsko pismo na e-mail posao@ziegler.hr ili ih dostavite osobno u Odjel ljudskih resursa najkasnije do 22.10.2026. ZIEGLER is a manufacturer of firefighting vehicles and equipment with a tradition of over 130 years. The ZIEGLER Group employs more than 1,200 people worldwide, operates at 9 production locations, and produces over 900 vehicles annually. It is part of the large global CIMC group, a leading world supplier of logistics and energy equipment. ZIEGLER d.o.o. has been operating in Croatia since 2000, with two production locations – in Zagreb and Kutina. Due to the growth of our team and further expansion of our market presence, we are looking for: AREA MANAGER - 1 position - Work location: Zagreb or Kutina

Ideal candidate:

  • University or higher vocational degree in Economics, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field (VŠS/VSS)
  • Minimum 1 year of experience in sales, business development, or account management
  • Strong communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills
  • Proven customer-oriented approach with a focus on achieving sales targets and business objectives
  • Fluency in English, both written and spoken (minimum B2 level)
  • Highly organized, proactive, and results-driven
  • Willingness to travel within the assigned region
  • Strong interest in the automotive and firefighting industries

Advantage:

  • Experience in Sales in the automotive, firefighting or related industry
  • Knowledge of public procurement and tender procedures
  • Experience working with ERP systems
  • Knowledge of additional regional languages

Job description:

  • Developing and maintaining business relationships with existing and potential customers within the assigned territory
  • Identifying new business opportunities and actively expanding the company's market presence
  • Managing the complete sales process, from initial customer contact to contract signing
  • Preparing commercial offers, quotations, and tender documentation in cooperation with internal departments
  • Participating in public procurement procedures and coordinating the preparation of bids
  • Conducting customer visits, presentations, product demonstrations, and negotiations
  • Monitoring market trends, competitor activities, and customer needs, and providing regular feedback to management
  • Achieving agreed sales targets and contributing to the company's growth objectives
  • Preparing sales reports, forecasts, and other related documentation
  • Representing the company at industry events, trade fairs, and professional conferences

We offer:

  • Work in dynamic international environment
  • Opportunity to work in a growing industry
  • Professional development within an experienced team
  • Fixed-term employment contract with possibility to extend to permanent duration

If you are interested in this position, please send your CV and Cover letter via e-mail to posao@ziegler.hr or submit to HR in person until 22.10.2026.
