title: COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2) (Kapitän/in)
description:
The MV Louise Michel is a former French Navy boat we’ve customized to perform search and rescue. Measuring 30 meters in length and capable of up to 28 knots, she was bought with proceeds from the sale of Banksy artwork - who then decorated her with a fire extinguisher. She is operated and crewed by a team of international activist rescue professionals.

- Main responsibilities: handling the ship, overview, control of the vessel and crew safety
- You have the final responsibility for all nautical and technical decisions concerning the operation as well as related crew intructions
- responsible for the ship’s administration (bunkering, crew-lists, customs clearance, detailed operational documentation, daily reports and statistics).
- shiphandling in harbour and during SAR-operations. Together with the officers you will familiarise the crew on the bridge and introduce them to the watch system.
- You will provide the crew with trainings and drills in emergency situations (e.g. what to do in case of fire, POB, ingress of water, unwanted visitors).
- You will work closely with the Head of operations during SAR operations, double checking all decisions against crew and ship safety as well as stability (and guest safety in case of guest already on board).
- You will work closely with the officers and chief engineer

Required:

-EC/EEA-Citizen Passport valid for at least 6 months

-Covid certificate with EU QR code needed, latest vaccine or recovery certificate no older than 180 days or a booster (other nationalities can be transferred to EU certificate)

-Seafarer Medical Certificate (fitness for sea service) according STCW I/9 (Deck Service)

-Proficiency in basic safety (STCW VI/1)

-Proficiency in survival craft and rescue boats other than fast rescue boats (STCW VI/2-1)

-Proficiency in Advanced fire fighting (STCW VI/3)

-Medical First Aid (STCW VI/4-1)

-Medical Care (STCW VI/4-2)

-GMDSS Radio Operator GOC (STCW IV/2)

-COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2)

-German Endorsement for COC Master Course

-Seafarer's book or the German Seafarer's ID Card

-Excellent and fluent English language skills

-Confidence in decision-making, strong team leading skills, and the ability to cooperate well within a team of volunteers with various levels of nautical experience and skill.

Desired:

- Previous SAR experience
- Italian, French and Arabic language skills

title: SSAB - Technical Development Manager Italy
description:
Your qualifications
•    Master’s degree in Mechanical engineering, Metallurgy or Mining
•    Fluent Italian and English written and spoken, German is a merit
•    Experience from the steel industry is a merit
•    Analytical skills
We are currently looking for a Technical Development Manager to SSAB Special Steels in Italy.

About the position
SSAB is a highly-specialized global steel company driven by close customer relationships. SSAB Develops high-strength steels and provides services for better perfomance and sustainability. The company is a leading producer on the global market for Advanced High-Strength Steels (AHSS) and Quenched & Tempered Steel (Q&T), strip, plate and tubular products, as well as construction solutions.
As Technical Development Manager, you are playing an important role of supporting SSAB’s customers with your technical competence and support in order to build customer value and profitability. The role also includes close collaboration with Tech support, product development, production and quality. Your geographical business area will be Italy, Greece and Switzerland. You will be traveling approximately 3-4 days a week to meet customers and also to visit SSAB’s mill in Oxelösund, Sweden.

Application
Send your application no later than 24th of September 2018

In this recruitment we collaborate with Hudson.

For more information, please contact
Fredrik Ålund, Researcher, 076-631 94 44

We decline contacts from recruitment agencies and ad sellers regarding this advertisement.
SSAB is a Nordic and US-based steel company. SSAB offers value added products and services developed in close cooperation with its customers to create a stronger, lighter and more sustainable world. SSAB has employees in over 50 countries. SSAB has production facilities in Sweden, Finland and the US. SSAB is listed on the NASDAQ OMX Nordic Exchange in Stockholm and has a secondary listing on the NASDAQ OMX in Helsinki. www.ssab.com

title: Mystery Shopper in Latvia
description:
Mystery Shopper in Latvia

Work tasks: WHAT OUR MYSTERY SHOPPERS DO
Mystery shoppers do not need to be customer service experts, as their personal opinion is not the deciding factor. However, they must be able to assess customer interactions and the service process objectively. We measure how closely employees’ customer service aligns with their company’s service standards and expectations, enabling businesses to identify development needs and provide targeted training. At the same time, we are confident that our mystery shoppers gradually become customer service professionals themselves. We believe this experience increases their value in the job market, especially in customer-facing roles, as we continuously train and guide our mystery shoppers. Our mystery shoppers are welcome to include “Trendline Mystery Shopper” on their CV. For many employers, this demonstrates a solid understanding of customer service processes. WHAT A TRENDLINE MYSTERY SHOPPER DOES NOT DO Trendline mystery shoppers do not provoke or deliberately challenge employees with difficult or misleading questions. Our mystery shoppers visit service providers, banks, retail stores, and sales organizations. The objective is for the mystery shopper to behave like an ordinary customer. This means they do not ask unusual questions that a typical customer would not ask and do not attempt to provoke employees in any way. Mystery shopping visits are conducted according to scenarios provided by Trendline. After each visit, the mystery shopper submits a detailed report through the Trendline online platform.

We offer: https://trendline.lt
Over 25 years of experience in developing customer service and sales organizations. We operate in Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania. Our services include: mystery shopping, training, customer satisfaction surveys and feedback questionnaires, development of customer service standards, production of training videos, and internal audit tools for managers. We provide our clients with a comprehensive solution—from defining customer service standards and principles to employee training and measuring implementation and performance.

Other requirements: WHAT QUALITIES WE LOOK FOR A mystery shopper should be responsible, friendly, honest,
reliable, and willing to follow instructions carefully while maintaining a professional approach. Before applying for assignments, our mystery shoppers can review the available projects, including the scenario, evaluation questionnaire, job description, and compensation. Once an assignment is confirmed, they are free to complete the mystery shopping visit at any convenient time within the specified timeframe. After completing the visit, the mystery shopper submits a concise evaluation report through the mystery shopper module of our online platform. Our mystery shoppers always have access to our dedicated Mystery Shopper Support Service, which provides ongoing assistance to help them complete assignments to a high standard. Upon request, we also offer additional training, as well as technical and practical support. With more than 25 years of experience in training and customer service development, Trendline knows how to focus on what matters most and provides high-quality training for all mystery shoppers.

Option to work from home: Yes

7.    Žiemą nukasti sniegą nuo takelių, šaligatvių, žaidimų aikštelių, įėjimų į pastatą, barstyti takelius smėliu.
8.    Kasdien apžiūrėti inventorių; esant gedimams – remontuoti savo jėgomis arba informuoti pavaduotoją ūkio reikalams.
9.    Perdažyti lauko įrenginius, atlikti smulkų jų remontą.
Kiemsargio atsakomybė: už mokyklos teritorijos priežiūrą ir tvarką; už sanitarinių higieninių reikalavimų vykdymą; už saugos darbe ir priešgaisrinės saugos reikalavimų laikymąsi; Už patikėtos technikos, įrankių ir inventoriaus saugumą, tinkamą naudojimą bei priežiūrą; už kuro ir eksploatacinių medžiagų racionalų naudojimą; už aukščiau išvardintų pareigų vykdymą.
Kiemsargis privalo: vykdyti mokyklos direktoriaus, pavaduotojo ūkiui arba įgaliotų asmenų su darbu susijusius nurodymus. Mokėti saugiai dirbti ir netrukdyti saugiai dirbti kitiems. Laiku tikrintis sveikatą. Laikytis įstaigos vidaus tvarkos taisyklių, darbe nevartoti alkoholinių gėrimų bei narkotinių medžiagų. Laikytis įrenginių naudojimo instrukcijų reikalavimų, asmens higienos reikalavimų.

title: Mystery Shopper in Lithuania
description:
Mystery Shopper in Lithuania

Work tasks: WHAT OUR MYSTERY SHOPPERS DO
Mystery shoppers do not need to be customer service experts, as their personal opinion is not the deciding factor. However, they must be able to assess customer interactions and the service process objectively. We measure how closely employees’ customer service aligns with their company’s service standards and expectations, enabling businesses to identify development needs and provide targeted training. At the same time, we are confident that our mystery shoppers gradually become customer service professionals themselves. We believe this experience increases their value in the job market, especially in customer-facing roles, as we continuously train and guide our mystery shoppers. Our mystery shoppers are welcome to include “Trendline Mystery Shopper” on their CV. For many employers, this demonstrates a solid understanding of customer service processes. WHAT A TRENDLINE MYSTERY SHOPPER DOES NOT DO Trendline mystery shoppers do not provoke or deliberately challenge employees with difficult or misleading questions. Our mystery shoppers visit service providers, banks, retail stores, and sales organizations. The objective is for the mystery shopper to behave like an ordinary customer. This means they do not ask unusual questions that a typical customer would not ask and do not attempt to provoke employees in any way. Mystery shopping visits are conducted according to scenarios provided by Trendline. After each visit, the mystery shopper submits a detailed report through the Trendline online platform.

We offer: https://trendline.lt
Over 25 years of experience in developing customer service and sales organizations. We operate in Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania. Our services include: mystery shopping, training, customer satisfaction surveys and feedback questionnaires, development of customer service standards, production of training videos, and internal audit tools for managers. We provide our clients with a comprehensive solution—from defining customer service standards and principles to employee training and measuring implementation and performance.

Other requirements: WHAT QUALITIES WE LOOK FOR
A mystery shopper should be responsible, friendly, honest, reliable, and willing to follow instructions carefully while maintaining a professional approach. Before applying for assignments, our mystery shoppers can review the available projects, including the scenario, evaluation questionnaire, job description, and compensation. Once an assignment is confirmed, they are free to complete the mystery shopping visit at any convenient time within the specified timeframe. After completing the visit, the mystery shopper submits a concise evaluation report through the mystery shopper module of our online platform. Our mystery shoppers always have access to our dedicated Mystery Shopper Support Service, which provides ongoing assistance to help them complete assignments to a high standard. Upon request, we also offer additional training, as well as technical and practical support. With more than 25 years of experience in training and customer service development, Trendline knows how to focus on what matters most and provides high-quality training for all mystery shoppers.

Option to work from home: Yes

title: Mystery Shopper in Lithuania
description:
Mystery Shopper in Lithuania

Work tasks: WHAT OUR MYSTERY SHOPPERS DO
Mystery shoppers do not need to be customer service experts, as their personal opinion is not the deciding factor. However, they must be able to assess customer interactions and the service process objectively. We measure how closely employees’ customer service aligns with their company’s service standards and expectations, enabling businesses to identify development needs and provide targeted training. At the same time, we are confident that our mystery shoppers gradually become customer service professionals themselves. We believe this experience increases their value in the job market, especially in customer-facing roles, as we continuously train and guide our mystery shoppers. Our mystery shoppers are welcome to include “Trendline Mystery Shopper” on their CV. For many employers, this demonstrates a solid understanding of customer service processes. WHAT A TRENDLINE MYSTERY SHOPPER DOES NOT DO Trendline mystery shoppers do not provoke or deliberately challenge employees with difficult or misleading questions. Our mystery shoppers visit service providers, banks, retail stores, and sales organizations. The objective is for the mystery shopper to behave like an ordinary customer. This means they do not ask unusual questions that a typical customer would not ask and do not attempt to provoke employees in any way. Mystery shopping visits are conducted according to scenarios provided by Trendline. After each visit, the mystery shopper submits a detailed report through the Trendline online platform.

We offer: https://trendline.lt
Over 25 years of experience in developing customer service and sales organizations. We operate in Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania. Our services include: mystery shopping, training, customer satisfaction surveys and feedback questionnaires, development of customer service standards, production of training videos, and internal audit tools for managers. We provide our clients with a comprehensive solution—from defining customer service standards and principles to employee training and measuring implementation and performance.

Other requirements: WHAT QUALITIES WE LOOK FOR
A mystery shopper should be responsible, friendly, honest, reliable, and willing to follow instructions carefully while maintaining a professional approach. Before applying for assignments, our mystery shoppers can review the available projects, including the scenario, evaluation questionnaire, job description, and compensation. Once an assignment is confirmed, they are free to complete the mystery shopping visit at any convenient time within the specified timeframe. After completing the visit, the mystery shopper submits a concise evaluation report through the mystery shopper module of our online platform. Our mystery shoppers always have access to our dedicated Mystery Shopper Support Service, which provides ongoing assistance to help them complete assignments to a high standard. Upon request, we also offer additional training, as well as technical and practical support. With more than 25 years of experience in training and customer service development, Trendline knows how to focus on what matters most and provides high-quality training for all mystery shoppers.

Option to work from home: Yes

title: Information Security Officer (m/f)
description:
Information Security Officer
Information Security - Findel, Grand Duchy of Luxembourg

About Utmost International
Utmost International is a leading provider of insurance-based wealth solutions operating across the UK, Europe, Latin America, Asia, and the Middle East. Its solutions are largely based on unit-linked insurance policies, serving the needs of affluent, high net worth (HNW), and ultra-high net worth (UHNW) individuals.

About Utmost Luxembourg S.A.

Sitting at the crossroads of private banking, asset management, and insurance, we operate in a well-established and fast-growing division of the financial services industry. Our dynamic international team of 450+ experienced wealth structuring specialists, subject-matter and technical experts consists of 50 different nationalities, speaking over 30 languages.

We are a diverse and inclusive organisation driven by a values-based culture that promotes excellence, ambition, and innovation. We invest in talented teams who develop their expertise, curated through support and training, and fostered through a people centred culture. Our people truly are our greatest asset!

Your role - Are you ready for a challenge?

The Information Security Officer is responsible for the day-to-day infosec tasks, including in relation to risk management, infosec governance, internal and external audit support, access management and monitoring and reporting of infosec events and incidents.

This role is part of our Information Security Department and will be reporting to an Information Security Manager.

Your responsibilities will be as follows:

• Undertake internal security assessments and facilitate the creation of action plans with key business units;
• Perform information security operational tasks and day to day follow up of actions with the overall objective of ensuring the operational effectiveness of existing security controls, improve the overall control environment and reduce risk exposure;
• Assist with the review and maintenance of existing Information Security controls and the design of new ones in line with evolving business, security or legal/regulatory requirements;
• Actively follow-up access rights entitlement reviews and request validations;
• Develop and maintain relationships with business units, to emphasise and promote the importance of Information security, risk and governance management;
• Work with internal and external auditors in relation to information security audits;
• Conduct risk assessment activities and execute risk treatment plans;
• Analyse and support the remediation of information security incidents;

Your profile - Have you got what it takes to become our Information Security Officer?

• Studies or initial experience in a combination of risk management, information security, and IT roles;
• At least 4-5 years of experience in Information Security or IT Security;
• Technical background in the field of security technologies and architectures;
• Knowledge of technological trends and developments in the area of IT and Information Security;
• Good communicator, ownership, problem-solving, solution oriented, service oriented, ability to adapt to a fast-paced environment, team work;
• Understanding of risk assessment and audit processes and techniques, specifically within the domain of financial information security;
• Basic knowledge of network and application security, as well as authentication, identity management and penetration testing technologies;
• Experience with DLP, NAC, SIEM, PAM and intrusion detection software;
• Understanding of advanced security protocols and standards;
• Understanding of software and security architectures and principles of secure network design;
• Have good understanding of anti-virus software, firewalls and similar products;
• Knowledge of generic software development lifecycle processes;
• Fluent English is a must. Any other European language would be considered as an asset.
• Professional certification, such as a CISSP, CISM, CISA or other information security credentials, is an asset;
• Working knowledge of security and control frameworks, such as ISO 27001, CobiT, COSO and ITIL.

As an equal opportunity employer, all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, colour, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Given the sensitive nature of our business, industry sector and the role as described, the selected candidate is required to provide a criminal record (Bulletin n°3 for Luxembourgish residents). This excerpt will be kept by Utmost Luxembourg S.A. in compliance with article 8-5 (2) of the law of 23 July 2016 and for no longer than one month from the conclusion of the employment contract; otherwise, it will be destroyed without any undue delay should the candidate not be hired.

Utmost Luxembourg S.A. is aware of its obligations under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and is committed to processing your data securely and transparently.

Our Recruitment Privacy Notice is in line with GDPR and provides more information with regards to the types of data that we collect and hold on you as a job applicant, including for the performance of Background Checks.  It also sets out how we use that information, how long we keep it for and other relevant information about your data. Das bringen Sie mit

- Kommunikation: Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse, interkulturelle Kompetenz sowie Bereitschaft, rund 30 % der Tätigkeit vor Ort in Luxemburg zu arbeiten

title: Assistant Manager – Fund Accounting (m/f)
description:
Assistant Manager – Fund Accounting

Role Overview

Within the Fund Administration department, the Assistant Manager is responsible for overseeing a portfolio of complex and high‑profile fund structures, ensuring high‑quality service delivery, regulatory compliance, and timely reporting.

The role combines technical expertise, team leadership, and client ownership. The Assistant Manager acts as a key escalation point for both clients and internal teams and supports the Manager in driving operational excellence, risk management, and process improvement.

Tasks

Client & Delivery Ownership

• Act as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of sophisticated clients (Private Equity, Private Debt, Evergreen structures, Hybrid structures, Open-ended structures).
• Assume end‑to‑end responsibility for service delivery, ensuring compliance with SLAs, fund documentation, and regulatory requirements.
• Manage client expectations proactively and handle escalations independently before involving the Manager where required.
Build and maintain trusted, long‑term client relationships, participating in client meetings, onboarding calls, and post‑audit reviews.

Onboarding

During client onboarding, the Assistant Manager undertakes several crucial tasks to ensure a smooth transition and establish a productive relationship with the new client. Hereunder are some key responsibilities:

• Lead or actively support client onboardings, restructurings, migrations, and system set‑ups.
• Validate fund structures, valuation methodologies, fee models, and reporting frameworks in line with legal documents.
• Coordinate across internal teams (FA, TA, back office, Corporate, AIFM, Risk & Compliance, IT etc) to ensure seamless implementation.
• Review and sign‑off data migration and initial NAVs.

NAV Oversight & Technical Review

During Net Asset Value (NAV) oversight, the Assistant Manager play a critical role in ensuring accuracy, compliance, and smooth operations. Hereunder are some key responsibilities:

• Assume overall accountability for the NAV oversight framework across the assigned client portfolio, ensuring accuracy, consistency, timeliness, and compliance with fund documentation, accounting standards, and regulatory requirements.
• Oversee the end‑to‑end NAV production cycle, including capital activity, income recognition, valuation inputs, investor allocations, and fee calculations.
• Perform in‑depth technical reviews and approvals of complex NAVs, including:

o Private equity, private debt, evergreen funds, and multi‑compartment structures
o Complex instruments (loans, profit‑participating notes, derivatives, look‑through investments)
o FX treatments, waterfalls, and performance fee mechanisms
• Act as a technical reference point on Lux GAAP, IFRS, consolidation and structure‑specific treatments.

• Ensure all NAV‑related deliverables meet agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and internal quality standards.
• Maintain strong documentation standards, including working papers, reconciliation files, and management review evidence, to support both internal controls and external audit requirements.
• Support the preparation of financial statements inputs by ensuring consistency between NAVs, accounting records, and statutory reporting.

Risk Management, Controls & Audit

• Act as a key control owner for the assigned client portfolio, ensuring that fund accounting activities are performed in line with internal policies, ISAE requirements, regulatory obligations, and client documentation.
• Ensure that appropriate preventive and detective controls are in place, operating effectively, and evidenced.
• Review and challenge unusual transactions, valuation judgments, late data, or deviations from standard processes.
• Act as the primary escalation point for NAV issues, breaches, or errors, ensuring timely resolution, root‑cause analysis, and clear documentation.
• Act as the primary liaison for external auditors, managing audit queries and timelines.
• Support the Manager in maintaining a strong control culture across the team and client portfolio.

Team Leadership & People Management

• Provide day‑to‑day supervision of Senior Fund Accountants and Fund Accountants within the team.
• Allocate work effectively, taking into account complexity, risk and deadlines.
• Review deliverables prepared by the team and provide structured feedback.
• Support training, development, and performance management of team members.
• Promote a culture of accountability, ownership, collaboration, and quality.
• Escalate capacity, performance, or quality concerns to the Manager with proposed solutions.

Process Improvement & Operational Excellence

• Continuously assess existing fund accounting and reporting processes to identify inefficiencies, risks, and improvement opportunities.
• Actively contribute to system enhancements, automation, and standardisation.
• Support the Manager in implementing new operating models, tools, and best practices.
• Encourage a culture of continuous improvement and risk awareness

Required Experience / Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or Economics
• ACCA (or equivalent) – qualified or advanced stage preferred
• Strong knowledge of Lux GAAP and IFRS (including consolidation)
• 8+ years of experience in fund administration, primarily for closed-ended funds, open-ended funds and evergreen/hybrid funds, with experience in various asset classes (private equity, private debt, listed loans)
• Prior experience reviewing NAVs and supervising team members is essential.
• Experience in capital hedging and portfolio management.
• Added value for candidates familiar with public loans managed through Allvue or WSO platforms.
• Languages: English fluent; French and/or German is an advantage.
• Additional advantage for candidates with experience using Paxus.

Skills/Behavior

In addition to demonstrating IQEQ's Group Values (Authentic, Bold, Collaborative), the Assistant Manager is expected to:

• Take ownership and accountability
• Demonstrate sound judgement and risk awareness
• Lead and develop others
• Communicate clearly with senior stakeholders
• Navigate complexity and ambiguity
• Balance client service with internal control discipline
• Plan, prioritise, and delegate effectively
• Continuously develop technical and leadership skills

The role provides independent assurance on the adequacy and effectiveness of governance, risk management and internal control, while supporting compliance with applicable laws and regulations and contributing to the continuous improvement of LIST's organisation and operations.

In addition to defining the internal audit strategy and the risk-based annual audit plan, you will oversee the full audit lifecycle, from planning and execution to reporting, follow-up and quality assurance. The role also leads specific assurance, advisory and investigation assignments and ensures that Internal Audit methodologies, policies, processes and the Internal Audit Charter remain robust and aligned with professional internal audit standards.

Your team - 3 people

• Internal Audit collaborators - 2 | contribution to assurance, advisory, audit follow-up and continuous improvement activities

The Internal Audit Service operates as an independent function within LIST and coordinates with Risk Management, where relevant, to leverage synergies and avoid duplication of work without prejudice to its independence.
You will report to the Chair of the Board of Directors, or to the Vice-Chair in the event of replacement of the Chair, in accordance with the Internal Audit Charter. For administrative and day-to-day matters, you will report to the CEO.

• Build constructive relationships with key internal and external stakeholders while maintaining the independence and objectivity required of the function

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us
The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.
Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?
As part of the Biotechnology Unit, and particularly the Bioformulation Group, you will contribute to the machine learning assisted structure-function study of soluble dietary fibres (galactomannans) isolated from underexplored leguminous seed bioresources in the framework of the ENTANGLE FNR funded project. You will develop clean label procedures to extract and isolate galactomannans from forage legume seed biomass such as alfalfa and clover. In addition, the successful candidate is expected to determine the technofunctional and prebiotic potential of native and enzymatically modified derivatives benchmarked to commercial biopolymer targets.

As a Postdoctoral Researcher, you will mainly be responsible for:
• Extracting, isolating and purifying galactomannans from forage legume seeds
• Enzymatically tailor the chemical structure and technofunctional profile of native galactomannans
• Determine the structure conformational, technological and prebiotic potential of the native and modified galactomannans and
• Promoting and disseminating your research work through high-quality scientific publications in peer-reviewed journals, oral and poster presentations in conferences, and patents.
If you are specialised in food biopolymers, colloids science, and/or food process engineering, with a strong foundation in soft-matter physics and a focus on understanding and tailoring structure–property–function relationships for innovative food applications, please apply and join our new and dynamic team.

The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The Faculty of Law, Economics and Finance counts over 2,700 students enrolled across four Bachelor programmes, thirteen Master programmes, doctoral studies as well as several continuing education courses. Teaching and research at the FDEF benefit from the proximity of European institutions, Luxembourg's leading international financial centre, as well as its vibrant business community. Institutional and private sector partnerships, sponsored chairs and a growing network of international partner universities make the FDEF a dynamic academic hub at the heart of Europe.

Your role
The successful candidate will strengthen the Department of Law's research area in Banking, Financial and Commercial Law, which is a cornerstone of the Department's academic profile and a key contributor to the University's reputation. They will pursue research and teaching in this field, focussing on Luxembourg, EU, and comparative transnational perspectives. The position is of particular strategic relevance given the Department's ambition to maintain its leadership in financial law, a domain central to Luxembourg's role as a global financial centre.
The ideal candidate shows potential to:
• Develop an internationally recognized research profile in banking law in a broad sense, e.g., prudential regulation and bank supervision, depositary law, regulation of payments and payment systems, financial technologies, sustainable finance, secured transactions and consumer financial contracts, links to financial markets law
• Publish extensively in top-tier peer-reviewed journals, monographs, or authoritative treatises

This position offers the opportunity to gain recognition and respect in Luxembourg's legal community, renowned for its emphasis on financial law expertise and its strong integration of academic insight with professional practice. title: PhD CANDIDATE IN SOCIAL CRITERIA DRIVEN ABSOLUTE ENVIRONMENTAL.... (m/f)

Fixed term contract | Belvaux | 48 months

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

The Environmental Sustainability Assessment and Circularity (SUSTAIN) Unit conducts cross disciplinary research to support the transition toward a more sustainable, resilient, and healthy society. SUSTAIN combines expertise in environmental sciences, circular economy, risk and safety assessment, and sustainable innovation to address complex challenges related to human and environmental health, climate change, and resource efficiency, developing knowledge, methods, and transferable software for the simulation and comprehensive sustainability assessment of socio-economic systems. Its purpose is to foster sustainable eco-innovation, through products and technologies, as well as support sustainability-oriented policy implementation and behavioural change to promote decarbonisation transitions.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

The world faces a convergence of crises that are transforming the conditions for human development. Climate instability, ecosystem degradation, and the overuse of natural resources have reached critical levels, while social inequality, political fragmentation, and technological disruption are reshaping societies. Traditional notions of economic competitiveness, centred on growth and productivity, are being redefined to include social resilience, inclusiveness, and ecological integrity. Responding to this “polycrisis” requires new pathways that reconcile prosperity with planetary and social limits. Luxembourg offers a particularly illustrative example of these tensions. The country enjoys one of the highest income levels globally and a dynamic financial and business environment that sustains its reputation for economic success. Yet this prosperity depends strongly on cross-border commuting, which creates mobility challenges and environmental stress. Escalating housing prices have made access to affordable living increasingly difficult, displacing a significant share of the workforce beyond national borders. The reliance on imported energy leaves households and firms vulnerable to external shocks. Although Luxembourg's welfare model and social dialogue remain robust, they are under pressure from rising costs of living, widening inequalities, and growing demands on public services. Environmentally, Luxembourg's footprint per inhabitant ranks among the largest worldwide, driven by high consumption and land-use pressures that push the country beyond sustainable limits.

Meeting these intertwined challenges calls for coordinated transformations that bridge sectors, disciplines, and scales. Economic and social progress must be reframed within the concept of a Safe Operating Space—an area in which human well-being is achieved without breaching environmental boundaries. The objective is to steer innovation, governance, and everyday practices toward forms of competitiveness that are compatible with sustainability, rather than in conflict with it. The Doctoral Training Unit C-SOS (Competitiveness within a Safe Operating Space) is designed to cultivate researchers capable of analysing and fostering such transformations. It brings together an interdisciplinary consortium to train 12 PhD candidates in the assessment and design of inclusive and sustainable development trajectories. The programme equips them with conceptual and methodological tools to connect environmental sustainability, social well-being, and economic dynamics into integrated frameworks for decision-making. Its ambition is to inform socio-economic policies, encourage responsible industrial and technological innovation, and contribute to more equitable and resilient societies. Luxembourg provides an ideal environment for this initiative, combining strong expertise in sustainability science and policy analysis. The DTU is a collaboration between researchers at the Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST), the University of Luxembourg (UL) and the Urban Development and Mobility Department at the Luxembourg Institute of Socio-Economic Research (LISER). The consortium also includes the National Statistics Office (STATEC). In this DTU, 12 scientists will train 12 PhD students over six years (from January 2027), each obtaining a PhD from UL's doctoral schools.

As part of the C-SOS Doctoral Training Unit, in this PhD you will integrate concepts from Post-Growth, Sufficiency and Doughnut Economics into the downscaling of planetary boundaries, leveraging good examples of application to territories and cities. Possible research questions include: how to couple ecological limits and social foundation as an interdependent system? How to define social foundation? How to allocate the carrying capacity based on social foundation?.

You will be embedded in the SUSTAIN unit at LIST and enrolled as a doctoral candidate at the University of Luxembourg. You will work closely with a diverse cohort of 12 PhD researchers across the social, economic, and environmental sciences, contributing to a shared research agenda on how Luxembourg can thrive within its fair share of planetary limits

You will be mainly in charge of:
• Conducting a systematic review and critical assessment of existing carrying capacity allocation and planetary boundary downscaling approaches, spanning economic and emission based allocation methods, sufficiency based approaches, and Doughnut Economics frameworks
• Developing a methodological framework for coupling ecological limits and social foundation as an interdependent system, integrating Post-Growth, Sufficiency, and Doughnut Economics concepts into the downscaling of planetary boundaries
• Applying the framework to Luxembourg and comparable small territories under a range of allocation scenarios, drawing on Green Deal technology targets, context specific Decent Living Standards, and provisioning systems, producing environmental ceiling estimates grounded in social foundation thresholds
• Building and maintaining a dynamic system model enabling the testing of individual and combined allocation approaches, valuing social outcome generation per unit of environmental impact across relevant planetary boundary dimensions
• Collaborating with other C-SOS doctoral researchers, in particular those working on social foundation, Quality of Life, and economic systems, to ensure that allocation approaches rest on socially realistic and empirically coherent definitions of social foundation
• Publishing results in peer reviewed journals and presenting at international conferences
• Contributing to C-SOS training activities, workshops, and stakeholder engagement events

Education
• Master's degree (or equivalent) in a quantitative discipline relevant to environmental sustainability, such as: industrial ecology, environmental engineering, environmental or ecological economics or computational social science
• Solid academic grounding in Planetary Boundaries, Doughnut Economics, Post Growth or degrowth literature
• Familiarity with Decent Living Standards and Quality of Life frameworks

Experience and skills

title: RESEARCHER IN FIRST-PRINCIPLES MODELLING OF MULTIFERROIC MATERIALS (m/f)
employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
description:
Fixed term contract | Belvaux | 24 months

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

The push to reduce global energy consumption has set a clear trend in modern technology towards devices that are smaller, faster and more energy-efficient. Meeting these demands calls for new materials that can perform several functions at once. Magnetoelectric multiferroics are especially attractive in this respect, because they combine magnetism and ferroelectricity in a single phase. Crucially, this opens the possibility of controlling magnetism with an electric field which could enable entirely new device architectures and transform modern computing and data storage. Despite decades of progress, this promise is hard to realise: in most known multiferroics the two orders only coexist well below room temperature, and many are difficult to integrate with standard semiconductor manufacturing. Turning multiferroics into a practical technology therefore requires identifying or designing new materials that show robust, coupled magnetism and ferroelectricity at room temperature and remain compatible with established fabrication processes.

This is the challenge at the heart of the SMART project funded by the FNR CORE programme and led by Natalya Fedorova. We offer a 2-year postdoc position in which you will use first-principles calculations (DFT) together with analytical modelling to design room-temperature multiferroics via doping of semiconductors. Working mainly with DFT, you will carry out a systematic analysis of electronic, structural, magnetic and ferroelectric properties of these materials - computing, for instance, ground-state magnetic configurations, magnetic exchange interactions, electric polarization and polarization-switching pathways. You will then combine these results with analytical models to describe the magnetoelectric coupling in the most promising candidates and to explore how their magnetism could be manipulated with an applied electric field.

You will join the Modelling of Functional Materials group led by Jorge Íñiguez-González (also involved in the project) and will benefit from interactions with other team members.

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us
The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a Research and Technology Organization (RTO) active in the fields of materials, environment and IT. By transforming scientific knowledge into technologies, smart data and tools, LIST empowers citizens in their choices, public authorities in their decisions and businesses in their strategies.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

The LIST AI Initiative, supported by the LIST Board of Directors, aims to expand LIST's AI capabilities and maximise the impact of AI innovation both within LIST (AI applied to scientific research in all LIST RDI units and AI applied to improve the performance of LIST corporate support functions) and outside LIST (AI applied to improve products, services and processes of private and public organisations through collaborative projects and/or contract research).
One of the key areas of interest in the LIST AI initiative is that of Frugal AI, understood in a very broad sense: from the analysis of “frugality” of current AI models to the selection/adaptation of models to be deployed in constrained resources (in terms of energy, memory…) depending on the client requirements as part of the design process of a new software system with sustainability concerns.

In this context, LIST is seeking to recruit an AI experienced researcher with a strong specialization and interest in the field of Frugal AI (and similar terms: green AI, low-resource AI, constrained AI, …).

You will join the LIST AI Initiative team as a member of the SWRDI research group and collaborate with peers in a dynamic and evolving research environment within the SWRDI group, the HANDS unit and, in general, with other LIST units requiring expertise in the Frugal AI field.

The SWRDI team specializes in the design and development of smart (i.e. AI-enhanced) software systems. We believe energy concerns should be part of the software design from its early stages and therefore, we believe there is the need to specify resource requirements as part of the requirements engineering phase. These requirements will be then analysed against the energy/memory requirements of AI models to optimize the system behaviour while minimizing the resources consumed by the AI components in it.

We'll expect from you to lead research and innovation (RDI) activities in Frugal AI. As an experienced researcher, you will take the lead in:
• Delivering Research, Development and Innovation (RDI) activities.

How will you contribute?
You'll be working on a production-grade Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system purpose-built for second-level controls on NAV computation in investment funds. The system must retrieve relevant regulatory methodology, replicate calculation steps, detect discrepancies against fund accounting outputs, and produce control reports that are traceable, auditable, and defensible under regulatory scrutiny.
You will contribute to a system where precision, explainability, and reliability are non-negotiable.

Code Development (60%):
·          Build retrieval pipelines optimised for structured regulatory methodology documents (CSSF circulars, ESMA guidelines, fund prospectuses), with adaptive weighting to surface the specific calculation rules relevant to each control query
·          Implement numerical validation pipelines that compare LLM-derived NAV calculation outputs against fund administrator figures, applying configurable tolerance bands and discrepancy flagging logic
·          Implement chunking strategies optimised for fund accounting reports and regulatory circulars, preserving the structure of calculation tables, formula references, and numbered regulatory provisions.
·          Build evaluation frameworks measuring control accuracy (error detection rate, false positive/negative rates on flagged discrepancies) and the quality of generated audit reports
·          Optimise vector database indexing for regulatory document corpora with high update frequency, ensuring fast retrieval as new CSSF/ESMA guidance is published

Research & experimentation (25%):
·          Benchmark embedding models against the current Nomic Embed Text baseline, with a focus on sensitivity to numerical and regulatory language in fund accounting contexts
·          Explore cross-lingual retrieval for EU regulatory documents published across multiple languages, with emphasis on French and German variants of CSSF and ESMA guidance
·          Research agent-based simulation of NAV calculation steps, investigating how LLMs can reason reliably over arithmetic-sensitive regulatory workflows and signal confidence levels
·          Experiment with multi-agent orchestration for second-level control workflows, where agents decompose a NAV control task into parallel verification sub-tasks across pricing, accruals, and corporate actions.

System integration (15%):
·          Integrate LLM backends optimised for structured reasoning and develop prompt engineering patterns that enforce step-by-step calculation verification and explainable output
·          Implement comprehensive logging, structured audit trail generation, and monitoring dashboards that allow compliance officers to review and challenge control decisions

description:

Are you passionate about space resources? So are we! Come and join us

The European Space Resources Innovation Centre (ESRIC) is a joint initiative of the Luxembourg Space Agency (LSA), the European Space Agency (ESA) and the Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST). ESRIC's mission is to be an internationally recognized centre of expertise for scientific, technical, business and economic aspects related to the use of space resources for human and robotic exploration, as well as for a future in-space economy.
The primary objective of ESRIC is to research, develop and improve our knowledge and understanding of space resources, and the performance of processes enabling the utilization of space resources with an initial focus on the Moon.
The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

Do you want to know more about ESRIC and LIST? Check our websites: https://www.esric.lu/ and https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

As part of a new phase of growth for ESRIC, we are seeking a Head of Group for the In Situ Resource Utilisation group. This group focuses on the prospecting, mapping and characterisation of resources in space, currently focused on the Moon. In addition, the group focuses on developing technology that will produce usable resources in space, including oxygen from lunar regolith and water purification. We are looking for an experienced researcher with proven expertise in space resources research and development to lead this group.
Reporting to the Head of ESRIC, the Head of the In Situ Resource Utilisation Group will be engaged in the definition and execution of high-quality research, development and innovation (RDI) projects related to finding and using resources in space. In coordination with the Head of ESRIC, you will define the group's roadmap and its objectives, and manage the current and future project portfolio. You will manage the group's budget and resources, including team allocation on projects. You will guide the development of competencies of the group, aligned with the overall objectives and mission of ESRIC. Management and leadership skills are a must, in addition to sound multi-project and/or programme management skills.
You will lead a dynamic team of researchers, PhD candidates and postdoctoral researchers, and help to grow the team, and ESRIC, by attracting projects and funding.

description:
Job Description

We are seeking a Finance Business Partner (Business Services) based in Luxembourg (hybrid). You will partner with Business Services leadership to drive lean accounting, process optimization and AI-driven reporting, lead budgeting and forecasting cycles, and deliver actionable financial insights that improve performance. The role suits a senior, pragmatic finance professional (10+ years) with SAP and BI experience, a strong process orientation, and a proven ability to deliver under pressure.

As Senior Finance Business Partner (Business Services) you will be the finance lead embedded with Business Services, acting as a change agent to drive lean accounting, process optimization and data-driven decision making. You will tightly partner with COO (Head of Business Services) and the business services leaders to translate operational needs into actionable financial insights, streamline processes through automation and AI-enabled tools, and support performance improvement across cost, quality and delivery. This replacement role requires a senior, hands-on professional who thrives under pressure, prioritizes effectively, and contributes as a collaborative team player.

What you will be working on

• Act as the trusted finance partner to CFO, Head of Finance, COO and Business Services leadership: deliver financial insight, challenge assumptions and influence decisions.
• Act as a sparring partner to the Director of FP&A contributing to robust discussions on financial performance, forecasting assumptions, business plans, controlling model and strategic priorities.
• Lead process improvement and lean accounting initiatives to simplify workflows, reduce waste and strengthen internal controls.
• Design, develop and maintain reporting and analysis that support operational decisions — move towards near real-time, KPI-driven dashboards.
• Drive automation and AI adoption across finance processes (reporting, forecasting, reconciliations, controls), identifying opportunities for AI.
• Support monthly close activities and ensure accuracy and timeliness of financial data.
• Lead budgeting, forecasting and budgetary control processes for Business Services; provide scenario analysis and actionable recommendations.
• Translate business change needs into finance requirements and support implementation of new tools, systems or processes (working closely with Digital Accelerator team  and Finance peers).
• Deliver ad hoc financial analysis and sponsor small-to-medium projects that enhance financial performance or operating model.
• Promote financial and business awareness across the Business function and within Finance through coaching and clear communication.

What we look for

• Strong accounting and controlling background with a minimum of 10 years' relevant experience.
• Advanced Excel; experience with SAP finance modules and Reporting tools.
• Hands-on familiarity with automation/AI tools or demonstrable appetite and experience driving such initiatives.
• Solid budgeting, forecasting and financial modelling skills.
• Excellent communication and presentation skills in English; other languages an asset.
• Proven track record in a finance business partnering role supporting shared services, central functions or similar.
• Demonstrable experience running process improvement projects and delivering automation/AI-driven efficiencies.
• Comfortable operating independently, handling ambiguous situations and escalating appropriately.
• Behavioral skills and competencies: growth mindset, change agent, process-oriented, detail focused, pressure management, team work, decision quality and uphold KPMG firm standars.
• Professional accounting qualification (ACCA, CPA, CFA or equivalent) and experience in professional services or the Big Four environment as an asset.

description:

Department:  ICT AND SECURITY RISK DEPARTMENT

Description:

The Risk Management Department is responsible for the risk control function of the Bank, encompassing both Financial Risk and Operational Risk matters.
The Risk Management Department monitors existing and emerging risks, assess them and report them to the Senior Management of the Bank. It supports the business in managing their risks, providing guidance to promote risk awareness continuously.

We are seeking an experienced Head of ICT & Security Risk Management on a permanent role to lead our digital operational resilience strategy and ensure full compliance with the EU Digital Operational Resilience Act (DORA) and relevant regulatory requirements.

Your main tasks will be to:

• Be responsible for establishing and maintaining and governing a comprehensive ICT risk management framework
• Protect the Bank against cyber threats, operational disruptions, and third-party risks while enabling business growth and innovation.
• Manage and enhance the Bank's ICT risk management strategy and digital operational resilience framework in compliance with DORA regulations;
• Provide expert advisory and regular reporting to the Executive Committee and the Board of Directors on ICT Risk appetite, tolerance levels, and evolving regulatory expectations;
• Develop, maintain and enforce comprehensive ICT risk policies, procedures, and governance structures across the organization;
• Conduct and manage the Digital Operational Resilience testing program, including vulnerability management, and Threat-Led Penetration Testing and comprehensive ICT risk assessments covering all systems, applications, and third-party services whenever applicable;
• Implement continuous monitoring and threat intelligence programs to identify emerging risks;
• Develop and maintain Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for ICT risk management purpose;
• Foster collaboration across IT, Risk, Compliance, and operating units;
• Provide training and awareness programs to enhance ICT risk culture across the organization.
• Lead and manage the ICT and Security Risk Management team, while supervising the department's objectives and operational alignment.

Job requirements:

• Relevant experience in information security and ICT risk management;
• Educational background in Computer Science, IT or Information Security
• Professional certifications such as CISM, CRISC, CISSP, or CISA are highly desirable.
• Comprehensive knowledge of ICT risk management methodologies and frameworks as well as cybersecurity frameworks, industry standards and regulations (e.g. ISO27001, NIST, DORA);
• Knowledge of cybersecurity technologies including SIEM, DLP, endpoint protection, and threat intelligence;
• Proactively support business and IT teams for assessing security and ICT Risk;

Head of Technical Training (m/f/x)

* Have strong leadership, organisational and priority-setting skills, with the ability to lead, develop and motivate teams in a demanding operational environment.
* Demonstrate strong communication, presentation and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively at all levels inside and outside the company.

* Be able to work autonomously, take decisions within the scope of responsibility, manage priorities and drive initiatives to completion.

* Be open to travel and participation in industry events.
* Be familiar with standard office and reporting applications.
* Have excellent communication skills in English, good working knowledge of French or German, spoken and written, is an advantage.
* Maintain strict confidentiality of data and sensitive operational matters.
* Have good negotiation skills
* Show strong sense for entrepreneurial and economical thinking
* Show the ability for clear expression in writing
* Be capable of working independently as well as in a team

Desired or to be acquired criteria
* Must provide an effort in the undeveloped language
* Show user skills in the IT systems used in Luxair Technics

The ideal candidate
* Be a current or former EASA Part 66 B1/B2 or C licence holder would be an advantage

Partner & Client Services Senior Officer - Swedish Market
Customer Operations - Findel, Grand Duchy of Luxembourg

About Utmost International

Utmost International is a leading provider of insurance-based wealth solutions operating across the UK, Europe, Latin America, Asia, and the Middle East. Its solutions are largely based on unit-linked insurance policies, serving the needs of affluent, high net worth (HNW), and ultra-high net worth (UHNW) individuals.

About Utmost Luxembourg S.A.

Sitting at the crossroads of private banking, asset management, and insurance, we operate in a well-established and fast-growing division of the financial services industry. Our dynamic international team of 450+ experienced wealth structuring specialists, subject-matter and technical experts consists of 50 different nationalities, speaking over 30 languages.

We are a diverse and inclusive organisation driven by a values-based culture that promotes excellence, ambition, and innovation. We invest in talented teams who develop their expertise, curated through support and training, and fostered through a people centred culture. Our people truly are our greatest asset!

Your role - Are you ready for a challenge?

The Senior Account Officer - Swedish and Norwegian Market is responsible for assisting in the timely and effective day to day processing of servicing activities for Swedish and Norwegian policies. Ensuring that all work items are processed in accordance with compliance obligations and within agreed service standards.
The Account Officer may help the team to support additional/exceptional workload.
The ideal candidate will be flexible in handling daily operations related to servicing existing clients and policyholders along with custodian account processing requirements.

Your responsibilities will be as follows:

The Senior Account Officer - Swedish and Norwegian Market is accountable for:
• Providing daily support to Partners, Clients and Sales colleagues;
• Handling daily workload in an accurate and timely manner meeting, exceeding where possible the Service Standards;
• Accurate and timely processing of policy transactions, servicing and query resolution during the life cycle of a policy, including document management;
• Proactively following up and monitor all transactions and queries received from both internal and external parties;
• Managing risk within your area of responsibility including adherence to Corporate Policy on Compliance and Risk;
• Respecting the planning established by your line manager in relation to business activities;
• Following instructions and process information accurately and in a timely manner;
• Prioritising multiple tasks while remaining calm and positive under pressure;
• Maintaining an on-going awareness of service, propose suggested improvement to your line manager and ensure quality improvements are made, as agreed.

Your profile - Have you got what it takes to become our Senior Account Officer?

• Experience of working within the Financial Sector with a minimum of 4 years' experience, ideally within Private Banking or with Independent Financial Advisors;
• You enjoy working in a challenging, fast paced environment and look for the opportunity to excel in all aspects of your role;
• Take personal pride in delivering high quality service to internal and external clients;
• Good communication skills: being able to build effective relationships and adapt communication style to the counterpart, always in a professional manner;
• Ability to listen to other opinions as well as being confident of your own and find balanced solutions;
• Be able and willing to look beyond the obvious and seek alternative solutions;
• Ability to work independently while keen to work as part of a team and assist colleagues;
• Willing to make the extra effort as required;
• Knowledge of Anti-Money Laundering regulations;
• Native-level Swedish speaker and fluency in English is a must, any other European language is an asset, particularly Norwegian.

As an equal opportunity employer, all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, colour, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Group General Counsel - International Company (m/f)
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Group General Counsel

Reporting line: Chief Executive Officer, with dotted reporting line to the Board.
Contract: permanent, full-time (40 hours per week). Location: Luxembourg, hybrid, with regular international travel.

1 The business and the role

The company operates an international online subscription and creator platform, with exposure to adult content, and which operates across the United Kingdom, the European Union and the US. The Group General Counsel is the most senior legal officer of the group.

2 Main responsibilities

1. Legal function leadership and Board support

• Build, staff and lead the group legal function, including recruitment, budget, external counsel panel and legal operations.
• Act as principal legal adviser to the Board, the founders and the executive team, and attend Board and committee meetings.
• Set and own the group's legal risk appetite, escalation framework and legal reporting to the Board and to investors.
• Manage disputes and litigation across jurisdictions, including instruction and supervision of external counsel.

2. Corporate, M&A and governance

• Lead corporate and M&A transactions end to end, including target assessment, due diligence, transaction documentation, signing, closing and PMI.
• Support fundraising rounds, investor documentation, shareholder arrangements and cap table matters.
• Own corporate governance across a multi-jurisdictional holding structure, including entity management, board and shareholder resolutions, statutory filings, registers of beneficial owners, delegated authority frameworks and group policies.
• Act as secretary to the Board and to group entity boards, or supervise that function.
• Coordinate with finance and tax on group structuring, intragroup agreements, transfer pricing documentation and substance requirements.

3. Data protection, artificial intelligence and digital regulation

• Own the group's data protection compliance programme under the EU GDPR and the UK GDPR, including records of processing, transfer mechanisms, data protection impact assessments, data subject rights, breach response and supervisory authority engagement.
• Advise on US privacy legislation applicable to the group's user base, including state level comprehensive privacy laws and applicable wiretapping and tracking technology claims.
• Own the group's artificial intelligence governance framework, including the classification of AI systems, transparency obligations for synthetic and AI generated content, model and vendor due diligence, training data and intellectual property questions, and readiness for the EU AI Act.
• Advise on the EU Digital Services Act and the UK Online Safety Act, including notice and action mechanisms, trusted flaggers, transparency reporting, risk assessment obligations, illegal content duties and children's access assessments.
• Advise on the EU Digital Markets Act, the audiovisual media services framework and platform to business regulation as applicable to the group's distribution channels.

4. High risk industry, trust and safety, and content compliance

• Advise on the legal and regulatory framework applicable to adult oriented and creator monetization platforms, including age assurance and identity verification, performer consent and record keeping obligations, nonconsensual intimate image takedown, CSAM prevention and reporting, and content moderation and appeals.
• Design and maintain creator terms, model releases, content licences, revenue share arrangements and agency and management arrangements.
• Advise on advertising, affiliate and performance marketing arrangements, influencer marketing rules and consumer protection requirements in the EU, the UK and the US.
• Manage intellectual property, including trademarks, copyright enforcement and anti-piracy programmes.

5. Payments, financial crime and sanctions

• Own the legal side of the group's payments stack, including acquirer and payment service provider agreements, alternative payment methods, payout and creator disbursement arrangements and merchant of record structures.
• Advise on card scheme rules as they apply to high risk and adult merchant categories, including high brand risk and integrity risk registration programmes, prohibited content rules, chargeback thresholds and remediation plans.

Tech Lead - Digital Transformation Factory Vie

Au sein de la Digital Transformation Factory Vie, vous portez la vision technique des solutions digitales du domaine Vie et accompagnez l'équipe dans la conception, le développement et l'exploitation de solutions robustes, sécurisées, simples et maintenables.
En tant que point de référence technique, vous veillez à la cohérence des choix réalisés avec les besoins métier, l'écosystème IT, les standards de l'entreprise et les principes d'architecture. Vous collaborez étroitement avec les équipes de développement, les Business Analysts, le Product Owner, les architectes et les équipes d'exploitation, tout en conservant une dimension opérationnelle avec environ 50 % de votre activité consacrée au développement, selon les priorités de l'équipe.

Ce qui vous attend

Type de contrat : CDI
Type d'emploi : temps plein

• Vision et architecture : définir les orientations techniques locales en cohérence avec l'architecture d'entreprise et les architectes solution, promouvoir des solutions simples et maintenables, et garantir la cohérence entre les frontends Angular, les services REST backend .NET, les microservices de support et les échanges Kafka.
• Analyser en amont les impacts, dépendances et risques techniques, documenter les décisions structurantes et contribuer à la roadmap technique.
• Consulter les architectes et débattre avec eux de toute décision ayant un impact sur plusieurs applications ou équipes.

• Réaliser des revues de code, prototypes et preuves de concept, intervenir sur les développements structurants ou complexes, veiller au respect des quality gates SonarCloud et promouvoir les tests automatisés.
• Accompagnement de l'équipe : faire progresser les membres sur les pratiques de développement et DevOps, contribuer au recrutement et à la montée en compétence, accompagner les choix de conception et d'implémentation, faciliter les décisions collectives et arbitrer lorsque nécessaire.
• Industrialisation : assurer une veille technologique, maintenir et améliorer les pipelines d'intégration continue dans Azure DevOps Services et collaborer sur les processus de déploiement continu gérés dans Jenkins.
• Garantir un niveau d'observabilité adapté grâce aux logs, métriques, tableaux de bord et alertes, et participer aux mises en production nécessitant l'intervention de l'équipe technique.

Ce que nous attendons

• Diplôme supérieur en informatique ou en ingénierie logicielle.
• Expérience significative en développement logiciel dans l'écosystème .NET et avec Angular, ainsi que dans un rôle de point de référence ou de leadership technique incluant l'accompagnement de développeurs.
• Très bonne maîtrise de C#, de .NET et de son écosystème, notamment EF Core et SQL Server, idéalement sur une version récente telle que .NET 10.
• Très bonne maîtrise d'Angular et de TypeScript.
• Bonne connaissance de Git, des revues de code et des stratégies de gestion des branches, notamment Gitflow.
• Expérience dans la conception d'API, de microservices, d'architectures distribuées et de solutions de messaging avec Kafka.
• Maîtrise des enjeux de performance, de scalabilité, de résilience applicative, de sécurité et d'observabilité.
• Expérience d'Azure DevOps Services pour l'intégration continue et connaissance de Jenkins pour le déploiement.
• Leadership technique, pragmatisme, autonomie, écoute et esprit d'équipe ; capacité à communiquer, coacher, décider et gérer plusieurs priorités sans posture autoritaire.
• Français et anglais courants ; l'allemand et le luxembourgeois constituent des atouts.
• Une expérience dans les secteurs financier, assurantiel ou de la gestion de patrimoine constitue un atout.

À propos de Baloise

Nous sommes plus qu'une compagnie d'assurance traditionnelle : nous sommes le partenaire personnel de quiconque veut se sentir tout simplement en sécurité. Outre nos activités financières classiques, nous cherchons à innover et à créer des liens générateurs de valeur avec des partenariats et des start-ups. Nous considérons l'ère numérique comme une opportunité et aspirons à ce que notre offre de demain soit encore plus durable, plus innovante et plus orientée client. Vous voulez y participer ?

Nous vous donnons la liberté de poursuivre vos idées... Investissez-vous ! Remettez-nous en question ! Continuez à évoluer et à nous faire évoluer !  Tout ceci est possible grâce à notre culture de l'apprentissage et de l'erreur ainsi qu'à une communication d'égal à égal. Parce que ce n'est qu'ensemble que nous pourrons aller de l'avant.

description:
Willkommen im Team als

(Senior) Risk Manager

Das Unternehmen:

Die Commerz Real Fundmanagement S.à r.l. (“CRFM“) ist ein Spezialist für die Verwaltung von Alternativen Investmentfonds. Die CRFM trägt hierdurch zum Profil der Commerz Real AG und ihren Konzerngesellschaften (“Commerz Real Gruppe“) als integrierter Investmentdienstleister bei. Die CRFM arrangiert Alternative Investmentfonds, insbesondere für Immobilien, Infrastrukturprojekte, Anlagen zur Erzeugung erneuerbarer Energien sowie Großmobilien (wie z.B.: Flugzeuge, Schiffe und Schienenfahrzeuge). Die CRFM ist eine Tochtergesellschaft der Commerz Real AG, die ihrerseits eine Tochter der Commerzbank Aktiengesellschaft, Deutschland, ist.

Aufgabe:

- Als (Senior) Risk Manager Anlageprodukte und Teil des Risk Management Teams bist Du verantwortlich für die Risikoanalyse, Bewertung und Überwachung von (komplexen) Neu- und Bestandsgeschäften unter Beachtung von wirtschaftlichen, rechtlichen und steuerlichen Rahmenbedingungen hinsichtlich aller relevanten Risikoarten (u.a. Adressausfall-, Objektwertänderungs-, Marktpreis-, Liquiditätsrisiken, spezielle Risiken im Bereich Infrastructure wie z.B. Betriebs- und Projektentwicklungsrisiken, etc.)
- Dabei stellst Du die kompetenzgerechte Genehmigung bzw. Erstellung von Genehmigungsvorlagen für An- und Verkaufstransaktionen der AIF/Spezial-AIF sicher
- Zu Deinen Aufgaben gehört auch die Mitarbeit bei der Strukturierung und Steuerung von AIF/Spezial-AIF zur haftungsmäßigen und wirtschaftlichen Optimierung
- Ebenso verantwortest Du die regelmäßige risikotechnische Überwachung der AIF/Spezial-AIF im Wertschöpfungsprozess inkl. Überwachung der vertraglichen Finanzierungsgestaltung und des Liquiditätsmanagements
- Du unterstützt die Marktbereiche bei Vertragsverhandlungen im Neu- und Bestandsgeschäft sowie bei der Entwicklung von neuen Produkten als Mitglied in Dealteams und/oder Projektgruppen
- Die Leitung von bzw. Mitarbeit in bereichsinternen Projekten zur Optimierung / Digitalisierung der Risikoorganisation, hier insbesondere zur (Weiter-)Entwicklung von gesetzeskonformen Prozessen, Regularien und Risikotools gehört ebenfalls zu Deinen Aufgaben
- Du bringst Deine Expertise und Unterstützung bei übergreifenden Projekten sowie im Rahmen der Digitalisierungsstrategie ein. Dabei übernimmst Du auch die Leitung von übergreifenden Projekten
- Du übernimmst Coaching / Weiterbildungsaufgaben im Risikomanagement sowie die Ausbildung von Nachwuchskräften

Profil:

- Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes (auch berufsintegriertes) Studium mit der Fachrichtung Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder Rechtswissenschaften, idealerweise im Schwerpunkt Risikomanagement
- Langjährige fachbezogene Berufserfahrung im Bereich Risikomanagement eines Asset-Managers, eines Fondsemissionshauses oder eines Kreditinstitutes,
- Umfassende Kenntnisse und mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Assetklasse Infrastructure, idealerweise auch in Private Equity und Debt Strukturen. Grundkenntnisse und Interesse an den Assetklassen Renewable Energies, sowie Real Estate runden Deine Erfahrung ab.
- Erweiterte betriebswirtschaftliche Kenntnisse insbesondere im Bereich Risikomanagement, Bilanzanalyse, Discounted Cash-Flow-Analyse, Sensitivitätsanalyse, Cash-Flow-Modellierung, Liquiditätsrisikomanagement und Portfoliosteuerung
- Sehr gute Kenntnisse der einschlägigen Gesetze, Verordnungen, Vorschriften und Richtlinien (AIFM-Richtlinie, AIFM-VO, ESMA-Leitlinien, Luxemburger Gesetze bzgl. AIFMD, u.a.)
- Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten und sehr sicherer Umgang mit MS Office
- Gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, idealerweise auch gute Französischkenntnisse
- Ausgeprägte Team- und Kommunikationsfähigkeit
- Hohes Maß an Zielstrebigkeit und Eigeninitiative sowie unternehmerisches Denken und Flexibilität
