title: Senior testledare SAP Sales S/4HANA
description:
Vi söker en senior SAP Sales Test Lead som leder testarbetet för Sales i den svenska utrullningen av ett globalt SAP S/4HANA-program. Du kombinerar SAP SD-kompetens med testledning och hjälper verksamheten att verifiera att offert-, order- och faktureringsflöden fungerar. Uppdraget är hos vår kund i Finspång.

Om uppdraget

– Definiera lokal teststrategi, omfattning, planering och arbetssätt inom programmets gemensamma testupplägg.

– Identifiera kritiska Sales-scenarier och anpassa globala testunderlag till lokala affärsprocesser.

– Leda framtagning av testfall och säkerställa spårbarhet mellan krav, processer och testresultat.

– Planera och samordna systemintegrationstest (SIT) och användaracceptanstest (UAT) tillsammans med verksamhet, IT och key users.

– Samordna testdata och beroenden till datamigrering, angränsande processområden och integrationer.

– Driva defekthantering från registrering och prioritering till uppföljning, eskalering och verifiering av åtgärder.

Vi söker dig som

– Erfarenhet av SAP SD i S/4HANA.

– Dokumenterad erfarenhet av testledning, inklusive SIT, UAT och defekthantering.

– God förståelse för Order-to-Cash-processer och hur Sales-data och integrationer påverkar flödet.

– Erfarenhet av globala templatebaserade utrullningar.

– Vana att arbeta i globala och tvärfunktionella team och samordna verksamhet, IT och key users.

– Mycket god engelska i tal och skrift.

Meriterande

– Erfarenhet av Quote-to-Cash och industriell reservdelsaffär eller eftermarknad.

Bra att veta

– Ort: Finspång.

– Språk: engelska.

title: Bästa extra jobbet i Vimmerby - tjäna pengar där festen är!
description:
Bästa extra jobbet i stan - tjäna pengar där festen är!

”För ett år sen visste jag knappt vad blackjack var. Nu står jag på Cherrys roligaste krogar, styr borden och tjänar mer än många av mina kompisar.”

– Linn, 21 år

Hur är det egentligen att jobba som blackjack dealer? Linn, en av våra medarbetare, berättar:

Vad jobbet faktiskt går ut på:

Du står vid blackjackbordet, dealar korten, håller koll på spelet och ser till att alla har det bra. Det är du som sätter stämningen. En kväll kan du ha ett bord fullt av tjejer på möhippa, nästa kväll ett företag på julbord och sen ett härligt gäng som vart ute på en afterwork. Du är ansiktet utåt – varm, tydlig, professionell.

Och nej, du behöver inte kunna något om kort eller spel. Det enda som krävs är att du är social, lugn under press och faktiskt gillar att möta människor. Resten lär du dig på Cherrys interna utbildning som är helt kostnadsfri.

Varför just det här jobbet?

Jag har testat det mesta som tex kassa, servering, telemarketing. Det här är det första extrajobbet som faktiskt känns som något mer än bara timmar mot kronor.

Varför man ska välja just Cherry:

    Ingen kväll är den andra lik, så risken att du tröttnar är obefintlig.
    Du får betalt för att vara social och närvarande i en rolig miljö och inte för att gömma dig bakom en skärm eller ett lager.
    Varje pass blir en upptäcktsresa bland nya människor så du blir riktigt vass på att läsa människor, snacka och ha koll på läget (utan att ens tänka på det).
    Du märker ganska snabbt att du är en stor del av stämningen och utan dig blir det inte riktigt samma flow.
    Du bygger erfarenhet som gör dig grym i alla servicejobb (och ärligt talat, livet i stort).
    Det är ett flexibelt jobb som du kan kombinera med studier eller annan sysselsättning.

Om Cherry:

Cherry Spelglädje finns sedan 1963 och är Sveriges största aktör inom landbaserat kommersiellt spel och bemmanar över 80 % av marknaden. Vi är ungefär 600 personer fördelade på 40 distrikt runt om i landet. På golvet känns Cherry som ett härligt team där gemenskapen är stark och där många hittar vänner för livet.

Vem vi tror passar:

Vi söker någon som bidrar till en bra stämning vid borden, skapar en trygg spelmiljö och får gäster att trivas. Det märks snabbt när rätt person står där. Du är en social person som gillar fart och blir inte stressad när det går snabbt. Du tycker att kvällar och helger är prime time.

Det praktiska:

    Omfattning: minst 4 helg kvällar/månad, ca 20 timmar – mer om du vill
    Tider: kvällar och nätter, främst fredagar och lördagar
    Lön: från 161 kr/h + OB, provision, semesterersättning, pensionsgrundande
    Kollektivavtal via HRF, anslutna till Visita.
    Åldersgräns: 18 år

Det här är ett av få jobb där det faktiskt spelar roll vem du är som människa, inte vad du har på CV:t. Skicka din ansökan direkt så hoppas jag att vi syns snart! Om du undrar något innan du söker så ring eller maila Chelsea, hon är platsansvarig i Vimmerby, Västervik och Oskarshamn.

title: Mainframe Developer
description:
What makes Cognizant a unique place to work? The combination of rapid growth and an international and innovative environment! This is creating a lot of opportunities for people like YOU — people with an entrepreneurial spirit who want to make a difference in this world. At Cognizant, together with your colleagues from all around the world, you will collaborate on creating solutions for the world's leading companies and help them become more flexible, more innovative and successful.

Job Summary

We are seeking a skilled Software Engineer with 4 to 8 years of experience in IBM Mainframe Utilities VSAM JCL and COBOL. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Data Management and will work from our office during day shifts. This role does not require travel.

Responsibilities

    Develop and maintain software applications using IBM Mainframe Utilities VSAM JCL and COBOL.
    Ensure the integrity and quality of data management processes.
    Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather and analyze requirements.
    Provide technical support and troubleshooting for mainframe applications.
    Optimize and enhance existing software systems for improved performance.
    Conduct code reviews and ensure adherence to best practices and standards.
    Create and maintain documentation for software applications and processes.
    Participate in the full software development lifecycle including design coding testing and deployment.
    Implement data management solutions that align with business objectives.
    Monitor and resolve issues related to data integrity and performance.
    Stay updated with the latest industry trends and technologies in mainframe and data management.
    Contribute to the continuous improvement of development processes and methodologies.
    Ensure compliance with company policies and regulatory requirements.

Qualifications

    Possess a strong understanding of IBM Mainframe Utilities VSAM JCL and COBOL.
    Have a solid background in data management and related processes.
    Demonstrate excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
    Exhibit strong communication and collaboration abilities.
    Show proficiency in software development lifecycle methodologies.
    Have experience in optimizing and enhancing software systems.
    Display attention to detail and commitment to quality.
    Be capable of working independently and as part of a team.
    Show adaptability to new technologies and industry trends.
    Demonstrate the ability to create and maintain comprehensive documentation.
    Possess a proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues.
    Exhibit a strong commitment to continuous learning and improvement.
    Ensure compliance with all relevant standards and regulations.

Certifications Required

Certified Application Developer on IBM Mainframe or equivalent certification relevant to mainframe technologies.

title: Marketing Director
description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY Tiger of Sweden is a Stockholm-based fashion house established in 1903 with a heritage in tailoring. For more than a century, Tiger of Sweden has stood for style with purpose, dressing men and women for whom true style is about the confidence to be themselves.

POSITION OVERVIEW As Marketing Director, you will build brand equity, elevate brand visibility, and fuel brand desirability for Tiger of Sweden globally. You should possess a deep understanding of brand strategy, consumer behaviour, and digital marketing, along with a proven track record of developing strategies and driving results for global fashion brands. Reporting directly to the CEO, you will set the brand strategy, lead all marketing, PR and campaign work, and build a high-performing Marketing & PR team across locations. You will work closely with the CEO and the entire management team, and represent the brand externally to agencies, press, industry opinion leaders, fashion influencers and celebrities. The role involves regular travel.

TASKS & RESPONSIBILITIES

Brand Strategy & Customer Insight:

    

Set the brand strategy for Tiger of Sweden, from target customer to visual identity and tone of voice, in alignment with the CEO.

    

Create a distinctive and inspiring brand community around Tiger of Sweden at a global scale.

    

Gain a deep understanding of current and target customers through qualitative and quantitative research and the Tiger Society customer database.

    

Share customer insights with the commercial, design, and product functions.

    

Ensure a consistent tone of voice across all channels globally (English, German, Swedish).

    

Act as the brand's north star, safeguarding 360-degree consistency across all owned and third-party channels.

Marketing, Campaigns & PR:

    

Develop and implement annual, seasonal, and project-based marketing and PR strategies.

    

Lead the conception, creation, and production (film, photo, editorial) of all marketing campaigns, in alignment with the CEO.

    

Lead the cross-functional 360 marketing and sales calendar planning and the weekly editorial meeting.

    

Drive online and offline media coverage, ensuring both quality and scale.

    

Drive the global influencer marketing strategy to increase visibility and awareness on social media.

    

Oversee and set a structure for global and local agencies and third-party service providers.

Retail, Store Concept & Events:

    

Lead the store design concept for all points of sale, directing external partners and delivering projects on time and on budget.

    

Co-develop in-store activations and create seasonal and theme-based window concepts.

    

Plan and manage brand events, such as fashion presentations, influencer experiences, store events, panel talks and live shopping.

    

Co-lead line release meetings with Sales and Design, and support selling-in with brand material such as lookbooks, virtual showrooms and brand presentations.

    

Support the Wholesale, Retail and eCom teams in reaching commercial targets.

    

Direct the creation of all branding-relevant physical assets, from stationery to packaging and signage.

Brand Development & Partnerships:

    

Develop a long-term licensing strategy, identifying suitable partners and setting up brand-enhancing, commercially attractive agreements.

    

Act as a brand ambassador for Tiger of Sweden.

Team Leadership & Budget:

    

Lead, develop, and mentor the Marketing & PR team, empowering existing talent to deliver excellence.

    

Manage the global Marketing & PR budget.

    

Set up relevant KPIs and reviews to ensure efficient and effective budget allocation, taking corrective action as needed.

SKILLS & REQUIREMENTS

    

10+ years of experience in Marketing & PR.

    

Proven track record in developing strategies and driving results for global fashion brands.

    

Experience working for a global fashion brand, preferably in a premium or luxury environment.

    

Experience directing creative and art direction for a global fashion or lifestyle brand.

    

Excellent knowledge of digital marketing, sales channels, and the latest digital trends.

    

Experience managing external agencies and senior, high-profile stakeholders.

    

Proven people leader with the ability to build successful cross-functional partnerships.

    

Strong written and verbal communication skills, with full professional proficiency in English.

    

Strong eye for brand-consistent visual storytelling.

    

Highly organised, able to juggle priorities in a fast-paced environment.

    

Creative, entrepreneurial and results-driven.

    

Culturally aware and highly engaged in the industry, current trends and events.

    

Team player with a positive, can-do attitude.

TOOLS & SYSTEMS

    

Microsoft Office

The position is based in our Head Office in Stockholm and is a full-time position. Does this sound like the perfect fit for you? Please don't hesitate to apply by submitting a CV and personal letter in English. We look forward to receiving your application.

Tiger of Sweden stands against any form of discrimination and strives to be an inclusive brand and workplace. We welcome applications from all individuals, regardless of gender, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, race or disability, and recruitment is based purely on skills and experience.

title: Danish-speaking Customer Service Representative for H&M - Remote work
description:
Are you passionate about building relationships and love fashion? As a Danish-speaking Customer Service Representative for H&M, you’ll have the opportunity to help customers, resolve issues, and deliver world-class service – all while working from home in Sweden. Sound interesting? Join Transcom and start your journey today!

What do we offer you?

    Security: We have a collective agreement (kollektivavtal) that guarantees great working conditions and employment security.
    Flexibility: The opportunity to work 100% from home in Sweden.
    Full-time: This is a 100% full-time position (40 hours per week).
    Start date: November 2nd.
    Contract Type & Future: This is a 6-month fixed-term seasonal contract – but for the right candidate, there are strong opportunities for a permanent position afterward, as we continuously invest in retaining our talented employees.
    Language Allowance: In addition to your base salary, we offer an attractive allowance for your Danish language skills.
    Employee Benefits: Rikskortet (meal card) to help you save on daily expenses, plus a wellness allowance (friskvårdsbidrag), as we highly value your health.
    Career Growth: No ambition is too big at Transcom. 90% of our leaders started their careers on the phones – we actively promote from within.
    Paid Training: We provide you with the right tools and foundation to succeed in your role from day one.

Your role as a Danish-speaking Customer Service Representative;

Become the face of H&M – an international company in the fashion industry where quality and customer experience are at the center of everything.

In this role, you will:

    Deliver a world-class customer experience by handling inquiries about online orders, deliveries, and returns quickly and accurately.
    Communicate effectively and professionally via phone, email, chat, and social media.
    Handle written inquiries in Norwegian (since the languages are very similar, you will pick this up quickly) and contribute to team success by sharing knowledge with colleagues.
    Working Hours: Monday–Friday 08:00–18:00, Saturdays 09:00–15:00 (shifts are scheduled within these hours). Closed on Sundays.

Who are you?

To succeed in this role, we believe you match the following profile:

    You speak and write fluent Danish (native or C1 level) and have a good understanding of written Norwegian.
    You have strong communication skills and demonstrate empathy and active listening.
    Strong technical aptitude & multitasking: You have excellent computer skills and are comfortable managing multiple digital tasks simultaneously, learning new systems quickly, and handling several chat conversations at once.
    You easily absorb new information and adapt quickly to changing circumstances.
    You bring a positive attitude and a passion for delivering a first-class customer experience – you believe the customer deserves more than just standard support.

Requirements for working from home:

    A stable internet connection of at least 10 Mbps (fiber/cable).
    A quiet and suitable work environment at home.
    Residency in Sweden: You must be living/residing in Sweden for this position.

About Transcom

Transcom is a global customer care specialist, providing customer care, sales, technical support, and credit management services through our network of 90 contact centers across 29 countries in 33 languages. We are driven by innovation and passionate about helping people solve problems. Additionally, we are one of Sweden's largest employers for young professionals. At Transcom, we are committed – to our clients and to each other. Every day, someone starts their journey with Transcom. We take the potential you have today and transform it into skills for the future. Here, you are recognized for your hard work, for being a team player, and for supporting others. We contribute to positive and lasting change in our teams and in society. That is simply who we are at Transcom. We take care of each other, and you are included, just as you are, from day one. With the right attitude, there are no limits to how far we can go together.

title: Backend Software Engineer – AI Assist
description:
Join Telavox as a Backend Software Engineer – AI Assist 🤖

Are you a backend engineer who wants to see AI run in production, not in a demo? AI Assist turns every recorded phone call on the Telavox platform into a transcript, a summary and action items for the people who took the call. We are looking for an engineer who is at home where distributed systems, telephony, and large language models meet.

In this role, placed in Malmö or Stockholm, you'll build and run the services behind AI Assist: turning a finished call into text and insight, and delivering the result to our apps and our admin portal. You'll work in a small team with a lot of ownership, shaping what to build together with the product manager day to day, and what you ship reaches real customers and partners the same week.

If you'd like to take the next step in your career and are excited by the challenge of making AI dependable at scale, this is your opportunity!

About the job

AI Assist is live today, sold both directly and through telecom operators across Europe, and usage is growing month over month. You'll join the team that owns it end to end, from the transcription pipeline to the APIs our apps and customers use. Much of the work is classic backend engineering with an AI twist: asynchronous processing, third-party model APIs, access control, metering, and data that has to be handled correctly under GDPR and EU data-residency requirements.

You'll work side by side with a colleague focused on model evaluation and transcription quality, with the AI Agents team next door building our AI agent platform, and with the telephony, apps and platform teams whose systems yours plug into.

Our stack: Java and Spring Boot, Kubernetes, and Google Vertex AI with Gemini and other model providers for transcription and analysis.

Your day-to-day work may include:

    

Designing, implementing and testing new capabilities in the AI service, from summaries a customer can shape themselves to the controls an admin needs to roll the product out.

    

Evolving the transcription pipeline together with the telephony and platform teams.

    

Integrating LLM and speech APIs in a production setting: asynchronous processing, quotas and rate limits, and keeping data within the EU.

    

Building the APIs that serve transcripts to our apps, our admin portal and our customers, with access control and data retention done right.

    

Owning what you ship: observability, alerting, and the follow-up when something fails.

About you

You're a product-minded backend engineer who likes owning a service from design to production, and who is comfortable in a system that spans several teams and a telephony platform with two decades of history. You care about correctness where it matters (who may read what, what is stored for how long, what a customer is billed for), and you enjoy the pace of a small team with customers and partners waiting for what you build. You don't need to be an AI researcher. You need to be the engineer who makes AI dependable.

Key skills and experience we're looking for:

    

Several years building backend services in Java, preferably with Spring Boot

    

Strong understanding of REST APIs, asynchronous processing, and system integration across service boundaries

    

Experience running services in production: monitoring, observability, and debugging in a distributed system

    

Experience with relational databases and queue-based or job-based architectures

    

Proficient in English, both spoken and written

Good-to-have skills:

    

Python, which we use alongside Java across the AI domain

    

Experience calling LLM or speech-to-text APIs from production code (Gemini, OpenAI or similar)

    

Experience deploying and running services on Kubernetes

    

Familiarity with telephony concepts (SIP, call recording, PBX) or with GDPR and data-residency requirements in practice

Join us at Telavox 💚

Since Telavox's journey started in 2002, we have strengthened our position as the leading forward-thinking communication platform for businesses. As a digital mobile operator, we develop and own our all-in-one communication platform, which integrates telephony, PBX, messaging, meetings, and contact centers, giving businesses a smarter way to connect.

Today, we’re a thriving company with 1.9 billion SEK in revenue and 500+ Telavoxers across nine countries. We embrace AI and automation to push the boundaries of business communication.

We offer flexible work options and adaptable hours, giving you the freedom to balance life and career while staying connected to our vibrant Telavox culture.

Read more about our new HQ in Malmö 🏠!

How to apply!

At Telavox, we don't focus on fitting in; we focus on making room for everyone.

We’re always on the lookout for great talent, so applications are reviewed continuously. If you're ready to be part of an innovative, AI-driven telecom company, apply today with your CV and cover letter in English.

Learn more about what we do! ⬇️

title: Torsby Hospital, Sweden is looking for specialist in internal medicine
description:
The Medical department at Torsby Hospital is looking for a specialist in internal medicine to become one of the consultant physicians in our team.

Torsby hospital is a pleasant workplace with a friendly atmosphere delivering high quality medical care. Learn more about the position and apply today!

Torsby hospital is a district hospital with 24/7 emergency services. It is situated in the north of the beautiful Värmland county. We serve a population of 40,000 inhabitants in the municipalities of Torsby, Sunne, Hagfors and Munkfors. Our goal is to deliver high quality medical care that contributes to a world-class quality of life for our citizens.

The hospital has a medical department and a department of surgery, orthopaedics and anaesthetics. There are 48 inpatient beds on three wards and an ICU with 4 beds. We have a modern operating theatre and an endoscopy unit. Our emergency department is open 24/7 and staffed by medical, surgical and orthopaedic doctors on call. We also have an outpatients department with specialised clinics.

In the medical department we take care of patients with a broad spectrum  of medical conditions, both as inpatients and in the outpatient department. We have a special focus on cardiology, stroke patients, gastroenterology, endocrinology and rheumatology. We also have a mobile team delivering care to palliative patients and patients with advanced medical illnesses.

Torsby hospital is a pleasant workplace with several advantages. We are known for our friendly atmosphere and excellent cooperation between the different staff categories and the different departments. The decision making paths are short and efficient. We are constantly striving to ensure the best possible working environment for all staff at the hospital. These features are the basis that enables us to deliver high quality care to our patients.

Work with us - Region Värmland

Living in Torsby you can enjoy life in the countryside while at the same time having all necessary facilities for daily life and all school types in close proximity.

As a specialist in internal medicine, you will be part of our team of seven consultants and about 14 junior doctors in training. You should have a broad knowledge in internal medicine and feel comfortable in treating acutely ill patients with a wide range of medical ailments.  You will be responsible for the care of inpatients on the ward and outpatients in your clinic. At the clinic, there is the opportunity for you to focus on certain groups of patients. After sufficient introduction you will also be taking part in the on call roster as a backup for the junior college on call. You will get the chance to advance to a consultant position. There is also the possibility to complete subspecialty training.

We can offer you:

    Work at a small hospital with full emergency services, short decision making paths and outstanding working atmosphere.
    A teaching hospital that has been recognised for its high quality
    A management team that cares about you
    Nice accommodation close to nature
    Help with finding accommodation
    Good connections to the international airports in Oslo and Stockholm
    A high quality of life with the possibility to engage in a wide range of outdoor activities from fishing and hunting to mountain biking and skiing
    A health promoting workplace with access to wellness activities and wellness allowances

Read more at Work with us.

Language training and introduction program

We offer Swedish language course and introduction program.

We can share knowledge, experience and clear strategies for handling new challenges and for integrating quickly into the Swedish society. We can also offer help for you and your family with relocation and with establishing yourselves. Read more at Ny i Värmland.

Your rights and benefits as an employee

The following are some of our rights and benefits:

    All our employees receive at least 25 days of holiday, and as a new employee your paid leave will accrue from day one.
    We give employees the possibility of learning and developing their skills in the daily work.
    We take care of you as an employee and we also provide opportunities for a life-long financial security for you. We have good benefits and different insurances.
    Most of our services have the possibility of flexible working hours.
    We want to promote health and wellness for all employees. An important part of the health promotion work is the wellness allowance.

A more pleasant life in Värmland

    An open and welcoming environment, an international business community, a strong storytelling tradition, inspiring culture, sports and outdoor life and an innovative university.
    Read more about Värmland.
    Read more about Nordvärmland.

You are welcome to contact us on email for more information:

Jeanette Arvidsson jeanette.e.arvidsson@regionvarmland.se, Head of department.

Tanja Ihle, tanja.ihle@regionvarmland.se, Specialist internal medicin.

Rekrytering.utland@regionvarmland.se  for questions about our Swedish course, relocation and introduction.

Welcome to Region Värmland!

title: Sous Chef
description:
Dream Big - Join Basta New Opening in Västerås! 🍕

About Basta

Basta is more than a restaurant—it's a place where people connect. Inspired by the warmth and spirit of Italy, we bring together great food, genuine hospitality and passionate teams to create memorable experiences for every guest. Whether you're in the kitchen or on the floor, you'll be part of a team that brings energy, personality and pride to everything it does.

Part of Urban Italian Group

Urban Italian Group is one of Europe's fastest-growing hospitality groups, bringing together distinctive restaurant brands, passionate people and memorable guest experiences. As we continue to grow, so do the opportunities for those who want to build their careers with us.

The Role

As Sous Chef, you will work closely with the Head Chef to keep the kitchen organised, consistent and performing well during busy service. This is a hands-on role for someone who takes pride in doing things properly, supports the team, and knows how to maintain quality and standards under pressure.

What you’ll be doing

    

Supporting food preparation, production and service across the kitchen.

    

Making sure dishes are prepared and presented to recipe, portion and quality standards.

    

Monitoring food quality during service and correcting issues when needed.

    

Supporting, training and coaching BOH team members.

    

Stepping in to lead the kitchen in the Head Chef’s absence.

    

Helping with ordering, stock control, waste management and food cost awareness.

    

Maintaining hygiene, health & safety and kitchen compliance standards.

You’ll thrive in this role if you

    

Previous experience as a Sous Chef, Junior Sous Chef or strong CDP ready for the next step.

    

Experience working in busy, high-volume restaurant kitchens.

    

Strong attention to detail around food quality, prep, presentation and standards.

    

A calm, hands-on leadership style and the ability to support the team during service.

    

Good understanding of hygiene, food safety, stock control and waste management.

    

Excellent time management and the ability to stay organised under pressure.

    

Pride in building a positive, hard-working and professional kitchen culture.

Our culture and values

We believe we work with people, not food. Guided by our values of Trust, Inclusion, Passion and Entrepreneurship, we’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels welcome, valued and empowered to grow.

What do we offer?

    

Be part of one of Europe’s fastest-growing hospitality groups.

    

Build your career across multiple brands and countries.

    

Work alongside talented people who genuinely love hospitality.

    

International career opportunities.

    

Referral bonus scheme.

    

Shared accommodation (where applicable).

    

Friends for life.

Sound like your kind of place?

If you are excited by joining us, we would love to hear from you. Bring your energy, personality and passion for Italian food to Basta.

Urban Italian Group is committed to fair and inclusive recruitment. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds. If you need a reasonable adjustment at any stage of the selection process, please tell our Talent Acquisition Team.

title: Senior Scientist – Scientific Services
description:
Rarity Bioscience develops ultrasensitive molecular diagnostics based on our proprietary superRCA® technology, enabling detection of rare mutations that standard methods miss. As our portfolio of pharma and clinical collaborations grows, so does our Scientific Services team - and we are now looking for a Senior Scientist to help lead that work.

The role

You will lead and contribute to scientific collaboration projects in molecular diagnostics and cancer genomics, from initial dialogue to final report. In this role, you combine scientific leadership with involvement across assay development, performance evaluation, sample testing, data interpretation, and customer dialogue. You bring enough scientific depth to be a trusted discussion partner in cancer genetics, while also being practical enough to plan experiments, assess results, provide guidance to junior colleagues, and help move projects from first dialogue to final report or publication. In addition, the role can be expected to include some hands-on lab work to build familiarity with our assays, workflows, and daily operations, with the level of involvement varying depending on project needs.

Key responsibilities:

    

Coordinate and execute service projects involving internal laboratory teams, academic researchers, clinical collaborators, and pharmaceutical partners.

    

Plan, perform, analyze, and report laboratory work across oncology, precision medicine, and mutation detection projects.

    

Analyze, interpret, and report experimental and genomic data in relation to clinical data, somatic mutation profiles, and biomarker analyses.

    

Present results to customers and collaborators, and represent Rarity at scientific conferences and meetings.

    

Act as a scientific and technical subject matter expert in assay development, cancer genomics, and molecular diagnostics.

    

Supervise and mentor junior team members in daily operations and project work.

    

Contribute to scientific publications, technical reports, and conference abstracts.

    

Maintain technical documentation in line with Rarity's QMS and applicable regulatory requirements.

You will be part of a small, cross-functional team where the distance between a question and a decision is short. The role is based at our office, soon located at Uppsala Business Park, where all functions will be under one roof. Around 30 people today, growing steadily - the kind of place where you know everyone, and where what you do is visible.

Who you are

You have deep knowledge of cancer genetics, built through years of working with cancer cohorts, patient data, and somatic mutation profiles. You know what variant assessment means in practice, and you can have a real scientific conversation with a pharma R&D team or a clinical researcher without losing the thread.

You can lead a project and bring people along with you. You are structured, logical, and not easily derailed but you can change course when the data tells you to. You want to work on something that matters, in a team where no one is afraid of getting their hands dirty and everyone pulls in the same direction.

Qualifications:

    

PhD in Molecular Biology, Cancer Biology, Genetics, Genomics, or a related discipline, with approximately five years of relevant experience in academia, a clinical setting, or industry. Strong MSc candidates with equivalent depth will be considered.

    

Solid expertise in cancer genetics and molecular oncology, including experience working with cancer cohorts and interpreting patient and clinical data.

    

Experience with variant calling, variant assessment, and interpretation of NGS data.

    

Hands-on experience with molecular biology techniques such as qPCR, digital PCR, RCA, NGS-based applications, and/or flow cytometry.

    

Experience in assay development, optimization, and validation.

    

Strong data analysis skills — R or equivalent is an advantage.

    

Excellent written and verbal communication in English.

    

Experience presenting scientific results to customers, collaborators, or at conferences.

    

Experience collaborating with pharmaceutical companies or translational research groups is an advantage.

Yes, it is a long list. But then again, we are not just any company - we are a team pushing the boundaries of what mutation detection can do, and we are looking for someone who is genuinely excited about that.

How to apply

If this sounds like the right next step for you, submit your application no later than mid-October. We review applications on a rolling basis, so do not wait too long.

Questions about the role or the process? Reach out to Sandra Bydell Sveder, Senior Recruitment Consultant at SallyQ (sandra.sveder@sallyq.se, 0763 19 96 88).

title: Lead Engineer, Datacenters
description:
Are you ready to shape and win major data centre projects? Join Eltel in a central role where your technical expertise and commercial insight will influence solutions, working methods and our future data centre offering.

What will my responsibilities be?As Lead Engineer – Data Centers, you will help build Eltel’s Data Centers and Emerging Services business. You will turn complex customer enquiries, drawings and technical specifications into deliverable solutions, robust cost estimates and competitive tenders.

Working closely with customers, suppliers, procurement and project teams, you will provide technical leadership from tender to delivery. You will also help build the capabilities and partnerships needed for Eltel’s long-term growth in data centres.

Example of tasks and responsibilities:

    Lead technical reviews of customer enquiries and tenders.
    Analyse drawings, bills of quantities and specifications to assess scope, costs, resources and risks.
    Prepare cost estimates and develop installation methods, production plans and standardised ways of working.
    Support supplier selection, project mobilisation and complex technical decisions.
    Act as the technical point of contact in customer presentations and tender negotiations.
    Build strong partnerships and strengthen Eltel’s long-term data centre expertise and offering.

The position is based in Sweden, preferably Bromma, although the right expertise matters most - we are flexible. Frequent travel within Sweden and the Nordic region is required, and you will collaborate with colleagues across Eltel, including Finland. The role can be shaped to suit your strengths and interests.

Why should I choose Eltel?This is your opportunity to play a key role in a strategic growth area, influence technology and business from the outset, and work on major, complex projects. You will work where technology meets business—from early customer dialogue and tendering to production planning and project support. With processes and offerings still evolving, your expertise will have a visible impact.

Your manager, Tobias, is calm, clear and unpretentious. He sets direction without micromanaging.

At Eltel, you will help secure critical infrastructure and turn digitalisation and electrification into reality. We offer varied work, responsibility and strong development opportunities within a stable, nationwide organisation. Safety is always our priority—and our open culture and highly skilled colleagues make us stronger together.

Who are you?You bring extensive experience in power engineering, data centres or major industrial installations, together with a strong understanding of large installation contracts. You quickly make sense of complex materia and turn it into clear recommendations, cost estimates and decisions.

Requirements:

    At least ten years’ experience in power engineering, data centres or major industrial installations.
    Experience of EPC, design-and-build or installation contracts.
    Proven expertise in cost estimation, tendering and risk assessment.
    The ability to analyse drawings, bills of quantities and technical specifications.
    Experience of working with international customers and contractors.
    Strong written and spoken English.

Experience of hyperscale data centre projects, commissioning or start-up is an advantage. Swedish language skills are also beneficial.

You are analytical, structured and self-motivated, with the confidence to take ownership of complex technical and commercial matters. Commercially aware and collaborative, you build trust with customers, suppliers and project teams—and enjoy helping to shape something new.

Additional information

    This is a permanent, full-time position, beginning with a six-month probationary period.
    Employment is subject to satisfactory background screening, including checks relating to legal disputes and financial standing.

Eltel employs people of different ages, religions, nationalities, sexual orientations and abilities. This diversity contributes to our success and is a source of pride. Can you help us broaden our diversity even further? We would be delighted to hear from you. In particular, we would like to see more women in technical roles.

My name is Mia and I am responsible for this recruitment process. If you have any questions, please contact me at maria.jungefors@eltelnetworks.se.

We look forward to receiving your application! ⚡

Eltel är den ledande leverantören av tjänster för kritisk infrastruktur. Vi designar, planerar, bygger och säkrar driften av el- och kommunikationsnätverk i hela Sverige på uppdrag av våra kunder som i huvudsak är operatörer, nätägare och myndigheter.

Vi är stolta över att skapa värde för våra kunder och för samhället i stort – vi på Eltel kombinerar kunskap och kompetens med en praktisk inställning till arbete. Vi har ambitionen att vara den bästa arbetsplatsen för dig som gillar utmaningar och som vill ta ett samhällsansvar. Vi söker nu fler engagerade människor som vill bli en del av vårt företag.

Vi undanber oss vänligt men bestämt kontakt från bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt andra försäljare av ytterligare tjänster kopplat till våra rekryteringar. Vi har upphandlat de tjänster vi behöver. Vid andra frågor; kontakta oss centralt på rekrytering@eltelnetworks.se.

title: Platform Engineer
description:
Hej 3D Platform Engineer,

Do you want to furnish the future with innovative solutions?

With us, you can feel at home in your work while sharing that feeling with millions of people around the world. We encourage you to stand up for yourself and others, creating an environment where everyone feels welcome. We invite you to open new doors, discover new tech possibilities, embrace mistakes, and grow from them. As our 3D Platform Engineer, you’ll have many opportunities to try things you’ve never done before.



Your new job

You are a Software Engineer or 3D Developer who enjoys working across cloud services, developer tooling, backend systems, and 3D pipelines. You turn complex 3D challenges into scalable, reliable platform capabilities.

We’re looking for a 3D Platform Engineer to build the shared capabilities behind IKEA’s next generation of 3D digital planning and product experiences. You will transform complex CAD and PLM product data into reliable, scalable 3D assets and services—covering tessellation, mesh optimization, LOD generation, and preservation of visual and geometric fidelity. Your work will make high-quality 3D product data easier to use across customer-facing planning solutions, content production, and product development. On a typical week, you will:

    Design, build, test, operate, and lifecycle-manage reusable 3D platform services and applications using JavaScript, TypeScript, C#, C++, and Python.
    Translate business and user needs into clear technical designs, working software, and well-defined development briefs.
    Evaluate architectures, tools, and workflows to improve platform security, performance, availability, reliability, maintainability, and developer experience.
    Collaborate in agile and DevOps teams across product and engineering areas to integrate shared 3D capabilities into planning, content, and product-development workflows, with clear communication and shared delivery commitments.
    Provide technical direction for core 3D solutions, guide consumers in using platform capabilities and good practices, and collaborate effectively with internal teams, technology partners, and suppliers.
    Build automated CAD-to-mesh pipelines that preserve product structure, metadata, geometry, materials, and instancing from PLM and CAD sources.
    Develop and validate mesh-processing workflows for repair, tessellation, simplification, LOD generation, and delivery of high-fidelity and optimized asset variants.
    Benchmark and integrate commercial and open-source technologies, building integration layers around CAD and geometry SDKs that enable scalable cloud-based 3D processing services.



What we’d like you to bring to the table

As a 3D Platform Engineer, you combine strong software engineering with practical knowledge of 3D data, pipelines, and runtime needs. You can work across the full flow—from CAD and PLM sources to optimized assets and scalable services. You should also bring:

    A strong understanding of computer graphics, real-time and offline rendering, and production-ready 3D asset pipelines.
    Hands-on experience developing software products for 3D, computer graphics, or VFX workflows.
    Knowledge of product-development workflows from CAD tools such as Revit, SolidWorks, or CATIA through digital content creation, visualization, and rendering.
    Understanding of asset creation, materials, texturing, lighting, rigging, and scene composition; experience with OpenUSD, MaterialX, or glTF is a plus.
    A platform and DevOps mindset, with experience building, operating, and improving business-critical services in an agile environment.
    A degree in computer science, media technology, digital media, or a related field—or equivalent practical experience.
    Strong C++ skills, including native SDK integration, performance profiling, debugging, and maintainable adapters for third-party libraries.
    Practical knowledge of CAD data, assembly structures, exact geometry, tessellation, and conversion to polygonal meshes in a PLM or PDM context.
    Experience with mesh repair, topology, normals, tangents, UVs, materials, instancing, simplification, and automated LOD generation—balancing fidelity with file size, processing time, memory, and rendering performance.

Our technology landscape includes Azure, Terraform, Docker, OpenAPI, Three.js, React, JavaScript, TypeScript, C++, Python, MongoDB, Neo4j, PLM platforms, CAD and geometry SDKs, and mesh-processing libraries. You do not need to know them all- curiosity and a willingness to learn matter just as much.

It’s a plus if you also bring:

    Experience with enterprise PLM or PDM platforms, CAD translation, or geometry SDKs.
    Experience with mesh-processing or optimization libraries and open 3D formats such as OpenUSD or glTF.

Be yourself, a 3D Platform Engineer, and more!

title: Business Development Engineer
description:
Welcome to SSC Space, an exciting workplace for those passionate about science and technology in general, and space in particular.

With space organizations, research institutes, institutional and commercial actors as customers, we offer specialist expertise in satellite communications, space consulting services, rocket and balloon systems, flight test services, satellite propulsion systems, and much more.

For more than 50 years, SSC Space has been a leading provider of sounding rocket and stratospheric balloon launches from Esrange Space Center. We are now looking for a Business Development Engineer who wants to help develop the next chapter of this business.

This is a technically oriented business development role where you will combine customer engagement, commercial development and technical coordination. You will build relationships with existing and potential customers and develop business opportunities connected to student programs, sounding rockets and stratospheric balloons.

You will be involved throughout the sales process, from identifying opportunities and shaping service offerings to developing proposals, negotiating contracts and supporting long-term customer relationships. The role has an international scope and includes customer visits, conferences and collaboration with technical experts across SSC Space.

REQUIREMENTS

We believe you are commercially minded, technically curious and comfortable building relationships across different cultures and professional environments. You can contribute to technical discussions while maintaining a clear focus on customer needs and business opportunities.

You also have:

    A university degree in engineering, science or another relevant technical field, or equivalent professional experience.
    The ability to understand technical concepts and communicate them clearly to different audiences.
    Strong business acumen and an interest in developing commercially viable solutions.
    Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
    Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage several activities and stakeholders simultaneously.
    A proactive, solution-oriented approach and the ability to move opportunities forward.
    The ability to work independently while contributing to a collaborative team.
    Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word and PowerPoint.
    A genuine interest in science, technology and space.
    Fluency in written and spoken English.

Swedish language skills and previous experience in business development, technical sales or another customer-facing commercial role are considered an advantage.

As the role involves international customer engagement, you should be willing and able to travel regularly.

RESPONSIBILITIES

    Develop and maintain long-term relationships with existing and potential customers.
    Identify and cultivate new business opportunities within science and research in space.
    Develop and expand business related to student programs, sounding rockets and stratospheric balloons.
    Understand customer needs and translate them into relevant service offerings and technical solutions.
    Coordinate commercial and technical input from specialists across SSC Space.
    Manage sales opportunities throughout the full process, from initial customer dialogue to proposal, negotiation and contract closure.
    Prepare proposals, presentations and other customer-facing material.
    Maintain an accurate sales pipeline and provide regular status reports and forecasts.
    Visit customers internationally and represent SSC Space at conferences, meetings and industry events.
    Contribute to both short-term sales activities and long-term business planning.

BENEFITS

We offer you

    A unique opportunity to contribute to a wide range of projects and play an active role in both the Swedish and international space industry.
    An excellent opportunity for personal and career development.
    An exciting, international workplace characterized by an open atmosphere and proud employees all over the world.



Additional benefits

    In addition to vacation and traditional public holidays, we offer extra paid leave throughout the year, such as time off between Christmas and New Year, Ascension Day, amounting to 6-11 extra days depending on the calendar.
    Wellness allowance of SEK 5,000 per year.
    Health benefits such as voluntary health insurance and regular health checks for eligible employees.
    Access to a benefit bike through a tax-efficient leasing program.
    Support for employee-driven activities that promote connection, health, and culture across teams.
    Collective Agreement, including good pensions plans, parental pay, and insurance.



LOCATION

This is a full-time, permanent position based at Esrange Space Center outside of Kiruna.

  

NEXT STEP

If this opportunity sparks your interest, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible! We review applications continuously and will conduct interviews throughout the process.

You can submit your application up until 2026-10-12, which is the latest possible date for consideration. Please note, however, that the position may be filled before this date, and the advertisement may therefore close earlier. This allows us to manage the process efficiently and give each application the attention it deserves.

When applying, please include your CV. While you are welcome to include a brief personal note or letter, our evaluation will primarily focus on your skills and qualifications as outlined in your CV, ensuring a fair and unbiased recruitment process.

This position requires approved pre-employment screening. These controls are based on the role that you will fulfill within the company. Additional requirements regarding citizenship may apply.



We help Earth benefit from space

SSC Space is a leading global provider of advanced space services, with more than 50 years of experience. We help space organizations, research institutes, commercial and institutional actors from all over the world to get access to space.

With local presence on all continents and about 700 committed employees, we offer specialist expertise in satellite communications and satellite control services, spacecraft operations, rocket and balloon systems, launch services and flight test services, as well as engineering, operations and consultancy services for space missions.

We help Earth benefit from Space. Learn more at sscspace.com

title: QA Engineering Leader | Range Operations
description:
Hej QA Engineering Leader,

Do you want to furnish the future with innovative solutions?

With us, you can feel at home in your work while sharing that feeling with millions of people around the world. We encourage you to stand up for yourself and others, creating an environment where everyone feels welcome. We invite you to open new doors, discover new tech possibilites, embrace mistakes, and grow from them. As our QA Engineering Leader, you’ll have many opportunities to try things you’ve never done before.



Your new job

We’re looking for a QA Engineering Leader who wants to solve complex, real-world problems to make life at home simpler. Join us on our journey as we level up our technology to enhance everyday experiences. Your primary focus will be on leading and continuously refining the quality and test automation approach within Range experience together with the other Software Engineering Leaders and Specialists.  

You will also be sharing your work in the wider Range Areas and you’ll report to the Quality Platform QA Manager. The impact of your work will touch homes and hearts around the world.

On a typical day, you will:

    Develop QA test plans and define acceptance criteria for both built and purchased software solutions.  
    Plan, coordinate, and lead QA activities to ensure testing is executed effectively and delivered on time.  
    Coach and mentor members of digital product teams on QA frameworks, methodologies, and best practices.  
    Drive clarity, consistency, and quality in requirements across product and platform teams.  
    Champion test data creation, mocking, and test automation as the preferred testing approach, always balancing cost, value, and efficiency.

    Collaborate closely with engineering and platform leaders to ensure features are implemented with quality assurance built into the delivery process.  
    Support product and platform teams in working in a decoupled way to improve software quality and enable effective interface-level testing.  
    Act as the subject matter expert on specialist QA disciplines such as performance testing, penetration testing, and high-availability assurance when needed.

What we’d like you to bring to the table

As a person you see the joy of sharing your knowledge and experience with your colleagues across different teams. Being curious and innovative is at the core of everything you do, and you know that making mistakes sometimes is part of your own development and learning journey.

You bring extensive experience and knowledge in software development and are fully familiar with agile/DevOps practices and tooling, and how the quality aspect is an integrated part of the development. Ideally, you have experience in building test automation frameworks and building their usage in an organization of cross-functional product teams.

You are an experienced leader with the ability to coach our product teams, testers and developers alike around test automation as an integrated part in software development, helping to ensure that we use our resources in the best way to achieve the strongest outcome.

You enjoy an agile, iterative and structured way of working and achieving results together with a team in a flexible environment but also have a strong individual drive to deliver high-quality results on time. You have great communication and networking skills and are fluent in written and spoken English.

The role as a QA Engineering Leader requires you to:

    Hold a degree in Computer Science or a related engineering discipline, or equivalent experience.  
    Have at least 2 years of hands-on software engineering experience.  
    Have at least 5 years of hands-on experience working with QA processes, testing methodologies, and QA tooling.  
    Demonstrate strong knowledge of modern digital product development principles, including aligned autonomy, Conway’s Law, product decomposition, DevOps, automation, blue-green deployments, and automated regression testing.  
    Coach and support engineering teams in adopting quality-first ways of working and embedding quality throughout the development lifecycle.  
    Advocate for early defect prevention through practices such as automation, clear requirements, and decoupled architectures.  
    Communicate effectively with stakeholders at different levels, both verbally and in writing.  
    Be a trusted subject matter expert in quality assurance, providing guidance on specialist QA approaches when needed.  
    Have experience of building and maintaining modern test automation frameworks for web using Playwright, Cypress or similar, including custom framework design in JavaScript/TypeScript with deep CI/CD integration via GitHub Actions

It’s a plus if you also have experience with:

    Using Sentry, Splunk or similar tools for monitoring and real-time error tracking
    Procurement processes and quality assurance of off-the-shelf or SaaS solutions.  
    Non-functional requirement (NFR) quality assurance and performance testing practices.

We welcome your application

title: Senior Engineer
description:
Senior Engineer

Simployer · Stockholm · Full-time

About the role

As a Senior Engineer, you'll own the technical direction of your team's domain. You'll decide where the boundaries go, how services communicate, and how we know that what we ship works with the rest of the platform. You'll work in an autonomous team where you're trusted to shape the architecture, not just deliver on a spec.

What you'll do

    Define, evolve and defend domain boundaries, aggregates and bounded contexts using domain-driven design, and make sure the model reflects how the business actually works.
    Design, build and operate event-driven flows in production, from event modelling and schema design to monitoring, failure handling and recovery.
    Introduce and maintain consumer-driven contract testing in CI so that teams can change their services with confidence that shared interfaces still hold.
    Investigate architectural alternatives, make decisions, and document and justify them (for example through ADRs), on your own initiative rather than waiting for a specification.
    Form and communicate a view on where your domain's architecture should go over the next year or two, and bring colleagues along with you.
    Pick up new technologies and patterns when the problem calls for it and take them all the way into production.

What we're looking for

    Recent, hands-on experience applying domain-driven design in production systems, including owning decisions on boundaries and aggregates.
    Experience building and running event-driven architecture in production, not just consuming events built by others.
    A modern approach to testing, including practical experience with contract testing (e.g. Pact or similar) as part of a CI pipeline.
    A track record of making and owning architectural decisions independently, including in situations where requirements were unclear.
    Evidence that you learn new technology on your own and apply it in real work, without needing formal training or central guidance.
    Comfort taking ownership in an autonomous team and setting technical direction.

About Simployer

At Simployer – We simplify being a great employer!

With +12 000 customers and 1.2 million users across our product lines, Simployer is the largest HRM cloud provider in Scandinavia. We are 300 employees across five cities in three countries.

Simployer helps organisations develop and take care of their employees, and offers digital HRM services that streamline internal routines and processes. Our product portfolio has solutions for every part of the employee journey.

How to apply

Send your CV and a short note about an architectural decision you made and why. We review applications continuously. [Contact person, deadline]

    Be an active member of the Intercom Solutions management team and contribute to building and developing the department as a whole.

Who are we looking for?

We're looking for someone who thrives in a collaborative setting and takes initiative to drive things forward. You enjoy working across disciplines, sharing knowledge, and taking responsibility for your part of the product development journey. You're proactive, results-oriented, and motivated by seeing your teams designs come to life in real products.

What we need you to bring:

    Degree in Electrical/Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent experience
    Experience as a line manager for hardware engineers in a technical environment, including people development and setting and maintaining long-term strategic goals.

    Ability to work collaboratively across functions and communicate effectively with diverse stakeholders
    A proactive approach with high initiative and a drive to deliver quality results
    Fluent in English (required for daily work)

What Axis has to offer

We are a world leader in network video, where cutting-edge technology meets global impact. Here, you'll contribute to meaningful projects that shape the future of security - developing solutions used worldwide.

As a fast-growing company, we offer exciting career opportunities. You'll grow professionally through continuous learning, supported by a collaborative team that values creativity, innovation, and work-life balance.

This position is based at our Lund HQ Campus, including the impressive Grenden building, which offers a dynamic environment with spaces crafted to encourage collaboration - whether through informal "fika" chats, formal meetings, or after-hours activities. This is a hybrid role, offering flexibility to balance on-site and remote work.

Your well-being matters to us. We offer a range of benefits, including a company bonus, Friday cake, wellness allowance, health insurance - and even your own Axis bicycle.

Ready to act?

Axis is a company realizing the benefits of a diverse workforce. We know that diversity in groups creates a better working environment and promotes creativity, something that is fundamental for our success. We welcome all applications.

We also want to ensure an inclusive recruitment process - if you need any adjustments or accommodations, please don't hesitate to let us know.

title: Fullstack Engineer
description:
TL;DR

We're looking for a Fullstack Engineer to ship features end-to-end — from database to UI. You'll build rock-solid systems that connect to CRMs, email providers, calendars, and sales tools, plus the interfaces reps use every day, while keeping latency low and reliability high. Must be obsessed with clean architecture, fast systems, and extreme ownership.

Why join

We’re a small, talent-dense team of engineers building a generation-defining company from Stockholm. We value speed, rigour, and extreme ownership. If you're obsessed with product, thrive in ambiguity, and want to push the edge of what agents can do, you’ll feel at home.

You'll work on hard problems across the stack - building resilient integrations with enterprise systems, optimizing database queries, reducing API latency, and shipping the interfaces sales reps live in every day. Not another CRUD app.

We're backed by founders and operators behind Lovable, OpenAI, Tandem Health, and Neo4j. Our customers across 10 countries report 90% less prospecting time, 3x market coverage, and 2x customer meetings.

What you'll do (responsibilities)

In one sentence: Ship features end-to-end — from the infrastructure that makes AI agents reliable, fast, and scalable to the interfaces reps use daily.

    Own features across the stack: Build complete slices — database schema, API, and React UI — and ship them to customers
    Own integrations end-to-end: Design and build integrations with CRMs, email, calendars, and sales tools
    Reduce latency relentlessly: Optimize database queries, implement caching strategies, and eliminate bottlenecks
    Scale the system: Design for horizontal scaling, handle increased load, and maintain <200ms response times
    Ship fast: Test ideas, run experiments, iterate daily on real customer feedback
    Shape the architecture: Make foundational decisions on database structure, API design, and system patterns

Who you are

    Cracked engineer obsessed with building great software
    Comfortable with ambiguity, early-stage chaos, and fast iteration
    Thrive on new tech - LLMs, knowledge graphs, agents, you name it
    Experience with API integrations, webhooks, OAuth flows, and third-party systems
    Comfortable across the stack: TypeScript on both sides, React on the front
    Care deeply about performance, observability, and operational excellence
    Care more about solving problems than polishing abstractions
    Fully committed to the mission: not "just a job"

What we offer

    A team of obsessed engineers, full of speed, rigour, and grit
    Mission-driven, no-BS culture: experiment, ship, learn
    Meaningful equity through qualified employee stock options (QESO) from day one
    Fully on-site in Stockholm - we believe in working together
    Top-tier compensation package

Our stack

    Frontend: React
    Backend: Typescript, Neo4j, PostgreSQL, Node.js, Express
    Infrastructure: Docker, Google Cloud
    Agent: Typescript, LLMs (Claude, OpenAI, Gemini), Mastra

About Spiich Labs

Spiich is the agentic platform for sales teams. Reps focus on the human work — building relationships, building trust, and closing deals — while Spiich agents handle everything else: prospecting, lead generation, CRM updates, meeting prep, follow-ups, and everything in between. The system integrates knowledge graphs, memory, and agentic workflows to deliver real help - not just summarisation or search. We're backed by founders and operators behind Lovable, OpenAI, Tandem Health, and Neo4j.

How we hire

    Submit your application
    Intro call with the team
    Technical interview
    Take-home exercise
    Join us for trial work lasting 2 days on-site. We'll see how you tick and you get to meet the team and explore whether joining Spiich feels right for you.

We move fast — the full process typically takes under two weeks.

How to Apply

Drop us a line at filip@spiich.ai with your GitHub/LinkedIn, a note on why this excites you, and your proudest achievement. No CV needed.

title: Transport Center Planner

    Warehouse operations teams
    System and data administration teams

    2+ years experience in transport or logistics operations, with active involvement in planning, reporting, or stakeholder communication across European markets.

title: Senior Mechanical Plant Design Engineer
description:
The opportunity

As a Senior Mechanical Plant Design Engineer within Plant mechanical, you will work in a collaborative engineering environment where problem‑solving, learning, and sound technical judgement are key. Within Plant Engineering, this role covers several disciplines, including electrical, mechanical, civil, and structural engineering, with a primary focus on mechanical design. Knowledge of other engineering areas is an advantage. The position offers the opportunity to contribute to HVDC station design through engineering design, planning, risk assessments, resource coordination, and technical project execution.

You will be supported by a strong multidisciplinary team and encouraged to take responsibility while continuously developing your technical and professional skills.

“In this position, you’ll work with complex and interesting challenges, collaborate closely across disciplines, and contribute to solutions that make a real impact. You are never alone — teamwork and knowledge sharing are fundamental to how we succeed.” — Lars‑Ove Mellberg, Mechanical Plant Design Manager  

This role is based in Ludvika or Västerås, Sweden.

How you’ll make an impact

    Lead mechanical plant design activities for complex HVDC projects, ensuring high-quality multidisciplinary engineering coordination.
    Develop robust and cost-effective technical solutions in line with customer requirements, contracts, budgets, and schedules.
    Drive engineering deliverables within your area of expertise and provide technical support during testing, installation, and commissioning.
    Ensure compliance with safety standards, quality requirements, and risk mitigation practices throughout the project lifecycle.
    Prepare work plans, cost estimates, and engineering schedules, and support scope and budget reviews.
    Collaborate closely with project teams, tender teams, customers, contractors, authorities, and supply chain partners.
    Independently manage technical activities, solve complex engineering challenges, and support project execution with limited supervision.
    Mentor and review the work of junior engineers while contributing to technical development and best practices within the team.

Your background

We know that no candidate meets every requirement. If you are motivated by this role and meet many of the criteria below, we strongly encourage you to apply.  

Ideally, you bring:

    Experience in mechanical plant design, including preparation of documents and design concepts aligned with customer needs, relevant standards, and internal guidelines.
    Knowledge of electrical power transformation systems is beneficial but not mandatory.
    Experience or interest in 3D modeling of equipment layouts and close collaboration with internal teams and external partners.
    Experience and/or knowledge in BIM coordination between external and internal partners.
    Familiarity with cost estimates like bill of quantities and engineering hours.
    Experience with CAD tools such as Siemens NX, Revit, and PLM systems like Teamcenter is beneficial, and we support further learning and development where needed.
    Good communication skills in English, both written and spoken, and a willingness to collaborate across cultures and disciplines.

More about us

We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together.​

Our benefits offering for our roles generally includes: ​

    Collective agreement, occupational pension & possibility of salary exchange to pension (for ITP1 and ITP2)​
    Group life insurance and additional insurances.​

    Health insurance incl. dental, spectacles & contact lenses allowance (employee pay 140 sek/month via salary deduction)​
    Psychological support program​​
    Supplementary compensation for parental leave​
    Various trainings and education supporting employee development ​
    Internal career possibilities both within Sweden and globally​
    Employee Benefit Portal with thousands of discounts and perks​

The benefits listed above are an excerpt only and may vary depending on job grade, location and contract type. Eligibility is subject to local regulations.​

title: Automotive System Engineer
description:
ARE YOU READY TO REINVENT MOBILITY? JOIN US AT EDAG AND BE PART OF OUR AGILE AND INTERNATIONAL TEAM

EDAG, one of the leading global engineering experts with heritage from the automotive industry, serves its customers with complete development responsibility, ranging from concept work to even building prototypes. Whether it is software development, development of future mobility solutions, sustainability, design engineering, quality assurance, manufacturing engineering or various other engineering requests, EDAG has for more than 50 years successfully helped its clients taking the next technology leap.

We at EDAG simply claim to be our customer’s global mobility engineering experts!

EDAG Engineering Scandinavia AB is the Scandinavian subsidiary of the EDAG Group. With an origin from Gothenburg, we have naturally become an important partner to the western region of Sweden. More and more customers are discovering our ability to deliver local engineering capabilities within a wide range of areas – not seldom in combination with other global EDAG sites, colleagues, and competences to accommodate larger projects and undertakings.

We are looking for System/Requirement Engineers who will work on E-mobility, Electronics and Software Development areas, such as Autonomous Drive, Power Electronics, Active Safety, Functional Safety, Cyber Security, Vehicle Mode Management, Infotainment Systems, and more. You will be part of a global team of dynamic and innovative team that is preferred solution partner for the industry.

Your Responsibilities

    Defining and analyzing system requirements and technical specifications
    Reviewing electronics/software requirements-specifications
    Managing suppliers in an international environment
    Designing and developing test requirements-specifications
    Responsible for issuing and changing management on developed models
    Securing deliveries are ready in time, updated and released
    Build and maintain personal network within R&D Organization

Our Requirements

    M.Sc. or B.Sc. degree within Electrical, Electronics, Computer Engineering, or equivalent education
    5 years of working experience in the related field
    Knowledge in developing software algorithms and specifications
    Knowledge in electronics and microprocessors (embedded systems)
    Knowledge in automotive communication protocols (CAN, LIN, MOST, FlexRay and Ethernet)
    Knowledge in Agile Product Development (Scrum, SAFe)
    Knowledge in AUTOSAR
    Knowledge in Automotive Functional Safety Standard ISO 26262
    Knowledge in Automotive Cyber Security Standard ISO 21434
    The experience with commercial vehicles is meritorious.
    Fluent in English (written and spoken), Swedish is meritorious
    B driving license

We Offer:

We can provide you exciting tasks with great colleagues developing your skills in true global EDAG project teams. Your base will be inhouse in our own facilities in Gothenburg, but you will have daily contacts with many more colleagues in other EDAG sites around the globe and of course great customers and suppliers.
