title: Flight Software Systems Engineer for Space Missions
description:
Einleitungstext
Led by Prof. Dr. Thomas Zurbuchen, ETH Zurich | Space brings together space-related research, education and technology development across ETH Zurich. Working with academic, industrial and institutional partners, the initiative develops new space missions, instruments and technologies.

This position is offered as a fixed-term appointment for an initial period of two years, with the possibility of extension.

Projekthintergrund
The objective of this initiative is to establish and grow a centralized pool of space engineering expertise within ETH Zurich | Space. This pool supports ETH Zurich-led space projects and technology programs, strengthening ETH Zurich’s role in the Swiss and international space ecosystem.

The Flight Software Systems Engineer will support a diverse portfolio of small spacecraft, scientific instruments, robotic systems, and technology demonstrators. The work includes resource-constrained missions, integration with externally supplied spacecraft platforms, autonomous functions, and future distributed or coordinated spacecraft concepts. This role interfaces across systems engineering, avionics, payloads, and software development, and coordinates with external platform providers and mission operations teams.

Aufgaben-/Stellenbeschreibung
As part of the specialized resource pool, you will provide flight software and software systems engineering expertise across multiple ETH Zurich space projects. You will contribute from early mission formulation and software architecture through implementation, integration, verification, launch preparation, and operations.

As part of your role, you will:

Take technical ownership of assigned flight software developments and act as the primary software interface to systems engineering, avionics, payload teams, mission operations, and external platform providers.
Translate mission concept of operations into spacecraft behaviors and define flight software architectures and functional decompositions
Allocate hardware-software functions, and define associated software requirements and interfaces.
Translate mission and system requirements into software specifications, interface control documents, operational concepts, and verification plans.
Develop embedded flight software in C and C++ and supporting tools and test scripts (e.g., Python), including device drivers, telemetry and telecommand handling, onboard data management, application software, and fault-management functions.
Integrate flight software with onboard computers, sensors, actuators, payload electronics, communication interfaces, ground systems, and externally supplied spacecraft platforms.
Set up and maintain flat-sat flight software testbeds
Perform software-related trade studies covering processing capacity, memory, timing, bandwidth, autonomy, reliability, and fault tolerance.
Develop real-time, event-driven, autonomous, synchronization, and GNC-related software functions where required.
Establish and maintain software baselines, configuration control, versioning, build automation, continuous integration, release management, and requirements traceability.
Develop and execute flight software unit tests, conduct integration, software-in-the-loop, processor-in-the-loop, hardware-in-the-loop, and system-level verification and validation activities.
Support software risk management, anomaly investigation, non-conformance handling, and technical review boards.
Support spacecraft and payload assembly, integration, and test activities, commissioning, in-flight software updates, telemetry analysis, and mission operations.
Contribute to technical reviews, early-stage mission concepts, proposals, and software feasibility studies.
Provide technical guidance to junior engineers, researchers, and student teams.
Ihr Profil
You have a strong background in embedded and real-time software development combined with systems-level experience in software architecture, requirements engineering, interface definition, integration, and functional verification. You are comfortable working across mission, spacecraft, avionics, payload, software, and operations domains.

We are looking for someone with:

Master’s degree in computer science, electrical engineering, computer engineering, aerospace engineering, robotics, or a related field.
5+ years of professional experience in flight software, embedded software, or mission-critical software systems.
Strong programming skills in C and C++ for resource-constrained embedded targets.
Experience with real-time operating systems, embedded Linux, or bare-metal development.
Experience in software systems engineering, including architecture definition, functional decomposition, hardware-software allocation, requirements management, and interface control.
Ability to translate mission and spacecraft requirements into software specifications, operational concepts, and verification strategies.
Experience integrating flight software with avionics hardware, sensors, actuators, communication buses, payloads, or ground systems.
Understanding of telemetry and telecommand, onboard data handling, timing, autonomy, fault management, and spacecraft operations.
Hands-on experience with software integration, debugging, automated testing, and hardware-in-the-loop environments.
Experience with configuration management, version control, release processes, technical baselines, and requirements traceability.
Ability to assess software-related technical resources, including processing capacity, memory, timing, bandwidth, and reliability margins.
Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary and multicultural teams.
Knowledge of radiation effects, redundancy, memory protection, watchdogs, and FDIR.
Excellent command of English, both written and spoken; German is an advantage but not required.
Additionally, the following characteristics are a plus:

Experience developing flight software for CubeSats, small satellites, scientific instruments, planetary systems, or Class D/Gamma-type missions.
Experience leading or coordinating software-related and functional AIT activities, including test planning, execution, anomaly resolution, and system-level functional verification.
Experience integrating payload software with spacecraft platforms supplied by external industrial partners.
Familiarity with ECSS software engineering and software product assurance standards, NASA software practices, or comparable development frameworks.
Experience with spacecraft protocols and buses such as SpaceWire, CAN, UART, SPI, I²C, Ethernet, or CCSDS-based services.
Experience with flight software frameworks or operating systems such as NASA cFS, F Prime, RTEMS, FreeRTOS, Zephyr, or equivalent.
Experience with autonomous systems, robotic software, relative navigation, formation flying, or distributed spacecraft coordination.
Experience with FPGA or firmware interfaces and hardware-software co-design.
Experience with EGSE, simulators, ground software, commissioning, or in-orbit operations.
Experience collaborating with international partners, space agencies, research institutions, or spacecraft suppliers.
Good knowledge of flight software suppliers.
Wir bieten
A dynamic, international, and interdisciplinary work environment at one of the world’s leading technical universities.
A motivated team sharing a passion for space, science, and engineering.
The opportunity to contribute to space missions from early concept and software architecture through integration, launch, and operations.
Work across spacecraft, payload, robotics, autonomy, and distributed-system applications.

**What if your next job lets you simplify payments for millions, every single day?**

Join Nexi and be part of a collaborative, inclusive workplace where you can learn, grow, and make an impact everyday.  

**About Nex**i  
At Nexi, we're simplifying the future of digital payments. As one of Europe's leading payment companies, we combine international scale with the dynamism of a fast\-moving tech company. With over 9,000 colleagues across more than 25 countries, we're shaping how people and businesses pay and interact every day. Here, your skills, curiosity, and ambition don't just support the business. They help shape what comes next.  

As Customer Service Manager (Acquiring) for Switzerland, you lead and develop the Acquiring Customer Service team (1st \& 2nd Level), ensuring consistently high service quality in a demanding, regulated, and customer\-critical environment. You are accountable for team performance, operational stability, and customer satisfaction—particularly in situations involving escalations, incidents, complaints, or highly frustrated customers. You act as both a people leader and an operational anchor: coaching your team to remain calm, empathetic, and solution\-oriented, while ensuring processes, controls, and service levels are met across all acquiring platforms. You are also a clear contributor in incident and crisis management.  

**Key Responsibilities**

People Leadership \& Team Development

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of 1st \& 2nd Level Acquiring Customer Support Agents, fostering a culture of professionalism, resilience, and customer focus.
* Provide regular coaching, feedback, and performance management, with particular focus on handling complex cases and emotionally charged customer interactions.
* Support onboarding, training, and continuous skill development (technical, regulatory, and communication skills).
* Act as a role model for calm, respectful, and solution\-driven customer communication.


Operational \& Service Management

* Ensure stable day\-to\-day operations of the acquiring customer support function, including workload planning, prioritization, and resource allocation.
* Monitor service levels, response times, and case quality, taking corrective action where required.
* Take ownership of complex escalations and complaints, supporting agents and engaging directly with customers when necessary.
* Ensure end\-to\-end case ownership and consistent customer communication, even across multiple internal interfaces.
* Support Operations team in crisis management during major incidents


Process, Quality \& Compliance

* Ensure adherence to defined processes, regulatory requirements, and internal controls within the acquiring environment.
* Drive continuous improvement of support processes, documentation quality, and knowledge management.
* Review and analyze recurring issues, complaints, or root causes, and initiate sustainable improvements.
* Ensure accurate and complete documentation in CRM and ticketing systems.


Stakeholder \& Interface Management

* Act as the primary escalation and coordination point for Sales, Key Account Management, Operations, Risk, and external partners.
* Collaborate closely with specialist teams ( Switzerland, Germany, Denmark, Croatia) to ensure smooth case resolution and clear ownership.
* Provide transparency to internal stakeholders through regular updates, reporting, and structured communication.


Reporting \& Continuous Improvement

* Track and analyze key KPIs ( tNPS, NPS, case volumes, resolution times, complaint trends, customer feedback).
* Translate insights into concrete action plans for service, quality, and team performance improvements.
* Actively contribute to projects, system enhancements, or process changes impacting customer support.

Professional Background

* Completed commercial or business education, ideally supplemented by leadership training.
* Several years of experience in customer support or service operations, preferably in acquiring, payments, or a regulated financial environment.

title: Chief Executive Officer at Theseus Robotics Group
description:
Chief Executive Officer at Theseus Robotics Group
Company: Theseus Robotics Group AG
Location: Opfikon-Glattbrugg / Zürich, Switzerland
Workload: Full-time (100%), on-site in Zürich
About Theseus Robotics
Theseus Robotics Group AG is a Zürich-based ETH spin-off building autonomous dual-arm robots that restock supermarket shelves overnight, offered to retailers as Robotics-as-a-Service.
Role purpose
The CEO leads the company and is accountable to the Board for turning the business plan into funded, revenue-generating deployments with retailers in Switzerland and abroad.
Key responsibilities
Strategy and financing: set and execute the strategy and business plan; lead fundraising, investor relations and financial planning; report to the Board on performance.
Commercial development: own relationships with retail and logistics customers and partners; take them from demos and pilots to paid deployments; set pricing and go-to-market strategy.
Operations and supply chain: oversee hardware suppliers, manufacturing partners and robot deployment operations in Europe and abroad.
Legal and compliance: oversee contracts, employment, insurance and regulatory matters with external counsel, and make sure the company is ready for each deployment.
Organisation: build and lead the team within the approved budget, set company goals and reporting routines, and align the executive team on priorities.
External representation: represent the company to customers, investors, suppliers, authorities and the public, with travel in Switzerland and abroad.
Required profile
Bachelor's degree (required) in computer science, engineering or a related technical field; a management or business qualification is an advantage.
Fluent English (required); German is an advantage.
At least 3 years in a founder, CEO or managing director role with full P&L responsibility.
Proven record of growing revenue in a technology-driven business, including B2B sales, commercial negotiations and strategic partnerships.
Experience leading hardware, electronics or mechatronics product development, including R&D teams and manufacturing or production facilities.
Experience building and managing international supply chains and supplier networks across Europe, Asia and North America.
Strong background in software, machine learning or data science, enough to lead a robotics/AI company and work credibly with engineers.
Track record in fundraising, investor relations and financial planning.
Experience leading teams of 20+ people across several functions.
Willing to work full-time in person from the Zürich office and travel often.

description:

Imagine pushing the boundaries of what machines can perceive and decide, refining the intelligence behind autonomous flight systems that operate in the real world. At Destinus, we are shaping the future of defense through high-speed, autonomous flight technologies. We develop next-generation unmanned aerial systems that deliver greater speed, precision, and efficiency, supporting governments and defense organizations in mission-critical operations worldwide.
Daedalean AG, the AI and autonomy hub of the Destinus Group, plays a key role in this vision. Developing safety-critical AI systems at the intersection of advanced research and real-world aviation. - Excellent programming skills in C++; experience with Rust is a plus.

Who You Are
You thrive in complex, high-stakes environments where precision matters, driven by curiosity to make systems smarter and more reliable. You experiment, iterate, and solve without waiting for direction, balancing deep technical thinking with real-world impact. Ownership comes naturally, collaboration is seamless, and there is a constant drive to push for excellence.

title: Photonics System Architect 100%
description:
Are you passionate about pushing the boundaries of photonic integrated circuit (PIC) technology? Lightium, a leading-edge photonics startup, is looking for a skilled Photonics System Architect to spearhead the system-level design and requirements management for internal and external customers in Lightium’s proprietary thin-film lithium niobate (TFLN) platform. This role offers a unique opportunity to contribute to the next generation of photonics solutions while collaborating with leading transceiver manufacturers and optical interconnect hardware companies.

Position Summary
As a Photonics System Architect, you will be responsible for defining and implementing system-level architectures together with our customers and for Lightium’s reference designs from concept to schematic as well as layout in Lightium’s proprietary TFLN-based technology. You will have the opportunity to apply state-of-the-art requirements-tracking methodologies and tools to ensure success for internal and external customers. Your contributions will be pivotal to ensuring a first-time-right design of complex, high-speed, electro-optical photonic integrated circuits (PICs).

Key Responsibilities
System Concepts and Architecture: Design optical on-chip communication systems based on internal and external customer requirements in the space of coherent communication in both C-band and O-band (coherent lite), intensity modulation direct detection (IMDD), quantum, radio over fiber (RoF), and passive optical networking (PON) systems. Setting up system-level specifications and derive block-level specifications. You will derive the system architectures of those systems and drive their schematic design and layout in state-of-the-art EDA tools. You will run system- and circuit-level simulations and optimize parameters to meet the target specifications while ensuring manufacturability and testability.

Relationship management: Act as the key interface with external parties such as drivers / TIA suppliers, packaging and integration houses (OSATs), strategic DSP partners, and customers.

Requirements Management: Benchmarking and selection of requirements management tools, their implementation, applying the previously-defined procedures and training of your colleagues and peers in the space of system engineering. Prior experience with PLM systems at an industrial level is advantageous for this role.

Collaboration: Work closely with the R&D teams from design to optical testing and characterization, contributing to cross-functional projects to advance our TFLN technologies. Occasional travel to Lightium’s existing customers and prospects.

Documentation and Reporting: Maintain thorough documentation and report findings, establish standard operating procedures, and train new colleagues.

Innovation: Stay up to date on the latest advancements in photonics, incorporating new techniques and technologies into our R&D landscape. Contribution to Lightium’s IP portfolio.

What You’ll Bring
Educational Background: An advanced degree (PhD preferred) in Communications, Integrated Photonics, Electrical Engineering, Physics, or a related field.

Experience Level: At least 5 years of work experience in RF and optical system design in integrated photonics (PICs), including ISO-compliant requirements management. Prior experience with integrated photonics, such as TFLN, silicon photonics, SiN, InP or related photonics platforms including microwave photonics, is mandatory for this role. Prior experience with IEEE standards such as IEEE 803.2ba, including 100 GbE LR4, 400 GbE DR4, 1.6T DR4, 1.6T ZR, and 1.6T ZR+, is a plus.

Technical Skills: Proficiency in system-level design including system-level simulation software packages such as Ansys Lumerical, GDSFactory, Luceda, PhotonDesign, Synopsis, Cadence or VPI Photonics. Strong understanding of system-level architectures in the space of photonics, like coherent transmitters and coherent receivers. Requirements tracking in accordance with the V development model. Prior experience with quantum computing systems or optical communication between or towards satellites is a plus.

Organization & Documentation: Strong organizational skills to plan your work schedule between multiple facilities, record your results and procedures, follow facilities’ guidelines, and use best practices to maintain confidentiality.

Collaboration: Excellent communication skills and the ability to communicate effectively in a multidisciplinary team and with international customers. Cultural awareness and tailoring of communication style to US, European, and Asian customers.

Adaptability: The ability to thrive in a fast-paced startup environment, demonstrating flexibility and resilience in the face of change.

Language Skills: Fluency in English is required; knowledge of German, French, or an Asian language is an advantage.

What We Offer
A unique opportunity to lead a cutting-edge manufacturing initiative in the rapidly growing field of photonics.

Competitive compensation and benefits package, including employee stock option plan (ESOP), reflective of your experience and expertise.

Become a key player in an early-phase startup and be part of a young, motivated, and energetic team. You will have the unique opportunity to create, grow, and develop your professional skills at a fast pace.

We'd love to hear from you if you're passionate about building new tech from the ground up and thrive in a collaborative and innovative environment.

Lightium is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: (Senior) Researcher in SoC Architecture (Wireless Technologies)
description:
Huawei’s vision is to enrich lives through communication and intelligent innovation.

As a global leader in information and communications technology (ICT), Huawei drives innovation in artificial intelligence, cloud computing, and smart device technologies. Through its Carrier, Enterprise, and Consumer business groups, the company delivers advanced Network Infrastructure, Cloud and AI Platforms, and industry-leading devices.

Huawei supports 45 of the world’s top 50 telecom operators and serves one-third of the global population, with operations in over 170 countries and a workforce of more than 200,000 employees.

Huawei Technologies Switzerland AG contributes to this innovation through cutting-edge research, with offices in Zurich and Lausanne focusing on High-Performance Computing, Computer Architecture, Computer Vision, Robotics, Artificial Intelligence, Neuromorphic Computing, Wireless Technologies, Networking, and related fields.

We are a unique team of innovative, diverse individuals who have come together from multiple backgrounds to create advanced Computing Architectures for communication system /Edge AI. The people who work here are generalists, and we complement each other. The passion for exploring uncharted territory makes us thrive.

We seek a highly talented (Senior) with research experience in the field of computing architecture. Responsibilities

Identify technology trends in Edge AI, scalar/vector/tensor processing, and CPU/GPU/NPU/TPU microarchitecture optimization techniques.

Propose novel technologies in computing architecture, memory/cache, interconnect and/or SoC design in general to improve Performance, Power efficiency and Area efficiency (PPA), system flexibility, etc.

Develop novel computing architecture to improve the performance and efficiency of chip systems through software-hardware co-design and other technical innovations.

Develop and maintain long-term strategic partnerships with the industry and academia from leading universities, and collaborate with professors specializing in computer architecture.

Key Qualifications

MSc or PhD in computer science, electrical engineering, wireless communication or related background.

At least 5 years of work experience in chip-related fields.

Having a strong background in hardware & software co-design, microprocessor architecture for scalar/vector/tensor computing, job scheduling in heterogeneous parallel systems, memory optimization in many-core systems, power optimization, etc.

Candidates with experience in AI chip design and power & area efficiency optimization are preferred.

Candidates with a good understanding of hardware-software interfaces and interactions, and experience in compiler technology, are preferred.

Excellent communication skills across organizations and at the executive level.

Fluency in English, both written and verbal. Chinese is a plus.

Excellent written skills for clear and concise reporting.

Opportunities for professional growth and development;

Competitive salary, and a high quality of life in Zurich, at the center of Europe;

title: Photonics Account Manager
description:
Are you passionate about turning complex customer engagements into seamless, high-trust partnerships? At Lightium, we're pioneering next-generation photonic integrated circuits (PICs) built on thin-film lithium niobate (TFLN), and we're looking for a Photonics Account Manager to serve as the backbone of our customer relationships, from purchase order entry through interfacing with our R&D team to long-term production agreements.

Position Summary
In this role, you'll join our Commercial Team, reporting to the CRO, and take ownership of the customer journey from project onboarding through delivery and after-sales expansion. You'll run structured customer touchpoints, coordinate across our internal operations and design teams, and ensure every MPW run is delivered on time, keeping every customer up to date on project status. Your work will be the bridgehead between Lightium's technical execution and our customers' confidence in Lightium as its prime photonics foundry partner.

Key Responsibilities
Customer Journey Ownership: Lead major customer engagements with Lightium’s foundry services, from kick-off and design submission to DRC report, regular update meetings, as well as shipment, invoicing, and after-sales support. Ensure customers always know where they stand thanks to your remarkable organization and communication skills.

Run Management & Internal Coordination: Track deliverables and open items across multiple simultaneous runs. Serve as the single customer-facing point of contact for run status, routing all technical questions to the appropriate internal resource, and closing the loop with the customer. Maintain tight alignment with our R&D Team and Operations Team through regular internal syncs. Keep CRM records tidy and up-to-date across all active engagements.

Process Building & Continuous Improvement: Design, document, and optimize Lightium’s internal business processes that make our customer journey scalable. Create best practices and standard operating procedures (SOPs) across our tools (CRM, Customer Portal, PLM, ERP, etc.) so that the approach defined today scales to a larger team tomorrow.

Customer Portal Ownership: Contribute to shaping, developing, and maintaining Lightium’s customer portal in collaboration with internal DevOps to ensure fully traceable data sharing with customers, such as PDK, technical updates, presentations, shipments, delivery notes, etc.

Industry & Relationship Development: Build trusted and durable relationships with customer-side program managers, heads of photonics, and engineering leads. Represent Lightium and expand your network at related tradeshows. This position requires regular international travel to tradeshows, conferences, and customer visits. While Lightium offers flexible working hours, this position requires regular meetings outside standard European office hours to meet with customers in different time zones.

What You’ll Bring
Educational Background: An advanced degree (Master or PhD) in Photonics, Engineering, Physics, or related technical field. Business or project management training is a plus.

Experience: 3–7 years in technical sales, account management, customer project or program management or customer success in a semiconductor or photonics environment. A foundry or contract manufacturing background is a strong advantage. Demonstrated track record managing multiple simultaneous customer engagements with complex technical deliverables and tight timelines.

Technical Skills: Sufficient photonics or semiconductor literacy to hold a credible conversation with a customer's engineering team. You will not need to design photonics chips, but you need to understand what a DRC violation, an insertion loss spec, or a fabrication yield figure means in context.

Organization: Exceptional organizational discipline: you track open items, you follow up, and nothing falls through. You treat up-to-date folders and information as a professional standard rather than an administrative burden.

Communication: Strong customer-centric communication: You translate complex internal status into clear, professional customer-facing language and documents into condensed information without losing accuracy.

Collaboration: You know how to get things done leveraging your indirect leadership skills, whether that is pulling a status update from a process engineer, aligning with the ops team on a shipping timeline, or getting a design review prioritized. You are experienced in interfacing with external parties, such as fab partners and OSATs, and can communicate across cultural differences.

Adaptability: The ability to thrive in a fast-paced startup environment, demonstrating flexibility, ownership, and resilience in the face of change. You are comfortable operating in environments where processes are still being built, and you actively contribute to their development.

Language Skills: Fluency in English is required. German, French, Mandarin, or another Asian language is a plus.

What We Offer
Competitive compensation and benefits package, including an employee stock option plan (ESOP), fully-covered Pillar Two, and generous vacation.

A unique opportunity to lead a cutting-edge manufacturing initiative in the rapidly growing field of photonics.

A collaborative and innovative work environment where your contributions will shape the future of telecommunications, datacom, and beyond.

Final Thoughts
We'd love to hear from you if you're passionate about building new tech from the ground up and thrive in a collaborative and result-driven environment. Become a key player in an early-phase startup and join a motivated and energetic team. You will have the unique opportunity to create, grow, and develop your professional skills at a fast pace. title: Strategic Technology Lead (AI Systems & Computing Architecture)
description:
About us
At Huawei Technologies Switzerland AG, we are a leading technology firm dedicated to developing cutting-edge solutions that redefine industry standards and push technological boundaries. Our core focus is on creating advanced computing architectures that can efficiently support and enhance the performance of artificial intelligence systems. We believe in innovation as a driving force for improvement and are committed to achieving excellence in all areas of research and development.

Role Overview
We are seeking a high-caliber Strategic Technology Lead to serve as the strategic bridge between world-class academic research and industrial product evolution. In this role, you will drive the full lifecycle of external collaboration projects, from identifying potential / trendy technologies in computer architecture and AI algorithms to ensuring these innovations are successfully integrated into our next-generation hardware-software systems. You will act as a Technological Diplomat, aligning internal business requirements with global academic excellence to accelerate the transformation of research into industrial value.

Key Responsibilities

1. Strategic Analysis & Trend Mapping
Evaluate Emerging Tech: Conduct in-depth research (literature reviews, simulations, and trend analysis) on AI-empowered processors, accelerators, and heterogeneous systems.
Decision Support: Produce high-impact technical reports for Chief Scientists and Executives to guide the strategic roadmap of the Corporate Research and Business Units.
Feasibility Studies: Lead early-stage technical assessments to shape technical roadmaps for future innovation programs.
2. Technological Diplomacy & Partner Engagement
Strategic Academic Engagement: Cultivate and maintain high-level relationships with global faculty and elite research institutions. Proactively identify synergies between emerging scientific breakthroughs and the company's long-term technical roadmaps.
Ecosystem Building: Foster an international network of researchers, suppliers, and academic partners. Organize high-level exchange activities, including workshops, seminars, and technical competitions.
3. Research Transformation & Implementation
Value Acceleration: Drive the digestion and expansion of external research results. Facilitate the transfer of academic achievements into internal R&D pipelines to maximize industrial impact.
Prototyping & Validation: Support or oversee preliminary technical assessments and prototyping efforts to validate research feasibility for product integration.
4. End-to-End Collaborative Project Management
Lifecycle Oversight: Manage the full collaborative project flow: requirements alignment, technical solution design, project initiation, phase reviews, and final acceptance.
Internal Alignment: Coordinate between local research teams and Headquarters technical leaders to ensure research outcomes are synchronized with internal product timelines.
Resource Orchestration: Steer cross-functional teams toward well-defined goals, managing the delicate balance between long-term research and immediate engineering constraints.

Requirements & Qualifications
Education & Experience
PhD in Computer Architecture, Chip Design, Electronic Engineering, or a related AI-hardware field.
5+ years of experience in industry or academic research, specifically managing or participating in high-stakes collaboration projects.
Deep Technical Expertise in at least one of the following:
Architecture: CPU/GPU/NPU cores, SoC design, or AI accelerators.
AI/ML Systems: Modern AI models, and hardware-software co-design/optimization.
Advanced Packaging: Heterogeneous integration (3DIC), Chiplets, or thermal management.

Core Competencies
Analytical Mindset: Ability to toggle between high-level strategic big picture and deep-dive technical details.
Project Leadership: A proactive, self-driven attitude with a proven track record of moving projects forward independently.
Exceptional Communication: A master of persuasion who can simplify complex concepts for stakeholders and navigate ambiguous, fast-paced environments.
Language Proficiency: Fluency in English is mandatory; proficiency in Chinese is highly preferred to ensure seamless communication with Headquarters.

title: Director, Global Commodity Management & Analytics
description:
Ready to make your next big professional move? Join us on our journey to achieve our big dream of building the most loved restaurant brands in the world.  

Restaurant Brands International Inc. is one of the world's largest quick service restaurant companies with nearly $45 billion in annual system-wide sales and over 32,000 restaurants in more than 120 countries and territories.

RBI owns four of the world's most prominent and iconic quick service restaurant brands – TIM HORTONS®, BURGER KING®, POPEYES®, and FIREHOUSE SUBS®. These independently operated brands have been serving their respective guests, franchisees and communities for decades. Through its Restaurant Brands for Good framework, RBI is improving sustainable outcomes related to its food, the planet, and people and communities.

RBI is committed to growing the TIM HORTONS®, BURGER KING®, POPEYES® and FIREHOUSE SUBS® brands by leveraging their respective core values, employee and franchisee relationships, and long track records of community support. Each brand benefits from the global scale and shared best practices that come from ownership by Restaurant Brands International Inc.

RBI’s Global Commodities & Intelligence Centre of Excellence

RBI is strengthening its global procurement organization by establishing a Global Commodities & Intelligence Centre of Excellence (CoE).

The CoE will provide commodity intelligence, data, risk management, and commercial decision support to procurement teams across RBI’s brands and markets. It will act as the analytical backbone of the global procurement function, helping regional teams make faster, data-driven sourcing and negotiation decisions.

Our Opportunity:

The Director, Global Commodity Management & Analytics will build and lead RBI’s newly established CoE, including its operating model, governance, analytical capabilities, tools, and team.

This is a newly created global role for a commercially minded commodity leader with deep market expertise, strong negotiation experience, advanced analytical capabilities, and an interest in using AI and data to improve procurement decisions.

The role will focus primarily on the following direct commodity categories:

Sugar, Wheat, Soy, Corn, Pork, Beef, Chicken, Paperboard, and Potatoes

The CoE will own market intelligence, forecasting, cost modelling, risk management, sourcing strategy, and upstream commercial negotiations for these categories, depending on the market.

The role will also provide advisory intelligence and risk support for selected indirect categories, including metals, steel, engineering, energy, maintenance, repair and operations, and industrial gases.

The CoE will lead or support negotiations for upstream raw materials, including raw meat cuts, agricultural commodities, and packaging feedstocks.

RBI follows a five-day, in-office work schedule to support collaboration. Candidates should be comfortable working onsite five days per week.

Your Roles & Responsibilities:

Build and lead the Global Commodities & Intelligence CoE, establishing its operating model, governance, team structure, priorities, and ways of working with regional and global procurement teams.
Define RBI’s global commodity intelligence strategy, including frameworks for market monitoring, price forecasting, risk assessment, scenario planning, and procurement timing recommendations.
Develop and deploy AI-enabled intelligence capabilities, including forecasting models, real-time market monitoring, should-cost tools, scenario analysis, and executive risk dashboards.
Own RBI’s global commodity risk management strategy, covering forward contracting, index-linked pricing, supplier diversification, pooling opportunities, hedging considerations, and spot, forward, and long-term supply arrangements.
Lead upstream commodity negotiations across the direct category portfolio, from market analysis and strategy development through to supplier engagement and commercial execution, as appropriate by market.
Lead RBI’s Global Contingency and Risk Management Programme, including supply-chain stress testing, inventory and business-continuity planning, geopolitical and weather-risk analysis, reporting, and executive escalation.
Establish global should-cost models, cost benchmarks, and pricing mechanisms that help procurement teams validate supplier proposals and strengthen sourcing and negotiation decisions.
Manage external commodity consultancies, market-data providers, and intelligence platforms, while building an integrated and scalable data infrastructure across markets and functions.
Act as RBI’s global commodity intelligence leader, delivering market outlooks, cost-impact analysis, sourcing recommendations, and executive briefings to senior procurement, finance, and brand leaders.
Partner with Procurement, Finance, Treasury, Supply Chain, Operations, R&D, Quality Assurance, Sustainability, and Brand teams to deliver cost savings, cost avoidance, supply resilience, responsible sourcing, and stronger procurement governance.

Your skills & experience:

10+ years of progressive experience in global commodity procurement, trading, supply chain risk management, or commodity market intelligence within a large-scale FMCG, food service, QSR, or agri-food business.
Demonstrable expertise across at least three of the nine Direct categories; proven track record of executing upstream raw commodity negotiations at significant scale, including proteins (Beef, Chicken, Pork), grains, oilseeds, or packaging feedstocks.
Strong working knowledge of commodity markets, exchange mechanics (CME, CBOT, ICE), financial risk instruments (futures, options, swaps), and price risk management frameworks.
Proven experience deploying or commissioning AI, machine learning, or advanced analytics tools for commodity forecasting, market monitoring, or procurement decision support.
Experience building or leading a Centre of Excellence, intelligence function, or data capability within a complex global organization.
Track record of managing external consultancies, market data vendors, and analytics platform relationships at enterprise scale.
Experience operating within global matrixed organizations with multiple brands, procurement cooperatives, or franchise networks; able to influence without direct authority across regional structures.
Strong commercial acumen with the ability to translate commodity market dynamics into clear business recommendations and financial impact models.
Excellent communicator and executive presence; comfortable presenting to C-suite and Board-level audiences.
Fluent in English; additional languages (French, German, Spanish, Portuguese) are an asset.

We are looking for:

A seasoned commodity professional who can build and lead a high-impact global intelligence function while also owning the commercial execution of RBI’s upstream raw commodity portfolio. You operate at the intersection of markets, data, and strategy. You are as comfortable at the negotiating table as you are presenting a risk scenario to the Board. You influence regional teams through the quality of your intelligence and the rigor of your commercial outcomes. You are energized by complexity, clarity, and building things that others depend on.

description:

Comptable confirmé(e)

Nous recrutons pour le compte d'une fiduciaire basée au centre de Genève un(e) Comptable confirmé(e) / Responsable de mandats pour un poste fixe. Vous prenez en charge de manière autonome un portefeuille de clients et assurez le suivi complet de leurs dossiers, tant sur les aspects comptables que salariaux, fiscaux et administratifs. Vous évoluez dans un environnement entrepreneurial privilégiant les outils digitaux tout en conservant une relation de proximité avec ses clients.



**Responsabilités**

* Gérer de manière autonome un portefeuille de clients Assurer la tenue complète des comptabilités jusqu'au bouclement
* Réaliser les clôtures intermédiaires et annuelles et établir les états financiers
* Élaborer les tableaux de bord et assurer le suivi de la trésorerie et des flux financiers
* Gérer les opérations bancaires, factures clients et paiements fournisseurs
* Établir les salaires et prendre en charge les démarches administratives liées au personnel
* Effectuer les déclarations sociales mensuelles et annuelles et assurer les relations avec les caisses de compensation
* Préparer les déclarations fiscales des personnes physiques et morales
* Établir et contrôler les décomptes TVA et assurer les échanges avec les administrations fiscales
* Présenter les comptes aux clients et les accompagner dans le suivi de leurs dossiers
* Assurer une coordination efficace avec les autres membres de l'équipe et effectuer un reporting auprès de la direction


**Profil**

* Minimum 3 ans d'expérience en fiduciaire en Suisse en qualité de responsable de mandats
* Expérience dans la gestion autonome d'un portefeuille clients conséquent
* Excellentes connaissances en comptabilité, fiscalité et gestion des salaires
* Maîtrise des outils bureautiques usuels, notamment **MS Office et SharePoint**
* La connaissance d' **Odoo et de WinEUR** **Salaires** constitue un réel atout
* Français courant et bonnes connaissances en anglais ; toute autre langue est un plus
* Excellente capacité d'organisation et aptitude à gérer plusieurs dossiers et échéances simultanément
* Personne autonome, proactive, rigoureuse et précise
* Bonne résistance au stress et capacité à respecter des délais exigeants
* Très bon relationnel et véritable orientation client
* Sens aigu de la confidentialité et des responsabilités


**Bénéfices**

* Gestion autonome d'un portefeuille de clients variés
* Fonction complète couvrant comptabilité, salaires, fiscalité et conseil client
* Environnement de travail entrepreneurial et digitalisé Relation directe et privilégiée avec les clients
* Poste offrant autonomie, responsabilités et diversité des missions
* Avantages sociaux


**Informations de contact**

N'hésitez pas à nous faire parvenir votre candidature, elle sera traitée en toute confidentialité ! Julien Jacquet



**À propos de nous**

Adecco Placement Fixe Genève \& La Côte, est votre agence spécialisée dans la recherche et le placement de personnel fixe pour la région de Genève et La Côte.



Spécialistes dans les domaines : Office\-Administration; Immobilier; Construction, Bureau d'études et Architecture; Electricité; CVCSE; Industrie.

Junior Product Manager
======================

**REJOIGNEZ NOTRE EQUIPE !**

Fondée en 1892 à Lancaster, en Pennsylvanie, Hamilton crée des montres offrant un équilibre unique entre authenticité et innovation. Les montres Hamilton ont contribué à la synchronisation des premiers chemins de fer et accompagné les pionniers de l'aviation, ainsi que les soldats américains. Grandes favorites des cinéastes depuis des décennies, les montres Hamilton sont apparues dans plus de 500 films, avec des modèles personnalisés ayant joué un rôle clé dans plusieurs blockbusters hollywoodiens.

Membre du Swatch Group, leader mondial dans la fabrication et la distribution de montres, Hamilton conjugue esprit américain et précision suisse dans ses collections actuelles. Authenticité et innovation sont deux valeurs qu'Hamilton cultive, tant à travers ses montres qu'à travers ses collaborateurs. La quête d'excellence et l'esprit d'aventure caractérisent chaque projet que nous entreprenons.

**LE JOB**

Afin de renforcer notre département Product Management, nous recherchons un **Junior Product Manager**.

Rattaché au Head of Product Management, vous participez au développement et au lancement de lignes de produits, depuis les premières réflexions créatives jusqu'à leur mise sur le marché. Au coeur d'équipes pluridisciplinaires, vous collaborez notamment avec le Design, la Qualité, les Achats, le Marketing, les Ventes et les partenaires externes.

**VOS MISSIONS**

* Responsabilité du développement de lignes de produits selon la planification établie par le Head of Product Management :
* Participation à l'élaboration du design produit
* Etablissement de la planification et suivi des délais
* Consultation et suivi des fournisseurs, pilotage de la convergence design\-production\-coûts
* Négociation des prix des composants en collaboration avec les Achats
* Etablissement des calculs de prix
* Pilotage de la fabrication des prototypes
* Etablissement de la documentation technique


* Coordination du lancement du produit en étroite collaboration avec les départements concernés jusqu'à la mise sur le marché :
    + Participation au plan de communication Produit en collaboration avec le Marketing
    + Mise à disposition du Marketing et de la Vente des informations et outils nécessaires pour la promotion des Produits en phase de lancement
    + Présentations internes et externes des nouveautés, participation à des formations Produit dans les filiales
* Suivi dans le temps des lignes de produit :
    + Analyse des ventes en collaboration avec la Vente


* Participation à l'élaboration du Plan Produit  

* Contrôle et coordination des montres pour les départements Marketing et Ventes

* Préparation des présentations produits et des feuilles de route ainsi que des tableaux de produits

* Mise à jour des manuels d'utilisation

* Développement d'emballages spéciaux

* Préparation et diffusion des fiches techniques des produits

* Organisation de formations internes

* Analyse des tendances des marchés

**VOTRE PROFIL**

* CFC d'employé.e de commerce
* Formation supérieure en marketing avec une 1^e expérience réussie dans le développement Produit
* 2 à 5 ans d'expérience dans l'horlogerie au sein d'un département développement Produit ou Marketing
* Expérience dans la gestion de projets avec capacités de vue d'ensemble dans un environnement pluridisciplinaire
* Intérêt prononcé pour le marketing produit
* Compréhension des problématiques techniques horlogères
* Sens aigü de la communication
* Esprit d'équipe
* Esprit de leadership et sens de l'initiative
* Forte sensibilité desing et au courant de tendances actuelles
* Esprit analytique et orienté solution
* Force de persuasion et de négociation
* Langue maternelle française avec de très bonnes connaissances de l'anglais
* Maîtrise des produits MS Office
* Connaissances SAP un atout


**VOTRE ETAT D'ESPRIT**

Hamilton recherche des personnalités qui se distinguent par leur curiosité et engagement en faveur de l'excellence. Les membres de notre organisation ont une personnalité pratique, ainsi que d'excellentes compétences en matière de communication et d'organisation. Ils développent et mettent en oeuvre des initiatives audacieuses qui équilibrent stratégiquement les risques et les attentes en matière de résultats et travaillent aussi bien en équipe qu'en tant que décideurs indépendants. Nous apportons de la passion et de l'enthousiasme à chaque projet et apprécions les personnes qui travaillent dur pour atteindre leurs objectifs.

Conçues pour les aventuriers, les pionniers, les créateurs et les héros du quotidien, nos montres ne se contentent pas de donner l'heure : elles racontent une histoire. Rejoignez notre équipe et commencez à écrire la vôtre avec Hamilton !

2504 Biel/Bienne

Federica Raho

title: Director, Global Commodity Management & Analytics
description:
Ready to make your next big professional move? Join us on our journey to achieve our big dream of building the most loved restaurant brands in the world.  

Restaurant Brands International Inc. is one of the world's largest quick service restaurant companies with nearly $45 billion in annual system-wide sales and over 32,000 restaurants in more than 120 countries and territories.

RBI owns four of the world's most prominent and iconic quick service restaurant brands – TIM HORTONS®, BURGER KING®, POPEYES®, and FIREHOUSE SUBS®. These independently operated brands have been serving their respective guests, franchisees and communities for decades. Through its Restaurant Brands for Good framework, RBI is improving sustainable outcomes related to its food, the planet, and people and communities.

RBI is committed to growing the TIM HORTONS®, BURGER KING®, POPEYES® and FIREHOUSE SUBS® brands by leveraging their respective core values, employee and franchisee relationships, and long track records of community support. Each brand benefits from the global scale and shared best practices that come from ownership by Restaurant Brands International Inc.

RBI’s Global Commodities & Intelligence Centre of Excellence

RBI is strengthening its global procurement organization by establishing a Global Commodities & Intelligence Centre of Excellence (CoE).

The CoE will provide commodity intelligence, data, risk management, and commercial decision support to procurement teams across RBI’s brands and markets. It will act as the analytical backbone of the global procurement function, helping regional teams make faster, data-driven sourcing and negotiation decisions.

Our Opportunity:

The Director, Global Commodity Management & Analytics will build and lead RBI’s newly established CoE, including its operating model, governance, analytical capabilities, tools, and team.

This is a newly created global role for a commercially minded commodity leader with deep market expertise, strong negotiation experience, advanced analytical capabilities, and an interest in using AI and data to improve procurement decisions.

The role will focus primarily on the following direct commodity categories:

Sugar, Wheat, Soy, Corn, Pork, Beef, Chicken, Paperboard, and Potatoes

The CoE will own market intelligence, forecasting, cost modelling, risk management, sourcing strategy, and upstream commercial negotiations for these categories, depending on the market.

Develop and deploy AI-enabled intelligence capabilities, including forecasting models, real-time market monitoring, should-cost tools, scenario analysis, and executive risk dashboards.
Own RBI’s global commodity risk management strategy, covering forward contracting, index-linked pricing, supplier diversification, pooling opportunities, hedging considerations, and spot, forward, and long-term supply arrangements.
Lead upstream commodity negotiations across the direct category portfolio, from market analysis and strategy development through to supplier engagement and commercial execution, as appropriate by market.
Lead RBI’s Global Contingency and Risk Management Programme, including supply-chain stress testing, inventory and business-continuity planning, geopolitical and weather-risk analysis, reporting, and executive escalation.
Establish global should-cost models, cost benchmarks, and pricing mechanisms that help procurement teams validate supplier proposals and strengthen sourcing and negotiation decisions.
Manage external commodity consultancies, market-data providers, and intelligence platforms, while building an integrated and scalable data infrastructure across markets and functions.
Act as RBI’s global commodity intelligence leader, delivering market outlooks, cost-impact analysis, sourcing recommendations, and executive briefings to senior procurement, finance, and brand leaders.
Partner with Procurement, Finance, Treasury, Supply Chain, Operations, R&D, Quality Assurance, Sustainability, and Brand teams to deliver cost savings, cost avoidance, supply resilience, responsible sourcing, and stronger procurement governance.

Your skills & experience:

10+ years of progressive experience in global commodity procurement, trading, supply chain risk management, or commodity market intelligence within a large-scale FMCG, food service, QSR, or agri-food business.
Demonstrable expertise across at least three of the nine Direct categories; proven track record of executing upstream raw commodity negotiations at significant scale, including proteins (Beef, Chicken, Pork), grains, oilseeds, or packaging feedstocks.
Strong working knowledge of commodity markets, exchange mechanics (CME, CBOT, ICE), financial risk instruments (futures, options, swaps), and price risk management frameworks.
Proven experience deploying or commissioning AI, machine learning, or advanced analytics tools for commodity forecasting, market monitoring, or procurement decision support.
Experience building or leading a Centre of Excellence, intelligence function, or data capability within a complex global organization.
Track record of managing external consultancies, market data vendors, and analytics platform relationships at enterprise scale.
Experience operating within global matrixed organizations with multiple brands, procurement cooperatives, or franchise networks; able to influence without direct authority across regional structures.
Strong commercial acumen with the ability to translate commodity market dynamics into clear business recommendations and financial impact models.
Excellent communicator and executive presence; comfortable presenting to C-suite and Board-level audiences.
Fluent in English; additional languages (French, German, Spanish, Portuguese) are an asset.

We are looking for:

A seasoned commodity professional who can build and lead a high-impact global intelligence function while also owning the commercial execution of RBI’s upstream raw commodity portfolio. You operate at the intersection of markets, data, and strategy. You are as comfortable at the negotiating table as you are presenting a risk scenario to the Board. You influence regional teams through the quality of your intelligence and the rigor of your commercial outcomes. You are energized by complexity, clarity, and building things that others depend on.

title: Global Head Digital & Technology Officer, P&C
description:
About the Role

The Global Head Digital & Technology Officer, P&C Re is accountable for the end-to-end Digital & Technology agenda supporting our global Property & Casualty Reinsurance business.
As a member of the senior Digital & Technology leadership team and a strategic partner to the P&C Re Executive Leadership Team, this role shapes how technology enables the business to grow, operate efficiently, manage risk and respond to an evolving reinsurance landscape.
The role combines technology strategy, business transformation and large-scale operational leadership. It requires an executive who can translate business strategy into a clear technology agenda, lead a significant global technology organization and portfolio, and determine where modernization and innovation will deliver meaningful commercial value.
The successful candidate will bring deep experience operating at scale within complex, highly regulated financial services environments, together with the leadership capability to drive transformation across businesses, functions and geographies.

Key Responsibilities
Set the Digital & Technology Strategy
•    Own the global Digital & Technology strategy for P&C Re, ensuring technology priorities, investment and capabilities are closely aligned with business strategy and the broader Group technology agenda.
•    Act as a trusted strategic partner to P&C Re leadership, bringing a technology perspective to business strategy, growth, operational effectiveness and transformation.
•    Translate business priorities into a pragmatic, multi-year technology roadmap with clear outcomes, investment priorities and accountability.
•    Represent P&C Re within enterprise technology decision-making, ensuring opportunities for shared platforms, capabilities and investments are fully leveraged.
•    Maintain a forward-looking perspective on technology and industry developments, identifying where emerging capabilities can create meaningful competitive or operational advantage.
Lead Transformation, Engineering & Innovation
•    Lead the modernization and simplification of the P&C Re technology landscape, balancing transformation ambition with commercial value, operational stability and business continuity.
•    Strengthen modern engineering, architecture and delivery practices to improve speed, resilience, quality and predictability.
•    Drive transformation of technology operating models, including organizational structures, location strategy, sourcing and strategic technology partnerships.
•    Champion the responsible adoption of data, analytics, automation and AI, including Generative AI, to enhance productivity, decision-making and business outcomes.
•    Build an environment where innovation is encouraged while investment remains focused on opportunities with clear strategic or commercial value.
•    Partner across Digital & Technology to leverage enterprise capabilities while ensuring solutions meet the specific needs of the P&C Re business.
Own Technology Performance, Investment & Risk
•    Hold end-to-end accountability for a significant global technology organization, application landscape and investment portfolio supporting the P&C Re business.
•    Ensure technology services and platforms are resilient, secure, scalable and capable of supporting the evolving needs of the business.
•    Optimize technology investment, capacity and resources across strategic transformation and business-as-usual priorities.
•    Drive disciplined portfolio management and governance, providing transparency around investment, delivery, performance, risk and value realization.
•    Identify opportunities to simplify the technology landscape, consolidate capabilities and improve cost efficiency without compromising business delivery.
•    Ensure technology risk, cyber security, operational resilience and regulatory requirements are embedded within technology strategy and execution.
•    Engage confidently with Risk, Compliance, Audit and regulatory stakeholders, maintaining a strong culture of accountability and control.
Build a High-Performing Global Organization
•    Lead and develop a large, globally distributed technology organization, creating clarity of purpose, accountability and decision rights across teams and geographies.
•    Build a strong senior leadership team with the capability to manage complex portfolios, lead transformation and partner effectively with the business.
•    Create an open and transparent leadership culture characterized by candid dialogue, constructive challenge and clear accountability.
•    Invest in leadership development, succession and capability building, empowering leaders while holding them accountable for outcomes.
•    Lead teams successfully through significant organizational and technology change, maintaining engagement, stability and delivery performance.
•    Build effective partnerships across business, technology and corporate functions, breaking down organizational boundaries to achieve enterprise outcomes.

About You

You are a global technology executive with a track record of leading complex technology organizations and transformation at significant scale.
You combine strategic vision with strong operational and commercial judgment. You understand that technology transformation is not an objective in itself: successful transformation starts with understanding the business problem, determining where change creates value and executing with discipline.
Your experience has given you a strong understanding of operating within highly regulated financial services environments, where innovation and speed must be balanced with resilience, risk management and regulatory expectations.
You are equally comfortable discussing business strategy with senior executives, challenging technology investment decisions, navigating regulatory requirements and engaging with technology leaders on engineering, architecture and delivery.
As a leader, you create structure and transparency in complex environments. You set clear expectations and provide candid feedback while giving leaders the trust and space to succeed. You are passionate about developing people and building leadership capability that extends beyond your own organization.
You bring an international perspective and have demonstrated the ability to lead successfully across geographies, cultures and organizational boundaries.

Experience & Capabilities

•    Extensive senior executive experience in technology, digital or engineering leadership within large, complex global organizations.
•    Significant experience within reinsurance, insurance, banking or broader financial services, including operating within highly regulated environments.
•    Proven accountability for large-scale global technology organizations, complex application landscapes and significant technology investment portfolios.
•    Experience owning technology end-to-end for a major business, business unit or portfolio, with clear accountability for strategy, delivery, operations and transformation.
•    A strong record of leading complex technology and organizational transformation, with demonstrable improvements in business performance, efficiency, resilience or cost.
•    Experience modernizing engineering practices, technology platforms and delivery models within established global organizations.
•    Strong commercial and financial management capabilities, including technology investment prioritization, vendor management, sourcing and cost optimization.
•    Experience designing or transforming technology operating models, including organizational structure, location strategy and global delivery capabilities.
•    Strong understanding of technology risk, regulatory compliance, operational resilience and control environments.
•    Experience leading and developing substantial global teams through periods of organizational and technological change.
•    Executive presence and the ability to influence, challenge and build trusted relationships with senior business and technology stakeholders.

Additional Experience That Would Be Valuable

•    Direct leadership experience within Property & Casualty insurance or reinsurance.
•    Experience applying AI, Generative AI, data, analytics and automation at enterprise scale.
•    Experience establishing or expanding global technology hubs and engineering capabilities.
•    Experience contributing to enterprise-wide technology capabilities and platforms beyond a single business or functional domain.
•    Experience leading major regulatory or compliance-driven technology programs across multiple jurisdictions.
•    Strong understanding of cloud, modern architecture and contemporary engineering methodologies.

title: Flight Software Systems Engineer for Space Missions
description:
Einleitungstext
Led by Prof. Dr. Thomas Zurbuchen, ETH Zurich | Space brings together space-related research, education and technology development across ETH Zurich. Working with academic, industrial and institutional partners, the initiative develops new space missions, instruments and technologies.

This position is offered as a fixed-term appointment for an initial period of two years, with the possibility of extension.

Projekthintergrund
The objective of this initiative is to establish and grow a centralized pool of space engineering expertise within ETH Zurich | Space. This pool supports ETH Zurich-led space projects and technology programs, strengthening ETH Zurich’s role in the Swiss and international space ecosystem.

The Flight Software Systems Engineer will support a diverse portfolio of small spacecraft, scientific instruments, robotic systems, and technology demonstrators. The work includes resource-constrained missions, integration with externally supplied spacecraft platforms, autonomous functions, and future distributed or coordinated spacecraft concepts. This role interfaces across systems engineering, avionics, payloads, and software development, and coordinates with external platform providers and mission operations teams.

Aufgaben-/Stellenbeschreibung
As part of the specialized resource pool, you will provide flight software and software systems engineering expertise across multiple ETH Zurich space projects. You will contribute from early mission formulation and software architecture through implementation, integration, verification, launch preparation, and operations.

As part of your role, you will:

Take technical ownership of assigned flight software developments and act as the primary software interface to systems engineering, avionics, payload teams, mission operations, and external platform providers.
Translate mission concept of operations into spacecraft behaviors and define flight software architectures and functional decompositions
Allocate hardware-software functions, and define associated software requirements and interfaces.
Translate mission and system requirements into software specifications, interface control documents, operational concepts, and verification plans.
Develop embedded flight software in C and C++ and supporting tools and test scripts (e.g., Python), including device drivers, telemetry and telecommand handling, onboard data management, application software, and fault-management functions.
Integrate flight software with onboard computers, sensors, actuators, payload electronics, communication interfaces, ground systems, and externally supplied spacecraft platforms.
Set up and maintain flat-sat flight software testbeds
Perform software-related trade studies covering processing capacity, memory, timing, bandwidth, autonomy, reliability, and fault tolerance.
Develop real-time, event-driven, autonomous, synchronization, and GNC-related software functions where required.
Establish and maintain software baselines, configuration control, versioning, build automation, continuous integration, release management, and requirements traceability.
Develop and execute flight software unit tests, conduct integration, software-in-the-loop, processor-in-the-loop, hardware-in-the-loop, and system-level verification and validation activities.
Support software risk management, anomaly investigation, non-conformance handling, and technical review boards.
Support spacecraft and payload assembly, integration, and test activities, commissioning, in-flight software updates, telemetry analysis, and mission operations.
Contribute to technical reviews, early-stage mission concepts, proposals, and software feasibility studies.
Provide technical guidance to junior engineers, researchers, and student teams.
Ihr Profil
You have a strong background in embedded and real-time software development combined with systems-level experience in software architecture, requirements engineering, interface definition, integration, and functional verification. You are comfortable working across mission, spacecraft, avionics, payload, software, and operations domains.

We are looking for someone with:

Master’s degree in computer science, electrical engineering, computer engineering, aerospace engineering, robotics, or a related field.
5+ years of professional experience in flight software, embedded software, or mission-critical software systems.
Strong programming skills in C and C++ for resource-constrained embedded targets.
Experience with real-time operating systems, embedded Linux, or bare-metal development.
Experience in software systems engineering, including architecture definition, functional decomposition, hardware-software allocation, requirements management, and interface control.
Ability to translate mission and spacecraft requirements into software specifications, operational concepts, and verification strategies.
Experience integrating flight software with avionics hardware, sensors, actuators, communication buses, payloads, or ground systems.
Understanding of telemetry and telecommand, onboard data handling, timing, autonomy, fault management, and spacecraft operations.
Hands-on experience with software integration, debugging, automated testing, and hardware-in-the-loop environments.
Experience with configuration management, version control, release processes, technical baselines, and requirements traceability.
Ability to assess software-related technical resources, including processing capacity, memory, timing, bandwidth, and reliability margins.
Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary and multicultural teams.
Knowledge of radiation effects, redundancy, memory protection, watchdogs, and FDIR.
Excellent command of English, both written and spoken; German is an advantage but not required.
Additionally, the following characteristics are a plus:

Experience developing flight software for CubeSats, small satellites, scientific instruments, planetary systems, or Class D/Gamma-type missions.
Experience leading or coordinating software-related and functional AIT activities, including test planning, execution, anomaly resolution, and system-level functional verification.
Experience integrating payload software with spacecraft platforms supplied by external industrial partners.
Familiarity with ECSS software engineering and software product assurance standards, NASA software practices, or comparable development frameworks.

title: F1 Data Scientist
description:
The Data Intelligence Team works alongside different technical groups to lead the data transformation of the department. Our work focuses on designing, building and deploying end to end data solutions that will enable more effective real-time decisions trackside and allow data-driven design of future sporting and technical regulations.
We seek result-driven, proactive people, who are passionate about building high-quality software solutions that address problems by transforming how engineers use data and technology. They must have a desire to innovate in a collaborative and fast-paced environment, as part of a growing team pushing the boundaries of what is possible in the unique and inspiring world of Motorsport.
The position will be based in our headquarters in Geneva and will involve some travel to Formula 1 championship events.

MISSIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
As F1 Data Scientist your mission is to design, test and deploy data solutions that transform raw motorsport data into powerful, actionable insights. You will work with large and diverse sources of data including telemetry time series, images or regulatory documents across multiple championships with the aim to build innovative tools and models that enhance understanding, and support fast decision-making.
To accomplish this, you will be part of the end-to-end product life-cycle: from requirement gathering and PoC development to deployment of production-ready solutions designed to scale, be understood by end users, meet organisation requirements and adapt as needs evolve.  

This role is ideal for someone who takes initiative, owns their work end-to-end, and actively contributes to a high-performing team.

Data Science
Develop Machine Learning models and advanced analytical tools that can provide further insights for decision-making.  
Further develop the FIA data analytics tool suite to optimise our remote and on-track support operations through real time analysis.
Investigate multimodal approaches that integrate telemetry time series, image, video, audio, and regulatory documents to enrich analytical capabilities.

MLOps Solutions
Build and maintain robust MLOps solutions to ensure scalability, reliability and continuous improvement of the deployed solutions.  
Collaborate with the Data Intelligence group to standardize data processing and promote shared tools across different FIA championships.

Latest Technology Watch
Stay up to date with state-of-the-art models, especially on time series treatment and the multi-modality area.  
Stay up to date on MLOps tools, techniques and best practices to enhance team capabilities.

PROFILE:
Master’s degree or equivalent working experience level in Computer Science, Data Science, AI Engineer, ML Ops Engineer or similar discipline.
You have extensive experience developing clean and efficient software in Python.  
You have significant experience with data wrangling libraries such as pandas, numpy, and PySpark.
You have significant experience with machine learning and deep learning frameworks such as Sklearn, SciPy, XGBoost or Pytorch.
You have extensive experience with the ML development lifecycle and MLOps solutions (MLFlow or similar) for model versioning, registry and experiment tracking.
You have knowledge of CI/CD pipeline implementation and containerization (Docker).  
You have experience with SQL and No-SQL databases.
You have demonstrated an ability to learn continuously and work autonomously. You are comfortable working in a rapidly changing environment with dynamic objectives and fast iteration with users.
You have demonstrated your ability to work effectively within teams with mixed technical expertise.
You are native or fluent in English. French is not required but appreciated.  
You are interested in Motorsport and are curious about how the field evolves and how data can impact it.  


The following skills are not required but if you have experience in any of them, we would love to hear more:  

You have experience developing computer vision solutions.
You have experience with open source LLM frameworks or Cloud based managed LLM solutions
You have experience with embedded machine learning
You have experience within the motorsport industry
You have experience working with Cloud Solutions, specifically AWS

If you are interested, please send us your CV and any relevant document.
The FIA is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified candidates.
